papers.title: Spatio-Temporal Scheduling Prediction Under Backhaul Delay for Resilient Coordinated Beamforming
papers.abstract_en: Coordinated beamforming in distributed 5G networks relies on the timely exchange of inter-cell scheduling information, but backhaul latency makes this information stale. Even a single transmission time interval (TTI) of delay can reduce CBF-SLNR performance below the uncoordinated baseline, because the precoder suppresses interference toward users that are no longer active. Coordination on stale information is therefore worse than no coordination at all. To address this, we propose a two-stage predictive framework in which a Spectral Temporal Graph Neural Network (StemGNN) predicts future user equipment (UE) scheduling states from delayed historical observations, and the predictions replace stale inputs to the CBF-SLNR precoder. Evaluated on a three-cell massive MIMO downlink with 60 UEs and 64 antennas per base station under Quadriga Urban Micro (UMi) channels and a proportional fair scheduler, StemGNN achieves a mean scheduling prediction accuracy of 87.57%, outperforming LSTM, GRU, Simple RNN, and Markov chain baselines at all evaluated horizons, with gains of up to 7.71% over LSTM at longer horizons where inter-UE structural dependencies dominate over temporal autocorrelation. When integrated into coordinated beamforming, the predictions recover 57-73% of the sum rate loss caused by one TTI of backhaul delay, improving sum rate by 9.58-14.35% over the no-prediction baseline and recovering up to 83% of the Lag-1 fairness loss for cell-edge users, with fairness gains persisting at higher lag values where throughput gains diminish. These results show that treating backhaul latency as a spatio-temporal forecasting problem is an effective approach for robust inter-cell coordination in delay-constrained networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分布式5G网络中回程延迟导致协调波束赋形（coordinated beamforming）性能下降的问题，提出两阶段预测框架：先使用Spectral Temporal Graph Neural Network (StemGNN) 预测未来的用户调度状态，再将预测结果替代陈旧信息输入CBF-SLNR预编码器。在3小区massive MIMO下行链路（60 UE，64天线，UMi信道）仿真中，StemGNN调度预测准确率达87.57%，优于LSTM等基线；集成后恢复57-73%的回程延迟导致的速率损失，提升sum rate 9.58-14.35%，并恢复83%的边缘用户公平性损失。
Motivation: 回程延迟使协调波束赋形使用的调度信息过时，即使单TTI的延迟也会导致性能低于无协调基线，因为预编码器会抑制已不再活跃用户的干扰，因此需要解决陈旧信息下的协调问题。
Method: 提出两阶段预测框架：第一阶段利用Spectral Temporal Graph Neural Network (StemGNN) 从延迟的历史观测中预测未来UE调度状态；第二阶段用预测结果替代陈旧信息作为CBF-SLNR预编码器的输入。
Result: 在3小区massive MIMO下行链路（60 UE，64天线，UMi信道）下，StemGNN调度预测准确率87.57%，在所有预测时域上优于LSTM、GRU、Simple RNN和马尔可夫链基线，长时域上较LSTM提升7.71%；集成后恢复57-73%的sum rate损失，提升9.58-14.35%的sum rate，并恢复83%的边缘用户公平性损失。
Conclusion: 将回程延迟视为时空预测问题（spatio-temporal forecasting problem）是处理延迟约束网络下鲁棒小区间协调的有效方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predicting Viticulture Potential through an Ensemble of U-Net and a Geospatial Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Determining agricultural potential is fundamental to sustainable land management and agricultural planning. Remote sensing data is increasingly valuable as an avenue for agricultural potential due to the cost of traditional methods (surveys, in-situ measurements, soil testing, etc). ImageCLEF AI4Agri 2026: Subtask 1 is concerned with the prediction of viticulture potential in Southern France. The DS@GT ARC's submission for Subtask 1 introduces an ensemble of U-Net and a Geospatial Foundation Model (Prithvi-2.0). Our best model achieved a $\pm$1 accuracy of 68.32 on the leaderboard, ranking 2nd among 7 teams. The implementation for this work is publicly available at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/imageclef-ai4agri-2026 .
papers.comment: To be published in CLEF 2026 Working Notes

papers.title: Statistical Efficiency and Inference of Quantile Distributional Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study quantile-based distributional reinforcement learning from the perspective of statistical efficiency. We focus on distributional policy evaluation, whose goal is to characterize the return distribution, namely the distribution of discounted cumulative rewards under a given policy. To obtain a finite-dimensional representation of the return distribution, we consider the quantile fixed point $η_m$ induced by the quantile-projected distributional Bellman equation. Assuming access to a generative model, we construct an estimator $η_m^{(n)}$ based on an empirical Markov decision process. For a fixed number of quantiles $m$, we establish a non-asymptotic error bound for $η_m^{(n)}$ and $η_m$ under the supremum $W_\infty$ metric, showing that the estimation error scales as $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{m/n})$ with respect to $m$ and $n$. This implies that the quantile-based distributional policy evaluation problem can be solved with sample efficiency, achieving the optimal parametric $\sqrt{n}$ convergence rate. We derive the asymptotic distribution of the quantile parameters $\sqrt{n}(θ_m^{(n)}-θ_m)$ and characterize the semiparametric efficiency bound, which is attained by our estimator. Beyond the fixed-dimensional setting, we investigate the asymptotic regime in which the number of quantiles diverges. We characterize the limit covariance structure and show that it matches the semiparametric efficiency bound of the nonparametric model for distributional policy evaluation, showing that quantile-based estimators remain asymptotically efficient in the infinite-dimensional limit. Finally, we establish a Berry--Esseen theorem for smooth functionals $\sqrt{n}(η_m^{(n)}(s)-η_m(s))f$, thereby providing a foundation for statistically valid inference on functionals of the quantile-projected return distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从统计效率角度系统分析基于分位数的分布强化学习（distributional RL）中的策略评估问题。作者针对由分位数投影分布贝尔曼方程导出的分位数不动点，在生成模型假设下构造经验MDP估计量，并建立了非渐近误差界、渐近分布、半参数效率界以及平滑泛函的Berry-Esseen定理。理论表明分位数方法在固定和发散分位数个数下均能实现最优参数收敛速率并达到效率界。
Motivation: 分布强化学习中，基于分位数的表示方法广泛使用但缺乏严格的统计效率分析，特别是估计量的收敛速率、渐近分布及最优性尚未被充分刻画。
Method: 考虑分位数投影分布贝尔曼方程定义的分位数不动点η_m；在生成模型下，基于经验MDP构造估计量η_m^(n)；通过非渐近分析、渐近正态性证明和半参数效率界推导，系统研究固定m和m→∞时的统计性质。
Result: 对于固定m，估计误差以标度Õ(√(m/n))收敛，达到最优参数√n速率；估计量达到半参数效率界；当m发散时，极限协方差结构匹配非参数模型的半参数效率界；建立了平滑泛函的Berry-Esseen定理。
Conclusion: 分位数估计器在分布策略评估中具有最优的统计效率和可靠的推断理论基础，为分位数分布RL的实际应用提供理论支撑。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文从统计效率角度系统分析基于分位数的分布强化学习（distributional RL）中的策略评估问题。作者针对由分位数投影分布贝尔曼方程导出的分位数不动点，在生成模型假设下构造经验MDP估计量，并建立了非渐近误差界、渐近分布、半参数效率界以及平滑泛函的Berry-Esseen定理。理论表明分位数方法在固定和发散分位数个数下均能实现最优参数收敛速率并达到效率界。
summary_sections.motivation: 分布强化学习中，基于分位数的表示方法广泛使用但缺乏严格的统计效率分析，特别是估计量的收敛速率、渐近分布及最优性尚未被充分刻画。
summary_sections.method: 考虑分位数投影分布贝尔曼方程定义的分位数不动点η_m；在生成模型下，基于经验MDP构造估计量η_m^(n)；通过非渐近分析、渐近正态性证明和半参数效率界推导，系统研究固定m和m→∞时的统计性质。

summary_sections.conclusion: 分位数估计器在分布策略评估中具有最优的统计效率和可靠的推断理论基础，为分位数分布RL的实际应用提供理论支撑。

papers.title: ADORN: Adaptive Drift handling for Open RAN using Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic traffic variations in Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN) lead to drift, which degrades the performance of Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) models. Traditional retraining approaches maintain forecasting accuracy but incur high computational cost and may lead to violations of Service Level Agreements (SLAs). This work proposes a Q-learning-based adaptive retraining approach that formulates the retraining decision as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), where a Reinforcement Learning (RL) agent learns a policy that balances forecasting accuracy and retraining cost. The proposed approach incorporates a multi-expert Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) ensemble to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and improve robustness across diverse traffic conditions. Experimental results show that the proposed approach effectively reduces retraining overhead compared to greedy and random baselines, while maintaining system performance within predefined limits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放无线接入网（O-RAN）中动态流量变化导致的AI/ML模型漂移问题，提出一种基于Q-learning的自适应重训练方法。该方法将重训练决策建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），通过强化学习智能体学习平衡预测精度与重训练成本的策略，并采用多专家LSTM集成来缓解灾难性遗忘。实验结果表明，与贪婪和随机基线相比，该方法在保持系统性能在预定范围内的情况下，有效降低了重训练开销。
Motivation: O-RAN中动态流量变化导致漂移，损害AI/ML模型性能；传统重训练方法虽能维持预测精度，但计算成本高且可能违反服务等级协议（SLA）。
Method: 将重训练决策建模为MDP，使用Q-learning的RL智能体学习策略，平衡预测精度与重训练成本；集成多专家LSTM以增强模型鲁棒性并减轻灾难性遗忘。
Result: 实验表明，与贪婪和随机基线相比，所提方法在保持系统性能在预定限制内的同时，有效减少了重训练开销。
Conclusion: 该方法在O-RAN环境下自适应处理漂移，通过强化学习优化重训练时机，实现精度与成本的平衡。

papers.title: DeltaV: Thinking with Visual State Updates in Unified Large Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Current Unified Large Multimodal Models (ULMMs) support interleaved multimodal reasoning through textual reasoning and intermediate visual states, but typically generate each visual state as a full image. This full-image generation paradigm introduces substantial visual-token redundancy and dilutes supervision on sparse yet reasoning-critical state transitions. We propose DeltaV, a ULMM that replaces full-image generation with visual updates. Conditioned on historical visual states, DeltaV incrementally predicts compact update tokens that capture the visual changes across reasoning steps, avoiding repeated modeling of unchanged content. To align the token budget of each update with the magnitude of visual change, DeltaV introduces a temporal similarity (TSIM) Router, which stops allocating tokens once the marginal reconstruction gain falls below a threshold. To support more diverse and generalizable reasoning, we further construct StructCoT, a large-scale interleaved multimodal reasoning dataset with 1.05M samples spanning 44 task domains. Experiments show that the visual-update paradigm reduces newly generated visual tokens by 55.6\% on average without compromising reconstruction fidelity, and improves multimodal reasoning by 3.3\% over full-image generation. Trained with StructCoT and large-scale multimodal data, DeltaV-2B further outperforms substantially larger open-source models by 8.4\% on in-domain multimodal reasoning evaluations and surpasses the comparable-scale Qwen3-VL-2B by 5.9\% on external multimodal reasoning and understanding benchmarks. Code, models, and StructCoT will be released at https://github.com/Pengjie-W/DeltaV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeltaV，一种统一多模态大模型，用视觉更新 (visual update) 替代全图生成，仅预测推理步骤间的视觉变化，减少令牌冗余。引入 TSIM Router 根据视觉变化幅度动态分配令牌预算，并构建 105 万样本的 StructCoT 数据集。实验显示视觉更新范式减少 55.6% 的新生成视觉令牌，多模态推理提升 3.3%，DeltaV-2B 在域内评估上超越更大开源模型 8.4%，并超过 Qwen3-VL-2B 5.9%。
Motivation: 现有 ULMMs 生成全图导致大量视觉令牌冗余，且对稀疏但关键的推理状态转变监督不足。
Method: 提出 DeltaV，基于历史视觉状态增量预测紧凑更新令牌；引入 TSIM Router，当边际重建增益低于阈值时停止分配令牌；构建大规模交错多模态推理数据集 StructCoT（1.05M 样本，44 个任务域）。
Result: 视觉更新范式平均减少 55.6% 的新生成视觉令牌，多模态推理准确率提升 3.3%；DeltaV-2B 在域内评估上超越更大开源模型 8.4%，在外部基准上超越 Qwen3-VL-2B 5.9%。
Conclusion: 视觉更新范式有效降低令牌冗余并提升多模态推理性能，有望推广至更多复杂推理场景。

papers.title: Predicting Male Fertility Using Machine Learning: A Semen Parameters Based Analysis with the VISEM Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Male infertility is a significant yet often underdiagnosed aspect of reproductive health, with semen analysis serving as the cornerstone of clinical evaluation. To address this problem, this study investigates the use of machine learning algorithms to classify male fertility status based on key semen parameters, i.e., sperm concentration, motility, and morphology, using the VISEM dataset. This dataset includes semen samples from 85 participants, classified into three categories, i.e., Fertile, Sub-Fertile, and Infertile, according to the World Health Organization's criteria. After pre-processing and feature engineering, the dataset was used to train and assess multiple classification models using the LazyPredict framework. Among the more than 40 algorithms tested, the Nearest Centroid classifier achieved an accuracy of 94.2%, outperforming other models such as Support Vector Machines and Quadratic Discriminant Analysis. The model's robustness was validated using 5-fold cross-validation and multiclass ROC-AUC analysis. This study illustrates that machine learning models can provide fast, accurate, and objective assessments of semen quality, potentially supporting clinical decision-making in andrology and assisted reproductive technologies. These findings emphasize the growing potential of machine learning to enhance fertility diagnostics and inform patient-specific treatment strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用机器学习算法，基于精子浓度、活力和形态等关键精液参数，使用VISEM数据集对男性生育状态进行分类（Fertile, Sub-Fertile, Infertile）。通过LazyPredict框架测试了超过40个模型，Nearest Centroid分类器达到94.2%的准确率，并使用5折交叉验证和多分类ROC-AUC验证了鲁棒性。
Motivation: 男性不育是生殖健康中常被低估的问题，精液分析是临床评估基础，但传统方法可能不够快速和客观。本文旨在通过机器学习提供快速、准确、客观的精液质量评估。
Method: 使用VISEM数据集（85名参与者，三类生育状态），进行预处理和特征工程后，利用LazyPredict框架训练和评估多个分类模型，其中Nearest Centroid分类器表现最佳。
Result: Nearest Centroid分类器准确率达94.2%，优于支持向量机和二次判别分析等模型，并通过5折交叉验证和多分类ROC-AUC验证。
Conclusion: 研究表明机器学习模型可以提供快速、准确、客观的精液质量评估，有望支持男科和辅助生殖技术的临床决策。

papers.title: FPGN: Redefining Ultra-Fast Programmable Gate-based Neural Acceleration with Differentiable LUTs
papers.abstract_en: Achieving nanosecond-scale inference latency for deep neural networks (DNNs) has become a primary architectural concern for latency-critical applications. While Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) offer a promising substrate for low-latency inference, conventional FPGA accelerators remain arithmetic-centric, using LUTs primarily as building blocks for numerical operators and peripheral logic. In contrast, recent LUT-native neural networks treat LUTs as learnable neurons, revealing promising theoretical potential to exploit their intrinsic logic expressivity. However, existing methods are largely confined to algorithmic optimizations, failing to translate this theoretical potential into high-performance FPGA accelerators. Specifically, their differentiable formulations do not faithfully match FPGA LUT primitives, their physically-unaware topologies compromise routability and timing closure, and their lack of automated optimization flow hinders systematic design space exploration (DSE) and efficient hardware implementation. In this paper, we propose FPGN, an end-to-end physically-aware framework that closes the gap between LUT-native learning and latency-optimized FPGA implementation. FPGN addresses these challenges through (i) a hardware-aligned differentiable formulation for training FPGA-native LUT neurons, (ii) a structured LUT-native topology with a streaming hardware architecture to improve routing locality and timing closure, and (iii) a latency-driven compiler that leverages high-fidelity analytical Quality of Results models to automate DSE and hardware generation. Experiments show that FPGN achieves up to 205$\times$ latency reduction compared to representative FPGA-based BNN accelerators and up to 30$\times$ higher LUT efficiency than prior differentiable LUT-native networks, while maintaining competitive inference accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FPGN，一个端到端的物理感知框架，用于在FPGA上实现超快推理加速。通过硬件对齐的可微分公式训练LUT神经元、结构化LUT原生拓扑与流式硬件架构，以及延迟驱动的编译器自动化设计空间探索，FPGN在延迟和LUT效率上大幅优于现有FPGA加速器和可微分LUT网络。
Motivation: 现有FPGA加速器以算术为中心，未能利用LUT作为可学习神经元的潜力；而LUT原生网络缺乏高性能FPGA实现，存在公式不匹配、拓扑不可路由、缺乏自动化优化等问题。
Method: 提出FPGN框架，包含(i)硬件对齐的可微分公式训练FPGA原生LUT神经元，(ii)结构化LUT原生拓扑和流式硬件架构改善路由和时序，(iii)延迟驱动编译器利用高保真分析模型自动化设计空间探索和硬件生成。
Result: 实验表明，与代表性FPGA BNN加速器相比，延迟降低高达205倍；与先前可微分LUT原生网络相比，LUT效率提高高达30倍，同时保持有竞争力的推理精度。
Conclusion: FPGN通过物理感知的端到端框架弥合了LUT原生学习与延迟优化FPGA实现之间的差距，实现了超快推理。

papers.title: OmniFood-Bench: Evaluating VLMs for Nutrient Reasoning and Personalized Health Advice
papers.abstract_en: The rapid integration of Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) into critical infrastructure promises to revolutionize personalized healthcare and dietary management. However, in the domain of food systems, autonomous agents face a unique and persistent challenge: the "Systemic Information Asymmetry" between visual appearance and intrinsic nutritional composition. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on coarse-grained classification tasks, such as food category recognition, which fail to evaluate the intricate reasoning chain required for real-world dietary management -- specifically, the ability to traverse from identifying hidden ingredients to estimating physical mass, and finally synthesizing safety-critical medical advice. In this paper, we introduce OmniFood-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark constructed from the MM-Food-100K dataset. Unlike previous works, OmniFood-Bench evaluates VLMs across three progressive capabilities: Basic Perception (Ingredients & Cooking Methods), Quantitative Reasoning (Portion Size & Nutritional Profiling), and Safety-Critical Advisory (Disease-Specific Recommendations). We evaluate six state-of-the-art VLMs, including gpt-5.1, gemini-3-flash, and qwen3-vl-8B. Our extensive experiments reveal a startling "Semantic-Physical Gap": while models achieve near-human accuracy in naming dishes, they exhibit catastrophic failure in mass estimation and frequently hallucinate benign advice for high-risk diabetic profiles. This work establishes a rigorous standard for trustworthiness in autonomous agents deployed for public health. The code and datasets are available in: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/OmniFood-Bench-7D0B
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了OmniFood-Bench，一个用于评估大型视觉语言模型（VLM）在食品营养推理和个性化健康建议方面的综合性基准。该基准基于MM-Food-100K数据集，评估VLM的三个渐进能力：基本感知（食材与烹饪方法）、定量推理（份量大小与营养分析）和安全关键建议（疾病特定推荐）。对包括gpt-5.1、gemini-3-flash和qwen3-vl-8B在内的六个先进VLM进行实验，揭示了惊人的“语义-物理差距”：模型在菜肴命名上接近人类，但在质量估计上完全失败，并常为高风险糖尿病用户产生良性建议的幻觉。该工作为公共卫生领域的自主代理建立了可信度标准。
Motivation: 现有的食品相关基准主要集中在粗粒度分类任务（如食物类别识别），无法评估从隐藏食材识别到物理质量估计再到综合医疗建议的复杂推理链，这一能力对于真实世界的饮食管理至关重要。
Method: 构建OmniFood-Bench基准，设计三个渐进评估层次：基本感知（食材和烹饪方法）、定量推理（份量大小和营养成分）以及安全关键建议（疾病特定推荐）。评估了六个当前先进的VLM模型，包括gpt-5.1、gemini-3-flash和qwen3-vl-8B。
Result: 实验表明，VLM在菜肴命名上接近人类准确率，但在质量估计方面出现灾难性失败，并且经常为高风险的糖尿病用户推荐良性建议，揭示了“语义-物理差距”。
Conclusion: OmniFood-Bench为评估自主代理在公共卫生领域的可信度建立了严格标准，强调了当前VLM在食品营养推理和安全建议方面的严重不足。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有的食品相关基准主要集中在粗粒度分类任务（如食物类别识别），无法评估从隐藏食材识别到物理质量估计再到综合医疗建议的复杂推理链，这一能力对于真实世界的饮食管理至关重要。
summary_sections.method: 构建OmniFood-Bench基准，设计三个渐进评估层次：基本感知（食材和烹饪方法）、定量推理（份量大小和营养成分）以及安全关键建议（疾病特定推荐）。评估了六个当前先进的VLM模型，包括gpt-5.1、gemini-3-flash和qwen3-vl-8B。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明，VLM在菜肴命名上接近人类准确率，但在质量估计方面出现灾难性失败，并且经常为高风险的糖尿病用户推荐良性建议，揭示了“语义-物理差距”。
summary_sections.conclusion: OmniFood-Bench为评估自主代理在公共卫生领域的可信度建立了严格标准，强调了当前VLM在食品营养推理和安全建议方面的严重不足。

papers.title: When Synthetic Speech Is All You Have: Better Call GRPO
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based ASR adapted to regulated domains such as banking is bottlenecked by privacy: real speech is costly and legally constrained to collect, making synthetic text-to-speech (TTS) an attractive substitute. Yet synthetic speech stays acoustically mismatched with real recordings, and work on this gap has stayed within supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We instead turn to reinforcement learning, and show that Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) extracts far more from the same synthetic speech than SFT. Synthetic-only adaptation of the model with GRPO, a critic-free method rewarding low-WER hypotheses, reduces WER by 40\% relative to SFT (36.71\%$\to$22.09\%), and an SFT-then-GRPO combination pushes this further to 45\%. We trace the gain to behavior rather than representation: GRPO reduces insertion errors by improving stopping calibration and speech-to-text alignment by better anchoring attention to audio, leaving early-layer representations intact. When synthetic speech is the main resource, reinforcement learning should be preferred over supervised fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM语音识别（ASR）在银行等受监管领域因隐私限制而使用合成语音训练的问题，提出采用强化学习方法GRPO替代监督微调（SFT）。实验表明，GRPO仅用合成语音即可相对降低40%的词错误率（WER），且SFT+GRPO联合训练可进一步降低45%。收益主要来自行为改进：GRPO优化了停止校准和语音-文本对齐，而非改变早期层表征。
Motivation: 现有基于合成语音的ASR适应方法局限于监督微调，但合成语音与真实语音存在声学失配，性能受限。
Method: 采用Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 进行强化学习，无需批评网络，奖励低WER假设；与SFT结合形成两阶段训练。
Result: 合成语音适应下，GRPO相比SFT使WER从36.71%降至22.09%（相对降低40%），SFT+GRPO组合进一步降低45%。
Conclusion: 在合成语音为主要资源时，强化学习（GRPO）优于监督微调，性能提升源于行为改进（校准和注意力对齐）。

papers.title: Track2Map: Online Deformable SLAM with Motion-Aware Pose Optimization in Robotic Surgery
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian splatting is the current state-of-the-art for dense, deformable 3D anatomy reconstruction in robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS); however, most pipelines are offline and depend on accurate camera trajectory priors (often from robotic kinematics), limiting applicability when priors are missing or noisy. To address these limitations, we propose Track2Map, an online 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline that jointly optimizes camera trajectory and 3D deformable scene representation directly from surgical video. Track2Map is therefore capable of robust 3D reconstructions when camera trajectory priors are either absent or noisy, and due to its online nature it effectively works as a Simultaneous Localisation and Mapping (SLAM) method. To stabilize optimization in the presence of tissue motion and ambiguous visual cues, we introduce a track-anchored deformation initialization using dense 2D point tracks. Track statistics are further utilized to disentangle camera motion from scene deformation by detecting static camera periods and reducing drift during incremental mapping. Experiments on StereoMIS show improved reconstruction quality and camera trajectory against competing SLAM methods, as well as compared to non-SLAM methods that utilize camera trajectory priors. The code is available at https://track2map.github.io/.
papers.comment: Accepted at MICCAI 2026. This is the submitted version prior to peer review. The final authenticated version will be available on SpringerLink
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Track2Map，一个基于3D高斯泼溅的在线可变形SLAM管道，用于机器人辅助微创手术中的3D重建。它联合优化相机轨迹和可变形场景表示，无需准确的相机轨迹先验，通过密集2D点轨迹锚定变形初始化，并利用轨迹统计区分相机运动和场景变形。在StereoMIS数据集上，该方法在重建质量和相机轨迹准确度上优于竞争SLAM方法及使用先验的非SLAM方法。
Motivation: 现有可变形3D重建方法多为离线，依赖准确的相机轨迹先验（如机器人运动学），在先验缺失或噪声时受限。需要一种在线方法能够直接从未处理视频中鲁棒地同时估计相机轨迹和可变形场景。
Method: 提出在线3D高斯泼溅管道，联合优化相机轨迹和3D变形场景。引入track-anchored变形初始化，使用密集2D点轨迹；利用轨迹统计检测静态相机周期以减少漂移，并解耦相机运动和场景变形。
Result: 在StereoMIS数据集上，Track2Map在重建质量和相机轨迹准确度上优于竞争SLAM方法，以及使用相机轨迹先验的非SLAM方法。
Conclusion: Track2Map实现了无需先验的在线可变形SLAM，适用于手术场景，代码已公开。

papers.title: Beyond Backpropagation: Monte Carlo Method Can Train Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Backpropagation (BP) dominates deep learning training, but its reliance on gradients brings inherent troubles -- vanishing and exploding gradients. The pursuit of gradient-free methods has long been a goal in the field of artificial intelligence. This paper shows that indeed the simplest Monte Carlo algorithm implemented on a single GPU -- randomly mutate a parameter, keep it if the loss decreases, otherwise retry -- can practically train deep networks. This gradient-free method does not even need common techniques such as batch normalization or residual connections to directly train sufficiently deep networks. More remarkably, its flexibility extends to several nontrivial scenarios: it enables pure pruning training, supports discrete weights, accommodates unconventional transfer functions such as Gaussian, and reveals the substantial redundancy of deep networks. We have demonstrated its feasibility on deep networks with more than 20 layers, single-hidden-layer wide networks with up to 16,384 hidden neurons, and even a simple Transformer architecture trained on both image classification (MNIST) and character-level language modeling (Tiny Shakespeare). This simple gradient-free method may offer a complementary perspective for understanding the self-organization and learning mechanisms of neural networks, and also provides an alternative route for building physically inspired deep learning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明最简单的蒙特卡洛算法——随机突变一个参数，如果损失减小则保留，否则重试——可以实际训练深度网络，无需梯度。该方法不依赖批归一化或残差连接，能直接训练足够深的网络。其灵活性包括纯剪枝训练、支持离散权重、适应非常规传递函数（如高斯），并揭示深度网络的冗余性。在20层以上深度网络、单隐层宽网络（16384个隐神经元）以及简单Transformer架构（MNIST图像分类和字符级语言建模）上得到验证。
Motivation: 反向传播依赖梯度带来固有的梯度消失和爆炸问题，无梯度方法一直是追求的目标。
Method: 最简单的蒙特卡洛算法：随机突变一个参数，若损失下降则保留，否则重试。
Result: 在20层以上深度网络、单隐层宽网络（16384隐神经元）以及简单Transformer（MNIST和Tiny Shakespeare）上可行。无需批归一化或残差连接。
Conclusion: 该无梯度方法为理解神经网络的自我组织和学习机制提供了补充视角，也为构建物理启发的深度学习系统提供了替代路径。

papers.title: DrugGen 2: A disease-aware language model for enhancing drug discovery
papers.abstract_en: Current computational approaches for drug design typically focus on generating molecules conditioned on specific targets or general molecular properties, often neglecting the influence of disease context on target behavior and therapeutic outcomes. To address this gap, we introduce DrugGen-2, a novel generative model that designs small molecules conditioned on both disease ontology and target protein sequences. DrugGen-2 was developed by fine-tuning a pre-trained GPT-2 model on a curated dataset of approved drugs linked to their diseases and targets, using a two-step strategy of supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning via group relative policy optimization (GRPO). This process was guided by reward functions optimizing for chemical validity, novelty, diversity, and high predicted binding affinity. When evaluated on five protein targets relevant to diabetic nephropathy, DrugGen-2 significantly outperformed baseline models (DrugGPT and DrugGen). It demonstrated a superior capacity to generate unique molecules, exhibited greater structural similarity to approved drugs, and achieved improved predicted binding affinities across all targets. Molecular docking analyses further supported these findings, identifying candidate ligands with strong binding potential, including compounds with predicted affinities (-9.917, -9.485, and -9.367) exceeding those of reference drugs such as enalapril for angiotensin-converting enzyme (-8.283). By integrating disease-specific context into molecular generation, DrugGen-2 advances AI-assisted drug discovery, offering a powerful tool for de novo design and drug repurposing that accounts for the complex interplay between diseases and molecular targets.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 1 table, and 4 supplementary files. To use the model, see https://github.com/alimotahharynia/DrugGen-2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DrugGen-2 是一个基于 GPT-2 微调的小分子生成模型，条件输入包括疾病本体和靶点蛋白序列。通过监督微调和基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习两步训练，该模型针对糖尿病肾病相关靶点生成分子，在结构相似性、新颖性和预测结合亲和力上优于基线模型 DrugGPT 和 DrugGen。分子对接验证了其生成物具有强结合潜力。
Motivation: 现有药物设计方法通常仅基于靶点或分子性质生成分子，忽略了疾病上下文对靶点行为和疗效的影响，导致生成的分子可能缺乏疾病特异性。
Method: 在经筛选的已上市药物-疾病-靶点数据集上微调预训练 GPT-2，先进行监督微调，再使用基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习，优化化学有效性、新颖性、多样性和高预测结合亲和力的奖励函数。
Result: 在糖尿病肾病的五个蛋白靶点上，DrugGen-2 生成分子的独特性、与已上市药物的结构相似度以及预测结合亲和力均显著优于 DrugGPT 和 DrugGen。分子对接显示候选配体的结合能（如-9.917）超过参考药物依那普利（-8.283）。
Conclusion: 通过整合疾病特异性上下文，DrugGen-2 提升了 AI 辅助药物发现的能力，可用于从头设计和药物重定位，考虑了疾病与分子靶点的复杂相互作用。

papers.title: Game Theory Driven Multi-Agent Framework Mitigates Language Model Hallucination
papers.abstract_en: The application of lightweight Large Language Models in rule-based scientific domains remains severely limited by their tendency to mimic linguistic patterns rather than reproduce axiomatic reasoning, causing frequent hallucinations. Here, we show that G-Frame, an adaptive multi-agent framework integrating Bayesian and team game principles, establishes an automated closed-loop for high-quality data synthesis and model training. By forcing the internalization of domain constraints through structured reasoning, we synthesized a specialized corpus of 363,045 chains-of-thought and 199,589 question-answer pairs. The resulting 7B model OmniChem achieves performance parity with GPT 4o mini on custom benchmarks and ChemBench while exhibiting a 79.46% reduction in hallucinations relative to its base architecture. We further demonstrate the advanced capabilities of OmniChem in molecular design and synthesis planning. This work establishes a scalable paradigm utilizing adaptive multi-agents to overcome inherent reasoning deficiencies, offering a feasible pathway for accelerating knowledge discovery in specialized scientific fields.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出G-Frame，一种结合贝叶斯和团队博弈原理的自适应多智能体框架，用于自动合成高质量数据并训练轻量级LLM。在化学领域，合成了363,045条思维链和199,589个问答对，训练出的7B模型OmniChem在定制基准和ChemBench上达到GPT-4o mini的性能，并相对于基础架构减少了79.46%的幻觉。还展示了在分子设计和合成规划中的高级能力。
Motivation: 轻量级LLM在基于规则的科学领域受限于模仿语言模式而非公理推理，导致频繁的幻觉。需要一种方法强制模型内化领域约束。
Method: 提出G-Frame多智能体框架，集成贝叶斯和团队博弈原理，实现自动化闭环进行高质量数据合成和模型训练。通过结构化推理强制内化领域约束。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了利用自适应多智能体克服推理缺陷的可扩展范式，为加速科学领域知识发现提供了可行路径。

papers.title: Swapping Faces, Saving Features: A Dual-Purpose Pipeline for Pedestrian Privacy in ITS
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale and diverse datasets are needed to train AI models to take real-time decisions for autonomous vehicles (AVs), an intelligent transportation system (ITS) application. Pedestrian intention and trajectory prediction are critical models used in AVs, requiring datasets involving diverse pedestrian images. Unrestricted access to these datasets imposes serious security risks, like identity theft and pedestrian tracking. The challenge is to apply privacy preservation procedures while maintaining the image attributes needed to train the models. Existing privacy methods may preserve the pedestrian's privacy, but degrade the image usability, which hinders the models' effectiveness. This work's focus is to implement a five-stage pipeline to protect pedestrians' privacy through face swapping while keeping the essential facial attributes intact. It should be tailored to satisfy the privacy needs of the Egy-DRiVeS dataset. Moreover, Roop and Ghost-v2 face-swapping models are evaluated. Provenly, Roop outperforms Ghost-v2 in various aspects, as will be discussed. Consequently, Roop is the face-swapping model to be used in the pipeline to strike the balance between pedestrian privacy via identity concealment and data usability via facial attribute preservation.

papers.title: TRACE: A Two-Channel Robust Attribution Watermark via Complementary Embeddings for LLM-Agent Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents reach users through resellers, who may rebrand a developer's agent or substitute a cheaper model. When provenance is disputed, attribution rests on the trajectory log (the record of tool calls, observations, and executed actions, not the model's reasoning), which the reseller stores and processes to meter usage. A watermark must therefore survive an adversary with full read/write access to the very evidence it is detected from; existing agent watermarks do not, as their attribution is read straight off that log. We present TRACE, to our knowledge the first agent watermark that is distortion-free in its action choices, self-synchronizing under deletion, and unconditionally invariant under rewriting. Deletion desynchronizes a position-derived key and rewriting alters content, so a deletion-robust key must come from content and a rewrite-robust key from position, and no single key serves both. A trajectory, however, has room for two watermarks. TRACE superposes a selection channel that sets which action is chosen, keyed on local content with a distortion-free sampler, so the agent's distribution is provably unchanged and detection resynchronizes after deletions, and a tally channel that sets how many records each decision group holds, keyed on the log's skeleton alone, which no rewriting can touch. We prove this behavioral watermark's signal is bought with decision entropy, each decision paying at least half its entropy and deterministic decisions nothing, and that erasing both channels forces the reseller to corrupt the trajectories it resells. On ToolBench and ALFWorld, TRACE matches the unwatermarked agent's success rate while its selection channel reaches detection scores near z = 100 on long-horizon trajectories, stays detectable under 70% step deletion, and keeps a tally channel exactly unchanged under LLM rewriting of any strength.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE，一种针对LLM代理轨迹（trajectory）的鲁棒水印方法，旨在防止经销商（reseller）篡改或替换模型后否认来源。TRACE通过叠加两个互补通道——基于内容的选择通道（selection channel）和基于位置/骨架的计数通道（tally channel）——实现无失真、自同步且对重写不变的水印。实验在ToolBench和ALFWorld上表明，TRACE在保持与无痕代理相同成功率的同时，选择通道在长轨迹上检测得分接近z=100，且在70%步骤删除下仍可检测，计数通道对任意强度的LLM重写完全不变。
Motivation: 现有代理水印缺乏鲁棒性：经销商可完全读写轨迹日志，现有水印直接嵌入日志中易被删除或篡改；而删除和重写分别破坏位置派生键和内容，单一水印无法同时应对两种攻击。
Method: TRACE叠加两个水印通道：选择通道基于局部内容（content）键控，使用无失真采样器决定选择哪个动作，保证代理分布不变且在删除后自同步；计数通道仅基于日志骨架（skeleton）键控，通过决策组的记录计数嵌入，对重写免疫。
Result: 在ToolBench和ALFWorld上，TRACE的无痕代理成功率未见下降；选择通道在长轨迹上检测得分接近z=100，70%步骤删除后仍可检测；计数通道在任意强度LLM重写下保持不变。
Conclusion: TRACE是首个在动作选择上无失真、对删除自同步、对重写条件不变的代理水印；水印信号需以决策熵为代价，确定性决策无法嵌入，且擦除两个通道会迫使经销商破坏轨迹。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prompt Compression via Activation Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models process prompts by propagating activations through dozens of layers before generating a response. We ask whether the task-relevant information contained in an instruction prompt can be compressed into a single activation vector and re-injected into the model, replacing the original token sequence? We show this is achievable using a learned weighted sum of activations extracted at an intermediate layer and injected at an early layer of the target LLM. The compressed vector preserves task-relevant information, incurring an accuracy drop of under $2\%$ relative to full prompt processing. Beyond its practical implications, including reducing per-query computation for fixed instruction prompts without reprocessing the original token sequence, our analysis reveals structure in the activation space of LLMs: (i) mid-layer representations transfer meaningfully to early layers, suggesting a degree of cross-layer compatibility in how information is encoded; (ii) a single activation vector encodes a quantifiable and recoverable amount of semantic information; (iii) a weighted sum of activations is a robust representation compressor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通过激活聚合（activation aggregation）压缩提示的方法：从大语言模型的中间层提取激活，加权求和后注入早期层，替代原始token序列。实验表明该方法在固定指令提示上精度损失低于2%，并揭示了LLM激活空间的结构特性。
Motivation: 处理固定指令提示时，每次查询都需重新传播整个提示的激活，计算开销大。本文尝试将提示压缩为单个激活向量并重注入模型，以减少冗余计算。
Method: 学习一个加权的激活和（weighted sum），从目标LLM的中间层提取激活，注入到早期层，从而压缩提示信息。
Result: 相对于完整提示处理，精度下降低于2%；压缩向量保留了任务相关信息。
Conclusion: LLM的中间层表示可以有意义地迁移到早期层，单个激活向量能编码可量化的语义信息，加权和是一种鲁棒的表示压缩器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HoloTetSphere: Unified TetSphere Mesh Reconstruction for Physical Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Standard pipelines for physics-ready 3D reconstruction rely on a decoupled two-stage paradigm: extracting surface geometry followed by an error-prone tetrahedralization process. While recent Lagrangian methods like TetSphere Splatting attempt to bypass this by directly optimizing volumetric primitives, their homeomorphic constraints prevent topology-adaptive optimization. Consequently, they produce disjoint tetrahedra rather than a single connected mesh, rendering the structures unsuitable for further physical simulations. To address this, we propose a topology-adaptive framework for holistic tetrahedral mesh reconstruction through end-to-end topological and geometric optimization. First, by coupling Gaussian spheres to tetrahedral elements and leveraging edge connections, we estimate a continuous opacity field for differentiable element pruning. Next, jointly minimizing mesh smoothing energy and multi-view Gaussian rendering error drives alternating geometric refinement while preserving topological adaptivity. Consequently, our approach effectively constructs a unified and topologically coherent tetrahedral mesh. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art techniques by achieving superior geometric accuracy and producing coherent, single-connected tetrahedral meshes, thereby effectively bypassing the error-prone conventional tetrahedralization step for reconstructed surface meshes and streamlining downstream physical simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种拓扑自适应的四面体网格重建框架HoloTetSphere，通过端到端的拓扑与几何优化，从多视图图像直接生成统一且拓扑一致的四面体网格。该方法将高斯球与四面体元素耦合，利用边连接估计连续透明度场进行可微分元素修剪，并联合最小化网格平滑能量与多视图高斯渲染误差进行交替几何优化。实验表明，该方法在几何精度和生成单一连通四面体网格方面优于现有技术，有效绕过了传统表面重建后四面体化步骤的误差，简化了下游物理模拟。
Motivation: 现有物理仿真就绪的三维重建流程通常采用解耦的两阶段范式（表面几何提取后四面体化），该过程容易出错；而最近的拉格朗日方法如TetSphere Splatting因同胚约束无法进行拓扑自适应优化，生成不连通的分片四面体，不适合物理模拟。
Method: 通过耦合高斯球与四面体元素并利用边连接估计连续透明度场，实现可微分元素修剪；联合最小化网格平滑能量与多视图高斯渲染误差，进行交替几何优化，同时保持拓扑自适应性。
Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在几何精度和生成单一连通四面体网格方面优于现有技术，有效绕过了传统四面体化步骤的误差，简化了下游物理模拟。
Conclusion: 本文提出的拓扑自适应框架能够生成统一且拓扑一致的四面体网格，适用于物理模拟，避免了传统两阶段方法的误差累积。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Attribute Retrieving for Open-Vocabulary Endoscopic Compositional Referring Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Referring Image Segmentation (RIS) aims to segment image regions specified by natural language, enabling fine-grained and controllable visual understanding. Extending RIS to endoscopic imagery, however, presents unique challenges, including scarce high-quality annotations and complex, domain-specific image-text relationships. Although recent vision-language models demonstrate strong cross-domain alignment, they often fail to capture fine-grained textual cues in endoscopic settings, resulting in suboptimal performance and limited generalization. To address these challenges, we introduce ReferEndoscopy, a large-scale benchmark for RIS in the endoscopy field. Building on this dataset, we propose the Attribute Retrieval-based Endoscopic-RIS (AR-ERIS) framework for open-vocabulary endoscopic compositional referring segmentation. AR-ERIS leverages attribute retrieval for open-vocabulary endoscopic compositional referring segmentation and is pretrained on the curated ReferEndoscopy dataset, achieving state-of-the-art performance with strong generalization across both simulated and real-world endoscopic data. The dataset and code will be publicly released upon completion of the review process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用于开放词汇内窥镜组合式指代分割的属性检索框架（AR-ERIS），并构建了大规模基准数据集ReferEndoscopy。该方法通过属性检索增强视觉-语言模型对细粒度文本线索的捕捉能力，在模拟和真实内窥镜数据上达到当前最优性能。
Motivation: 指代图像分割（RIS）扩展到内窥镜领域面临标注稀缺、领域特定图文关系复杂等挑战，现有视觉-语言模型难以捕捉内窥镜场景中的细粒度文本线索，导致性能不佳且泛化有限。
Method: 提出属性检索增强的内窥镜指代分割框架（AR-ERIS），在构建的ReferEndoscopy数据集上预训练，利用属性检索实现开放词汇的组合式指代分割。
Result: 在模拟和真实内窥镜数据上取得当前最佳性能，并展现了强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 属性检索策略有效提升了内窥镜指代分割的细粒度理解与泛化能力，相关数据集和代码将在评审完成后公开。

papers.title: Towards Mechanistically Understanding Why Memorized Knowledge Fails to Generalize in Large Language Model Finetuning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning LLMs to inject new knowledge faces a critical challenge: LLMs can quickly memorize new facts, yet fail to use them for downstream reasoning tasks. We formalize this failure as the \textit{\textbf{Knowing--Using Gap}}, characterized by an accuracy gap and a temporal lag between memorization and generalization. To understand this phenomenon, we fine-tune LLMs with unseen knowledge and monitor the spatial permeation dynamics of the knowledge internally using a novel intervention technique called self-patching. Self-patching identifies activation locations where relocating representations substantially improves failed generalization cases. These results are consistent with a knowledge-circuit misalignment hypothesis: memorized representations can exist internally but may not be routed to computation-effective layers. To demonstrate the practicality of this diagnostic finding, we design a simple heuristic strategy which recovers 58--75\% of the oracle headroom in generalization failure. Experiments are done cross-domain for the robustness of this finding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文研究大语言模型微调中注入新知识时，模型能快速记忆却无法用于下游推理任务的“Knowing-Using Gap”现象。作者通过 self-patching 干预技术分析知识内部表征的渗透动态，发现知识电路错位假设：记忆表征虽已存在但未路由到计算有效层。基于此诊断设计的启发式策略可恢复 58-75% 的泛化性能下降。
Motivation: 微调 LLM 注入新知识时，模型能快速记忆事实但无法在推理任务中泛化，这种记忆与使用的鸿沟限制了知识编辑的实际应用，亟需理解其内部机制。
Method: 提出 self-patching 干预技术，通过定位激活位置并迁移表征来改善泛化失败案例，从而监测知识的内部分布动态，验证知识电路错位假设。
Result: self-patching 识别出关键激活位置，基于此设计的启发式策略在跨领域实验中恢复了 58-75% 的泛化性能损失。
Conclusion: 知识电路错位（记忆表征未路由到计算有效层）是导致知识无法泛化的主要原因，该诊断为知识编辑提供了可操作的优化方向。

summary_sections.method: 提出 self-patching 干预技术，通过定位激活位置并迁移表征来改善泛化失败案例，从而监测知识的内部分布动态，验证知识电路错位假设。

papers.title: Joint Discrete-Continuous Flow Matching for Open-Vocabulary Inverse Design of Multilayer Optical Coatings
papers.abstract_en: Amortized neural inverse design typically remains closed-world: component choices are fixed vocabulary tokens, coordinate grids are frozen at training time, and continuous variables are discretized into sequence tokens. Multilayer optical coatings are an industrially important instance, coupling material sequence, layer thickness and wavelength-dependent response. We present IrisFlow, a query-based, open-vocabulary flow-matching framework instantiated in coatings: the target reflectance/transmittance spectrum, wavelength grid, candidate-material optical constants and layer count are supplied at query time. Candidate materials enter as wavelength-aware optical tokens rather than learned identities; material sequences are sampled by discrete flow matching over the query's candidate bank, thicknesses by continuous flow matching without discretization. A single 136M-parameter model designs 2-100-layer stacks. Across a 224-task benchmark it reconstructs in-distribution targets faithfully and retains same-order accuracy on a 15-material held-out bank without retraining; it reconstructs bands up to 1100 nm beyond its training envelope, designs against analytic application specifications and outperforms an autoregressive baseline on that baseline's material library. With optical constants calibrated to our deposition process, IrisFlow designs four color-displaying coolers, fabricated by ion-assisted evaporation: the three chromatic devices reach a CIEDE2000 color error of 3.1-5.2 while retaining 93-95% solar near-infrared reflectance, demonstrating open-vocabulary design carried through to fabricated coatings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IrisFlow，一种基于查询的开放词汇流匹配框架，用于多层光学涂层的逆设计。框架在查询时接收目标光谱、波长网格、候选材料光学常数和层数，通过离散流匹配采样材料序列、连续流匹配采样厚度，无需预定义词汇或离散化。单个 136M 参数的模型可设计 2-100 层堆叠，在 224 任务基准上忠实重建分布内目标，并能在不重训练的情况下以相同精度泛化到 15 种保留材料库。实验通过离子辅助蒸发制造了四种彩色显示器，颜色误差为 3.1-5.2，同时保持 93-95% 的太阳近红外反射率。
Motivation: 现有摊销神经网络逆设计通常局限于封闭世界：组件选择为固定词汇标记，坐标网格在训练时冻结，连续变量被离散化为序列标记。多层光学涂层需要联合考虑材料序列、层厚度和波长依赖响应，但缺乏开放词汇的灵活设计方法。
Method: IrisFlow 采用查询驱动的流匹配：候选材料以波长感知的光学标记而非学习身份嵌入；材料序列通过离散流匹配从查询的候选库中采样，厚度通过连续流匹配而不离散化。模型参数为 136M，可处理 2-100 层堆叠。
Result: 在 224 任务基准上，IrisFlow 忠实重建分布内目标，并在 15 种保留材料库上保持相同精度，无需重新训练。它能重建超出训练范围 1100nm 的波段，并根据分析应用规格进行设计，在基准的材料库上优于自回归基线。制造的四款彩色显示器中，三款色度器的 CIEDE2000 颜色误差为 3.1-5.2，同时保持 93-95% 的太阳近红外反射率。
Conclusion: IrisFlow 展示了从模拟到制造的开放词汇设计路径，能够处理训练时未见过的材料和光谱范围，在多层光学涂层逆设计中具有实用价值。

papers.title: On Exploring Input Resolution Scaling For Anytime LiDAR Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Making tradeoffs between execution latency and result utility (i.e., anytime computing) for adapting to dynamic operational requirements has been shown to enhance the performance of cyber-physical systems. In this work, we focus on enabling anytime computing for deep neural networks (DNNs) that process LiDAR point clouds for 3D object detection. We propose a novel method that enables multi-resolution inference for models that process point clouds as pillars or voxels, allowing the input to be dynamically scaled and processed at the resolution needed to meet timing requirements. Importantly, our memory-efficient approach requires the deployment of only a single DNN model, avoiding the need to deploy multiple models, each trained for a different input resolution. We also introduce a deadline-aware scheduler that selects the highest possible resolution for any given input by accurately predicting the execution time for all possible resolutions at runtime, which is challenging due to the irregularity of LiDAR point clouds. Experimental results on the nuScenes autonomous driving dataset demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing anytime computing approaches for LiDAR object detection. Finally, we deploy our approach in a simulated autonomous driving system, where it consistently enables collision-free navigation while avoiding unnecessary stalls caused by environmental complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的方法，使基于pillar或voxel处理LiDAR点云的3D目标检测深度神经网络能够进行多分辨率推理，从而支持任意时间计算（anytime computing）。该方法仅需部署单个模型，即可动态调整输入分辨率以满足时序要求，并引入一个截止时间感知调度器，通过准确预测不同分辨率的执行时间，为每个输入选择最高可能的分辨率。在nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著优于现有的LiDAR目标检测任意时间计算方法。最后，在模拟自动驾驶系统中，该方法能够实现无碰撞导航，同时避免因环境复杂性导致的不必要停顿。
Motivation: 在动态运行环境中，需要在执行延迟和结果效用之间进行权衡（即任意时间计算），以提升信息物理系统的性能。现有方法通常需要部署多个不同分辨率的模型，内存开销大，且难以处理LiDAR点云的不规则性导致的执行时间预测困难。
Method: 提出一种内存高效的多分辨率推理方法，只需训练一个网络，通过动态缩放输入点云的pillar或voxel分辨率来适应时序需求。同时设计了一个截止时间感知调度器，在线预测不同分辨率下的执行时间，从而选择最高可行分辨率。
Result: 在nuScenes数据集上，该方法在任意时间计算性能上显著优于现有基线。在模拟自动驾驶系统中，实现了无碰撞导航，并避免了不必要停顿。
Conclusion: 该方法证明了单模型多分辨率推理在LiDAR目标检测中的有效性，能够灵活适应动态时序要求，且内存开销低。限制可能包括对点云稀疏性和传感器配置的敏感性，但摘要未明确说明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revisiting One-Zero and Two-Zero Neutrino Mass Textures in Light of Recent Oscillation and Cosmological Data
papers.abstract_en: We revisit one-zero and two-zero textures of the neutrino mass matrix under current experimental and cosmological constraints. We identify the phenomenologically viable texture structures using the latest results on neutrino oscillation parameters, the cosmological bound on the sum of neutrino masses, the kinematic bound on the effective electron-neutrino mass, and limits from neutrinoless double-beta decay. For two-zero textures, several structures are still allowed if only the CMB bound on the neutrino mass sum is imposed. Among them, the $B$-series textures show a characteristic prediction for the Dirac CP phase, with $δ_{\rm CP}$ lying around $π/2$ and $3π/2$, and are within the reach of future neutrinoless double-beta decay searches. When the stronger CMB+BAO constraint is included, however, only the $A$-series textures remain viable. Therefore, we also analyze one-zero textures by using machine learning techniques, particularly flow matching. It turns out that some of the texture structures are already excluded by current data, while the allowed ones give distinct predictions for $\sum_i m_i$, $m_{ν_e}^{\rm eff}$, $\langle m_{ee}\rangle$, and $δ_{\rm CP}$. We further discuss how the one-zero texture structures can arise from non-invertible selection rules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于最新中微子振荡数据和宇宙学约束，重新审视中微子质量矩阵的一零和双零纹理。作者识别出可行的纹理结构，并指出双零纹理中的B系列对Dirac CP相位有特征预测，而更强的CMB+BAO约束下只有A系列可行。对于一零纹理，使用流匹配（flow matching）机器学习技术进行分析，区分了已排除和允许的结构，并讨论了非可逆选择规则如何产生一零纹理。
Motivation: 现有中微子质量纹理研究可能未充分利用最新的振荡数据和宇宙学约束（如中微子质量和的CMB边界），需要重新评估哪些纹理结构仍然允许。
Method: 对双零纹理，基于最新振荡参数、中微子质量和、有效电子中微子质量和无中微子双贝塔衰变边界进行扫描；对一零纹理，采用流匹配（flow matching）机器学习技术进行参数空间探索。
Result: 双零纹理中，仅用CMB边界时B系列仍允许且预测δ_CP≈π/2或3π/2，但加入BAO后只有A系列可行。一零纹理中部分结构已被数据排除，允许的结构对Σm_i、m_{ν_e}^{eff}、⟨m_{ee}⟩和δ_CP有不同预测。
Conclusion: 作者强调未来无中微子双贝塔衰变实验有望检验B系列纹理，而一零纹理可以通过非可逆选择规则解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dynamics of Gradient Descent with Large Step Size Near a Manifold of Flat Minima
papers.abstract_en: An important quantity in the theory of gradient descent (GD) is the \emph{sharpness}, defined as the largest eigenvalue of the objective Hessian. Classical analyses typically require the step size to be uniformly smaller than twice the reciprocal of the sharpness, but this condition is frequently violated in the training of deep neural networks. Recent work bridges this gap in the setting of overparametrised least-squares with a \emph{single scalar output}, providing a normal form for large-step GD in a neighbourhood of an \emph{isolated} flat minimum and establishing three corresponding convergence results. In this paper, we extend this theory in two directions: (1) to overparametrised least-squares with \emph{vector-valued outputs} (including regression with arbitrarily many observations), and (2) to a neighbourhood of a \emph{manifold} of flat minima (which we show is essential for applications such as matrix factorisation). We generalise both the normal form and all three convergence theorems of \cite{macdonaldeos} to this broader setting, overcoming several technical challenges, including the solution of a singular partial differential equation via a novel method that may be of independent interest. We further show that our framework applies to deep matrix factorisation under mild assumptions, yielding several new structural results. In particular, we prove that the set of flat minima forms a fibre bundle over a product of spheres, and that the sharpness is Morse-Bott along this manifold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了关于大步长梯度下降（GD）在平坦极小值附近动力学的理论，从单一标量输出的过参数化最小二乘推广到向量值输出，并且从孤立平坦极小值推广到平坦极小值流形。作者克服了包括奇异偏微分方程求解在内的技术挑战，并展示了该框架在深度矩阵分解中的应用，得到了一些新的结构结果。
Motivation: 经典梯度下降分析要求步长小于2/锐度，但深度神经网络训练中常违反此条件。已有工作填补了过参数化最小二乘中孤立平坦极小值附近大步长GD的空白，但仅限于单一标量输出和孤立极小值。本文旨在推广到更一般的情形。
Method: 通过推广正常形式（normal form）和三个收敛定理，解决奇异偏微分方程，将理论扩展到向量值输出和流形上的平坦极小值。
Result: 扩展了理论，并证明深度矩阵分解中平坦极小值集合形成球面积上的纤维丛，且锐度沿该流形是Morse-Bott的。
Conclusion: 本文为大步长GD在平坦极小值流形附近的动力学提供了更一般的理论，并有望在矩阵分解等应用中发挥作用。

papers.title: Classical versus Deep Mirror-Symmetry Scoring: A Benchmark of Thirteen Methods
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying how mirror-symmetric an image is about a given axis (symmetry scoring) underpins applications from visual aesthetics to medical imaging, yet proposed scoring methods have never been compared on a common, statistically grounded protocol. We benchmark 13 scoring methods (nine collected from literature, four introduced here) spanning from classical features to frozen deep features, across four single-axis and five multi-axis datasets under a reflection-exact protocol with a chance-anchored, significance-tested discrimination skill. Deep backbones perform best on single-axis and harder multi-axis protocols. However, a classical histogram-of-oriented-gradients (HOG) descriptor trails the best frozen-network readout by a small (but significant) margin, is not statistically separable from the runner-up (a CNN-filter measure), and runs ~300x faster on CPU. Our results show that discrimination concentrates in mid-scale oriented features, where deep backbones peak at a low or mid stage, and HOG peaks at a mid cell size. Among existing methods, frozen deep features thus offer little over a tuned classical descriptor for measuring symmetry; whether task-trained deep scorers can do better remains open. We release the scorers and harness in imgsym, an open toolkit for image symmetry detection and measurement.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对13种镜像对称评分方法进行了基准测试，涵盖经典特征和冻结深度特征，使用反射精确协议和基于机会锚定的显著性检验。结果表明，深度骨干在单轴和难多轴协议上表现最佳，但经典HOG描述符与最佳冻结网络读数差距很小（但显著），且速度约快300倍。判别能力集中在中尺度定向特征上，深度网络在低或中阶段达到峰值，HOG在中细胞大小达到峰值。
Motivation: 现有镜像对称评分方法缺乏在统一、统计可靠的协议下的比较，本文填补了这一空白。
Method: 收集9种现有方法并引入4种新方法，使用反射精确协议（reflection-exact protocol）和基于机会锚定、显著性检验的判别技能（discrimination skill）进行基准测试，涵盖单轴和多轴数据集。
Result: 深度骨干在单轴和多轴协议上表现最佳，但经典HOG描述符与最佳冻结网络读数差距很小（但显著），且与亚军CNN滤波器度量不可统计分离，速度约快300倍。判别集中在中等尺度定向特征。
Conclusion: 冻结深度特征在对称性测量上优势不大；任务训练的深度评分器是否更好仍有待研究。

papers.title: Eigenvalue Calibration for Semantic Embeddings of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification is central to the reliable deployment of large language models (LLMs), and eigenvalues of semantic embeddings have recently emerged as a key tool in state-of-the-art methods. However, conventional calibration results developed for classification probabilities cannot be directly transferred to eigenvalues. We address this gap by proposing a novel framework for calibrating the eigenvalues of semantic embeddings. We interpret LLMs combined with semantic embeddings of their generated answers as density matrix predictors, and we propose a novel approach to calibrate density matrix predictors by applying temperature scaling to their eigenvalues. We establish entropy-risk equivalence under calibration, derive a central calibration inequality specific to eigenvalues, and prove that temperature-scaled eigenvalues optimize calibration when minimizing proper score risks. Experiments on a variety of real-world settings show that current LLMs are systematically overconfident, and validate our theoretical findings. Together, these results advance the foundations and practice of uncertainty quantification for semantic embeddings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了针对大语言模型语义嵌入特征值的校准框架，将LLM与语义嵌入视为密度矩阵预测器，并通过温度缩放对特征值进行校准。理论部分建立了熵-风险等价性、特征值校准不等式，并证明温度缩放可优化校准。实验表明当前LLM系统性地过度自信。
Motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法中，语义嵌入的特征值被广泛使用，但适用于分类概率的传统校准结果无法直接迁移到特征值上，亟需专门的特征值校准理论和方法。
Method: 将LLM及其生成答案的语义嵌入解释为密度矩阵预测器，提出通过温度缩放（temperature scaling）校准特征值的方法，并推导了熵-风险等价性、特征值校准不等式等理论结果。
Result: 在多种真实场景实验中验证了当前LLM存在系统性过度自信，并证明了温度缩放后的特征值能优化校准性能，支持理论推导。
Conclusion: 该工作为语义嵌入的不确定性量化提供了理论基础和实践方法，但未提及额外局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WCog-VLA: A Dual-Level World-Cognitive Vision-Language-Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing methods either lack comprehensive world cognition or suffer from fragmented world foresight, inherently confining these models to reactive driving. To address this limitation, we propose WCog-VLA, a novel dual-level World-Cognitive VLA framework that successfully bridges semantic world forecasting with generative world evolution to achieve proactive autonomous driving. At the semantic level, WCog-VLA unifies world cognition and reasoning by incorporating 3D spatial perception and injecting agent tokens to capture the world dynamics, while concurrently enabling Game-theoretic Chain-of-Thought (Game-CoT) reasoning. At the generative level, we introduce the Aligned Decoupled Diffusion Transformer (ADDT) as a powerful generative world model that synthesizes physically-plausible joint multi-agent trajectories. Through scene representation alignment, ADDT reduces the number of denoising steps required and thus significantly accelerates inference. To facilitate strategic reasoning, we further construct a large-scale dataset featuring 85k Game-CoT annotations. Extensive experiments on the NAVSIM benchmark demonstrate that WCog-VLA achieves a State-Of-The-Art (SOTA) PDMS score of 92.9.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WCog-VLA，一个双层级世界认知视觉-语言-动作框架，用于端到端自动驾驶。该方法在语义层融合3D空间感知与博弈链式思维推理，在生成层使用对齐解耦扩散变压器作为世界模型合成多智能体轨迹。在NAVSIM基准上取得PDMS 92.9的state-of-the-art结果。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型要么缺乏全面世界认知，要么世界预测碎片化，导致只能被动驾驶。需要实现主动驾驶，即具备世界预测与演化能力。
Method: 双层级框架：语义级通过3D空间感知和智能体token捕获世界动态，并引入博弈链式思维推理；生成级使用对齐解耦扩散变压器作为生成世界模型，通过场景表示对齐减少去噪步数加速推理。同时构建包含85k博弈链式思维标注的大规模数据集。
Result: 在NAVSIM基准上达到PDMS 92.9分，取得state-of-the-art性能。
Conclusion: WCog-VLA通过语义预测与生成演化的结合实现了主动驾驶，但摘要未讨论在真实复杂场景中的泛化或计算资源需求。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Large-Language-Models-as-a-Judge in Theory-Agnostic Adaptive Metric-Alignment for Prototypical Networks in Personality Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Personality recognition has traditionally been constrained by theory-dependent formulations, where models are trained to fit predefined psychological taxonomies rather than uncovering shared underlying behavioral structure. This limits generalization, as personality itself is better understood as theory-invariant, while existing annotations reflect only partial and sometimes inconsistent views of the same latent traits. In this work, we introduce JAM ((J)udge for (A)daptive (M)etric-Alignment), a theory-agnostic framework that shifts learning from adapting to predefined personality theories toward discovering unified latent pseudo-facets that capture shared psychological structure. Rather than constraining the model to any personality taxonomy during training or inference, the framework learns generalizable psychological representations and can infer an individual's latent psychological profile directly from the textual samples, without requiring theory-specific labels. JAM achieves this through an Attention-Pooled Graph Prototypical Network that learns structured representations via clustering in embedding space, together with a Cross-Theory Harmonization (CTH) approach that integrates (i) Human-Guided Linkage and (ii) Machine-Induced Consensus to unify heterogeneous datasets without relying on predefined labels. To further improve robustness and data quality, we incorporate an LLM-as-a-Judge mechanism operating in two configurations, (i) LLM-before-the-loop and (ii) LLM-in-the-loop which identifies ambiguous samples to guide adaptive metric learning. Experiments show that JAM improves cross-framework generalization and performance, establishing a strong step toward theory-agnostic personality inference and supporting low-resource personality theories. The related code repository, model weights, and artifacts are available at https://research.jingjietan.com/JAM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JAM（Judge for Adaptive Metric-Alignment），一个理论无关的人格识别框架。该框架通过注意力池化图原型网络学习结构化的心理表征，并利用跨理论协调（CTH）统一异构数据集，同时引入LLM作为法官来识别模糊样本以指导自适应度量学习。实验表明JAM显著提升了跨框架泛化性能，为低资源人格理论提供了支持。
Motivation: 传统人格识别模型受限于预定义心理学分类，无法发现共享的潜在行为结构，导致泛化能力不足。
Method: JAM包含三个核心组件：注意力池化图原型网络（用于在嵌入空间聚类）、跨理论协调（CTH，含人类引导链接和机器共识）以及LLM-as-a-Judge（两种配置：LLM-before-the-loop和LLM-in-the-loop）用于清洗数据并引导度量学习。
Result: 实验结果表明JAM在跨框架泛化任务上表现优异，优于理论依赖的基线方法，且能有效支持低资源人格理论。
Conclusion: JAM证明了理论无关的人格推断是可行的，为未来研究提供了框架和资源（代码、模型权重已开源）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Adaptive Anomaly Detection with Reinforcement Learning and Human Feedback in Connected Vehicles
papers.abstract_en: Connected vehicles are autonomous cyber-physical systems whose behavior must be continuously monitored during operation to detect deviations from normal operation before they propagate into failures. Such evaluation is challenging because the systems themselves evolve: over-the-air updates, configuration changes, and shifting workloads alter the definition of normal behavior, causing static diagnostic methods to degrade silently over time. Existing approaches typically address either automated model adaptation or operator integration in isolation, rather than as a single coordinated supervisory loop. This paper presents an online anomaly detection framework for autonomous CPS that integrates three coordinated mechanisms. A factorized deep Q-network with self-attention selects the most suitable detector from a candidate pool for each monitored service, exploiting inter-service dependencies in the microservice topology. An ensemble of three statistical drift detectors monitors the input distribution and raises an alarm only when all three concur, prioritizing precision over recall. A human-in-the-loop retraining mechanism, built around a pending transition buffer and a 60/40 prioritized replay strategy, allows the operator to incorporate expert knowledge while preserving the system's learned response to prior data distributions. The framework is evaluated on a connected-vehicle testbed running an automated valet parking application across seven backend microservices. The attention-augmented agent achieves an F1 score of 0.69, compared to at most 0.11 for any single detector applied uniformly. Following a real software update that induces measurable concept drift, F1 drops to 0.52; after operator-triggered retraining, performance recovers to 0.65 on the new distribution while remaining at 0.69 on the prior one, demonstrating sustained adaptation without catastrophic forgetting.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 30th IEEE International Conference on Emerging Technologies and Factory Automation (ETFA 2026), Special Session SS10: Evaluation Methods for Autonomous Cyber-Physical Systems' Behavior. 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联网车辆（connected vehicles）等自主CPS的在线异常检测问题，提出一个集成三个协调机制的框架：因子化深度Q网络（self-attention）从候选池中选择最佳检测器；三个统计漂移检测器一致时才报警；人类通过待定过渡缓冲区和60/40优先回放策略参与重新训练。在自动代客泊车微服务测试平台上，注意力增强智能体F1达到0.69，远高于任何单一检测器（最高0.11）。软件更新后F1降至0.52，经操作员触发的重新训练后在新分布上恢复至0.65，同时保留旧分布上的0.69，表明无灾难性遗忘的持续适应。
Motivation: 现有方法要么自动调整模型，要么依赖操作员介入，但未将它们整合为一个协调的监督循环。联网车辆的行为因空中更新、配置变化和负载变动而演变，静态诊断方法会逐渐退化。
Method: 提出包含三个机制的在线异常检测框架：1）带自注意力的因子化深度Q网络，利用微服务拓扑中的服务间依赖选择最合适的检测器；2）三个统计漂移检测器集成，三者一致时才报警，优先保证精确率优于召回率；3）基于待定过渡缓冲区和60/40优先回放策略的人类参与重新训练机制，允许操作员整合专家知识同时保留系统对先验数据分布的学习响应。
Result: 在运行自动代客泊车应用的七后端微服务测试平台上，注意力增强智能体F1为0.69，而所有单一检测器最高仅0.11。一次真实的软件更新引起可测量的概念漂移后，F1降至0.52；经操作员触发重新训练后，在新分布上恢复到0.65，同时在先验分布上保持0.69，证明系统能持续适应且无灾难性遗忘。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过结合自动模型选择、集成漂移检测和人类反馈，实现了在联网车辆动态环境中的持续异常检测适应，且不会遗忘先前学到的知识。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Role of Conversational Timing in Synthetic Training Data for ASR
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic multi-speaker conversations are widely used to train conversational automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems, but it remains unclear which timing properties make simulated data most useful. This paper studies conversational timing as a controllable training variable rather than merely as a corpus statistic to be reproduced. We parameterize pause and overlap timing distributions with an exponential-tilting family estimated from multiple conversational corpora, and then explore the resulting four-dimensional parameter space with Latin hypercube sampling and multi-objective Bayesian optimization. Each sampled timing configuration is used to generate simulated training conversations, train an ASR system, and evaluate concatenated-permutation word and character error rates (cpWER and cpCER) on a Hungarian dialogue corpus. The results show that downstream ASR behavior is explained more directly by induced timing statistics than by raw simulator coordinates or corpus proximity. In particular, higher overlap exposure is associated with lower cpWER, whereas longer and more variable gaps are associated with higher cpWER; cpCER follows the same trend, but with weaker statistical support. Bayesian optimization yields modest aggregate improvements, but its main value is analytical: it produces controlled timing interventions that reveal an overlap--gap trade-off in simulated conversational training data. These findings suggest that realistic simulation should be complemented by task-relevant diagnostics of overlap, gap, and timing-variability profiles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究合成对话语音训练数据中的对话时序（停顿和重叠）对ASR性能的影响。通过参数化时序分布并采用贝叶斯优化探索四维参数空间，发现下游ASR误差率（cpWER/cpCER）更直接由诱导的时序统计量解释，而非原始模拟参数。高重叠暴露降低cpWER，长间隙和可变间隙增加cpWER，揭示重叠与间隙之间的权衡。
Motivation: 合成多说话人对话广泛用于训练对话ASR系统，但哪些时序属性对训练最有效尚不清楚；现有工作通常仅将时序作为语料库统计量复现，而非可控训练变量。
Method: 提出用指数倾斜族参数化停顿和重叠时序分布，从多个对话语料库估计参数；然后通过拉丁超立方采样和多目标贝叶斯优化探索四维参数空间，每个配置生成模拟对话训练ASR并评估。
Result: 在匈牙利语对话语料库上，高重叠暴露与低cpWER相关，长间隙和可变间隙与高cpWER相关；cpCER趋势相同但统计支持较弱。贝叶斯优化带来适度聚合改进，主要价值在于分析性洞察。
Conclusion: 模拟对话数据的时序设计应辅以任务相关的重叠、间隙和变异性诊断，而非仅追求真实感。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tubular Neighbourhoods of Pfaffian Sets and Applications to Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We derive bounds for the volume of tubular neighbourhoods of smooth Pfaffian hypersurfaces, generalising known results for algebraic varieties. The bounds are given in terms of the Pfaffian format of the defining functions. As an application, we obtain tail bounds on the probability distribution of a condition number measuring the robustness of neural network classifiers with Pfaffian activation functions, in both the uniform and Gaussian settings. In the special case of single-hidden-layer sigmoid networks with rational weights, we derive polynomial-in-width bounds for tubular neighbourhoods of the decision boundary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为光滑 Pfaffian 超曲面的管状邻域体积导出了边界，推广了代数簇的已知结果。作为应用，获得了使用 Pfaffian 激活函数的神经网络分类器鲁棒性条件数的概率分布尾部边界，包括均匀和高斯设定。在单隐层 sigmoid 网络有理权重情形下，推导了决策边界管状邻域的多项式宽度边界。
Motivation: 现有管状邻域体积边界主要针对代数簇，而许多实际系统（如神经网络激活函数）涉及 Pfaffian 函数，需要推广这类边界以分析其几何性质。
Method: 利用 Pfaffian 格式（Pfaffian format）描述定义函数，通过复分析和技术性估计导出管状邻域体积的显式边界。
Result: 获得条件数概率分布的尾部边界（均匀和高斯分布下）；对单隐层 sigmoid 网络，得到决策边界管状邻域的多项式宽度边界，阶数为网络宽度的多项式。
Conclusion: 这些管状邻域边界为分析 Pfaffian 神经网络分类器的鲁棒性提供了理论工具，但摘要未明确讨论局限性或扩展方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FedOPAL: One-Shot Federated Learning via Analytic Visual Prompt Tuning
papers.abstract_en: With the widespread deployment of basic models in edge intelligence, communication bandwidth has become a core bottleneck restricting the scalability of federated learning. Although one-shot federated learning alleviates this problem by minimizing communication rounds, existing iterative fine-tuning or knowledge distillation methods still face challenges such as high server-side computational costs and hyperparameter sensitivity. Analytical federated learning achieves efficient gradientfree aggregation using least-squares closed-form solutions, but in environments with non-independent and identically distributed data, its static feature assumptions fail, leading to feature manifold misalignment and severely impairing model performance. To address this contradiction, this paper proposes the FedOPAL framework. This framework adapts the visual prompts as feature rectifiers, actively correcting the feature distribution of heterogeneous data to a linearly separable space by applying local proximal constraints, thereby satisfying the theoretical assumptions of analytical federated learning. Experimental results show that FedOPAL not only significantly outperforms the original analytical methods on several benchmarks, but also achieves accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art iterative methods while maintaining zero server-side training costs, providing a new engineering paradigm for efficient collaboration of large models on the edge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FedOPAL框架，利用视觉提示调整（visual prompt tuning）作为特征矫正器，解决单轮联邦学习（one-shot federated learning）中非独立同分布数据导致的特征流形不对齐问题，实现线性可分的特征空间，从而兼容解析联邦学习的闭式聚合。实验表明，FedOPAL在多个基准上显著优于原始解析方法，且精度接近最先进的迭代方法，同时保持零服务器端训练成本。
Motivation: 单轮联邦学习受限于通信带宽，但现有方法在非独立同分布数据下特征流形不对齐，导致解析联邦学习的静态特征假设失效，模型性能严重受损。
Method: 通过本地近端约束（local proximal constraints）调整视觉提示，主动修正异构数据的特征分布至线性可分空间，使得解析联邦学习的闭式聚合假设得以满足。
Result: 在多个基准上显著优于原始解析联邦学习方法，精度与最先进的迭代方法相当，且服务器端无需训练成本。
Conclusion: FedOPAL为零服务器端训练成本的联邦学习提供了新范式，适用于边缘端大模型的高效协作。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FSD-VLN: Fast-Slow Dual-System Modeling for Aerial Long-Horizon Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) enables UAV autonomous navigation in unknown environments by mapping language instructions to real-time visual inputs. Compared with GPS-dependent or pre-programmed navigation, VLN supports intuitive human-machine interaction and stronger environmental adaptability, requiring tight integration of high-level semantic reasoning and low-latency flight control.Existing methods suffer from structural misalignment between global multimodal understanding and sequential action generation, causing jittery trajectories and severe decision latency for long-horizon aerial navigation. To solve this issue, we propose FSD-VLN, a fast-slow dual-system architecture disentangling semantic reasoning and low-latency flight command generation.The framework has two asynchronous branches: a slow stream extracting stable semantic priors from pre-trained vision-language models, and a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) fast stream modeling cross-temporal action distributions to produce consistent flight outputs. We further introduce a time-aware adaptive optimizer to stabilize long-sequence training and reduce gradient oscillation.Large-scale low-altitude simulation experiments show FSD-VLN achieves up to 2X higher navigation success rates on unseen scenes than SOTA methods, while cutting single-action inference delay and total task runtime by over 50%. Our work validates the benefit of decoupled semantic-control modeling and provides a practical paradigm for long-horizon aerial VLN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FSD-VLN，一种快慢双系统架构，将语义推理与低延迟飞行命令生成分离，用于无人机长程视觉语言导航。慢流提取稳定语义先验，快流使用扩散Transformer建模跨时间动作分布。实验表明，在未见场景中导航成功率比SOTA方法提升2倍，单动作推理延迟和总任务运行时间降低50%以上。
Motivation: 现有VLN方法在全局多模态理解与序列动作生成之间存在结构错位，导致长程空中导航轨迹抖动和严重决策延迟。
Method: 提出快慢双系统架构：慢流从预训练视觉语言模型提取稳定语义先验，快流使用扩散Transformer（DiT）建模跨时间动作分布以产生一致飞行输出；引入时间感知自适应优化器稳定长序列训练并减少梯度振荡。
Result: 大规模低空仿真实验显示，FSD-VLN在未见场景中导航成功率比SOTA方法最高提升2倍，单动作推理延迟和总任务运行时间降低超过50%。
Conclusion: 验证了解耦语义-控制建模的益处，为长程空中VLN提供了实用范式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MobiDiff: Semantic-Aware Multi-Channel Discrete Diffusion for Human Mobility Data Generation
papers.abstract_en: Human mobility data are essential for transportation optimization, urban planning, and resource allocation, yet real-world mobility data are costly to collect and difficult to share due to privacy concerns. Recent diffusion-based methods have shown promise in synthesizing realistic mobility patterns, but they typically rely on continuous or latent spatio-temporal traces, limiting their ability to natively model discrete semantic events with explicit region, activity, time, and interval structures. To address this issue, we introduce MobiDiff, an end-to-end discrete diffusion framework that efficiently generates mobility data by directly denoising multi-channel semantic skeletons, avoiding the costly interpolation, latent trace construction, and coarse-to-fine realization pipelines widely used in existing diffusion-based methods. Specifically, MobiDiff decomposes each human check-in event into spatial, activity, and temporal channels, and employs structured event-, group-, and channel-level masking to jointly capture trajectory-level mobility patterns and within-event dependencies. We evaluate generation fidelity, privacy-preserving, and efficiency on three large-scale real-world datasets from Atlanta, Boston, and Seattle. Results show that MobiDiff effectively preserves trajectory length and temporal interval distributions while remaining competitive across broader mobility statistics; it is also much faster than state-of-the-art methods, e.g., 5.3$\times$ faster than GeoGen on average during inference. These findings suggest that discrete diffusion offers an interpretable and efficient framework for synthetic mobility data generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MobiDiff，一种端到端离散扩散框架，用于生成人类移动性数据。MobiDiff 将每个签到事件分解为空间、活动和时间通道，通过结构化掩码联合捕获轨迹模式和事件内依赖，避免了现有方法中的插值和粗到细实现。在亚特兰大、波士顿和西雅图三个真实数据集上，MobiDiff 在保持轨迹长度和时间间隔分布方面表现良好，同时推理速度比 GeoGen 平均快 5.3 倍。
Motivation: 现有扩散方法通常依赖连续或潜在时空轨迹，难以原生建模具有离散语义事件（如区域、活动、时间和间隔）的移动性数据，且需要昂贵的插值和粗到细实现。
Method: MobiDiff 将每个签到事件分解为空间、活动和时间三个通道，采用结构化的事件级、组级和通道级掩码，在离散空间中直接去噪多通道语义骨架，联合捕捉轨迹级模式和事件内依赖。
Result: 在三个大规模真实数据集上，MobiDiff 有效保留了轨迹长度和时间间隔分布，在更广泛的移动统计指标上具有竞争力；推理速度显著快于现有方法，平均比 GeoGen 快 5.3 倍。
Conclusion: 离散扩散为合成移动性数据生成提供了可解释且高效的框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Certified Interventional Fidelity: Anytime-Valid, Adaptive Evaluation of Causal Claims in Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability often evaluates explanations by intervening on a model: swapping hidden states, patching activations, ablating components, or comparing a compressed model to the original one. These experiments are usually summarized by a point estimate, even though the evaluation may be monitored while it runs or adapted toward suspected failures. This makes it hard to tell whether a reported fidelity or patching effect is a stable causal claim or a consequence of finite sampling and evaluation choices. We introduce Certified Interventional Fidelity (CIF), a statistical layer for interventional interpretability evaluations. CIF first writes the quantity being reported as a causal estimand: an expectation of a bounded score over a stated input distribution and a stated intervention distribution. It then provides confidence intervals and anytime-valid confidence sequences for this estimand, including under adaptive intervention sampling via bounded mixture importance weighting. We instantiate CIF with Hoeffding-style sequences and variance-adaptive betting sequences, the latter reducing certification cost by 10-30x in our experiments. On MNIST abstractions and GPT-2 Small IOI circuits, CIF certifies high-fidelity claims, shows when apparent method differences are not statistically supported, and makes sensitivity to the intervention distribution explicit.
papers.comment: Accepted at UAI 2026 (Proceedings of the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence). Code: https://github.com/AsiaeeLab/certified-interventional-fidelity
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Certified Interventional Fidelity (CIF)，一种为机械可解释性中的干预评估提供置信区间和实时有效置信序列的统计框架。CIF将报告量定义为因果估计量，并通过霍夫丁序列和方差自适应投注序列提供认证，在MNIST抽象和GPT-2 Small IOI电路上表明能认证高保真说法并揭示方法差异的统计显著性不足。
Motivation: 当前的干预评估通常用点估计总结，难以判断报告结果是否是稳定的因果声明，还是由于有限采样和评估选择造成的结果。
Method: 将评估量写为因果估计量（期望值），然后提供置信区间和任意有效的置信序列，包括通过有界混合重要性加权的自适应干预采样。具体实现了Hoeffding-style序列和方差自适应投注序列。
Result: 在MNIST抽象和GPT-2 Small IOI电路上，CIF能认证高保真说法，显示方法差异在统计上不支持，并明确对干预分布的敏感性。方差自适应序列将认证成本降低10-30倍。
Conclusion: 该方法为干预可解释性评估提供了统计保障，使得因果声明可以随时验证且自适应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prediction-Powered Active Testing
papers.abstract_en: Active testing provides a label--efficient approach to risk estimation by adaptively selecting which test points should be labelled. However, existing estimators fail to exploit the informative predictions of powerful black--box models, even though such predictions are increasingly available in settings where labels remain expensive. To address this, we propose \textbf{Prediction--Powered Active Testing (PPAT)}, a novel label--efficient risk estimation framework that combines the unbiased LURE estimator \citep{farquhar2021statistical} with a prediction--powered control variate. Rather than using proxy predictions as biased pseudo--labels, PPAT uses them to residualise the loss, preserving unbiasedness while reducing variance. Beyond the estimator itself, PPAT also changes which points should be acquired: we derive oracle and practical surrogate--based acquisition rules tailored to reducing the variance of our estimator. Moreover, we establish asymptotic normality for PPAT, yielding asymptotically valid confidence intervals and thus a principled estimate of the uncertainty around our estimates. Across tabular regression and image--classification tasks, PPAT outperforms existing methods in risk estimation, while its confidence intervals attain the target coverage with substantially fewer labels and smaller widths.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出预测驱动的主动测试（PPAT）框架，将无偏估计器LURE与预测控制变量结合，在主动测试中利用模型预测的残差化来保持无偏性并降低方差。推导了适用于该估计器的获取规则，并证明了渐近正态性，从而得到渐近有效的置信区间。在表格回归和图像分类任务上，PPAT在风险估计和置信区间覆盖方面优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有主动测试方法未能利用强大的黑箱模型提供的预测信息，而标签获取成本高昂，需要更高效的估计方法。
Method: PPAT结合无偏LURE估计器与预测驱动控制变量，通过残差化损失而非使用预测作为有偏伪标签，保持无偏性同时降低方差。还设计了面向该估计器的oracle和基于代理的获取规则，以进一步减小方差。
Result: 在表格回归和图像分类任务中，PPAT在风险估计上优于现有方法，其置信区间以更少的标签和更窄的宽度达到目标覆盖率。
Conclusion: PPAT提供了一种标签高效的风险估计框架，利用预测信息提升估计精度和置信区间质量。

papers.title: Spectral Analysis of Dueling Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: Q-learning is a fundamental algorithm in reinforcement learning (RL) for solving discounted Markov decision processes (MDPs) when the transition kernel is unknown. The deep Q-network (DQN) extends Q-learning by using a deep neural network for Q-function approximation, which makes Q-learning applicable to more practical high-dimensional problems. Dueling Q-learning decomposes the Q-function into a value function and an advantage function and learns the two components jointly, which can improve learning efficiency. However, the theoretical understanding of dueling Q-learning is still limited. Recent work has initiated an analysis of tabular dueling Q-learning, but existing guarantees focus on a regularized formulation and leave the pure tabular update less completely understood. This paper strengthens that line of analysis by adding a direct interpretation of the centered tabular decomposition and by establishing convergence guarantees for the unregularized, unprojected constant step-size recursion. In particular, we derive an exact switching linear system representation for deterministic dueling Q-learning and a finite-time error bound in expectation for the sampled stochastic version. The analysis clarifies how the value and advantage updates act as different gains on the action-common (value function) and action-differential (advantage function) components of the Q-function.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对对偶 Q-learning 进行了频谱分析，推导了确定性版本下精确的切换线性系统表示，并给出了随机版本下期望有限时间误差界，从而建立了非正则化、非投影、常数步长递归的收敛保证。分析阐明了值函数和优势函数更新对 Q 函数的不同增益作用。
Motivation: 尽管对偶 Q-learning 在实践中有效，但其理论理解有限，特别是纯表格更新的收敛性分析尚不完整，现有研究多关注正则化形式。
Method: 推导了确定性对偶 Q-learning 的精确切换线性系统表示，并针对采样随机版本证明期望有限时间误差界。
Result: 给出了非正则化、非投影、常数步长递归的收敛保证，揭示了值函数和优势函数更新分别以不同增益作用于 Q 函数的公共和差分分量。
Conclusion: 本文深化了对偶 Q-learning 的理论理解，明确了其更新规则的结构性质。

papers.title: TypeProbe: Recovering Type Representations from Hidden States of Pre-trained Code Models
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art code models achieve impressive performance, yet the extent to which they internally encode type information remains poorly understood. We probe the residual streams of pretrained code models for internal type representations using a parallel dataset of Java and Python code examples. Our results show that cross-lingual type representations emerge even from untyped code. Moreover, we test whether hidden states linearly encode the result type implied by typed function application by training probes on one language to infer argument and result types in the other. Finally, we find that this structure is partly robust to lexical perturbations and cross-language syntactic variations. To the best of our knowledge, prior work on interpretability of code models has not directly targeted formal type semantics or cross-lingual type representations. We release our code and datasets.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 12 figures. Accepted at ESSLLI 2026 (StuS; double-blind)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过并行Java和Python代码数据集，探测预训练代码模型残差流中的内部类型表示。结果表明跨语言类型表示甚至从无类型代码中涌现。进一步实验发现隐藏状态线性编码类型函数应用的结果类型，且该结构对词汇扰动和跨语言句法变化部分鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有预训练代码模型在编程任务上表现优异，但其内部如何编码类型信息尚不清楚；且以往代码模型可解释性工作未针对形式类型语义或跨语言类型表示。
Method: 使用并行Java和Python代码示例，对预训练代码模型的残差流进行探测（probing），训练线性探针在一种语言上推断另一种语言的参数类型和结果类型，并测试对词汇扰动和句法变化的鲁棒性。
Result: 跨语言类型表示从无类型代码中涌现；隐藏状态线性编码类型函数应用的结果类型；该结构对词汇扰动和跨语言句法变化部分鲁棒。
Conclusion: 代码模型内部存在跨语言类型表示，且可通过线性探针恢复；未来工作可进一步探索形式类型语义的可解释性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AutoAnchor: Stable Diffusion Unlearning Using Cross-Attention as a Manifold Surrogate
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion unlearning is essential for mitigating the generation of harmful or copyrighted content in text-to-image models. Current diffusion unlearning techniques determine the model update direction by either using alternatives of the target concept as an anchor or using empty prompts. The anchor-based method relies on manually and semantically-chosen anchors that risk biased unlearning, while the anchor-free method inherently suffers from unrobust unlearning due to unconstrained latent updates. In this work, we theoretically formalize such unstable diffusion unlearning issues under the manifold hypothesis and prove that lacking a manifold-proximal anchor inevitably induces significant normal-space drift that degrades unlearning performance. To achieve stable unlearning, we propose \mysysn, a two-stage framework that automatically synthesizes manifold-proximal anchors. However, direct geometric manifold optimization is computationally intractable. To address this challenge, \mysys introduces a novel cross-attention consistency loss which serves as a highly efficient surrogate of manifold proximity. Experimental results demonstrate that \mysys effectively achieves robust and unbiased unlearning across various state-of-the-art baselines, significantly improving targeted concept removal (by up to 31.04\% in CLIP score) and non-target utility (by up to 4.18\% in CLIP score). Moreover, \mysys can also be easily integrated into existing diffusion unlearning methods to enhance their unlearning performance (by 6.30\% for concept removal and 6.65\% for utility on average).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型遗忘中的不稳定性问题，提出AutoAnchor框架。基于流形假设理论，通过自动合成流形近端锚点，并引入交叉注意力一致性损失作为流形近似的代理，实现稳定且无偏的遗忘。实验表明，该方法在概念移除和非目标效用上分别提升高达31.04%和4.18%的CLIP分数，并可集成到现有方法中平均提升6.30%和6.65%。
Motivation: 现有扩散遗忘方法依赖人工语义锚点导致偏差，或使用空提示导致不稳定；缺乏流形近端锚点会引起显著的正常空间漂移，降低遗忘性能。
Method: 提出两阶段框架AutoAnchor，自动合成流形近端锚点；为克服直接几何流形优化计算困难，引入交叉注意力一致性损失作为高效的流形近似代理。
Result: 在多种基线方法上，目标概念移除CLIP分数提升最高31.04%，非目标效用提升最高4.18%；集成到现有遗忘方法后，平均提升概念移除6.30%和效用6.65%。
Conclusion: 该框架实现了稳健、无偏的遗忘效果，且易于集成到现有扩散遗忘方法中。
