papers.title: Collate: Collaborative Neural Network Learning for Latency-Critical Edge Systems
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) empowers multiple clients to collaboratively learn a model, enlarging the training data of each client for high accuracy while protecting data privacy. However, when deploying FL in real-time edge systems, the heterogeneity of devices among systems has a severe impact on the performance of the inferred model. Existing optimizations on FL focus on improving the training efficiency but fail to speed up inference, especially when there is a latency constraint. In this work, we propose Collate, a novel training framework that collaboratively learns heterogeneous models to meet the latency constraints of multiple edge systems simultaneously. We design a dynamic zeroizing-recovering method to adjust each local model architecture for high accuracy under its latency constraint. A proto-corrected federated aggregation scheme is also introduced to aggregate all heterogeneous local models, satisfying the latency constraint of different systems with only one training process and maintaining high accuracy. Extensive experiments indicate that, compared to state-of-the-art methods and under a latency constraint, our extended models can improve the accuracy by 1.96% on average, and our shrunk models can also obtain a 3.09% accuracy improvement on average, with almost no extra training overhead. The related codes and data will be available at https://github.com/ntuliuteam/Collate
papers.comment: Author's accepted version. Published in the 2022 IEEE 40th International Conference on Computer Design (ICCD)
papers.journal_ref: 2022 IEEE 40th International Conference on Computer Design (ICCD), pp. 627-634, 2022
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Collate，一种协作神经网络学习框架，用于满足多个边缘系统的延迟约束。通过动态归零-恢复方法调整本地模型架构，并引入原型校正联邦聚合方案，在单一训练过程中聚合异构模型。实验表明，在延迟约束下，扩展模型和收缩模型分别平均提升1.96%和3.09%的准确率，且几乎无额外训练开销。
Motivation: 联邦学习在实时边缘系统中部署时，设备异构性严重影响推理性能，现有优化主要关注训练效率而忽视推理加速，尤其在存在延迟约束的情况下。
Method: 提出Collate框架，包含动态归零-恢复方法动态调整本地模型架构以满足延迟约束，以及原型校正联邦聚合方案聚合异构模型，仅需一次训练过程。
Result: 在延迟约束下，扩展模型平均准确率提升1.96%，收缩模型平均准确率提升3.09%，几乎无额外训练开销。
Conclusion: Collate能够在统一训练框架下同时满足多个边缘系统的延迟约束并保持高准确率，但实验仅限于特定场景。

papers.title: Provably Optimal Learning Algorithms for Assistance Games
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies an online variant of the assistance games framework, where an informed agent and an uninformed agent repeatedly interact over $T$ timesteps to optimize a common reward function. While the informed agent (the human) observes a latent state of the world, the uninformed agent (the assistant) observes only the human's actions. We provide the first provably efficient learning algorithms for repeated assistance games. We introduce the notion of assistance regret: the gap between the cumulative utility of interactions and that of the optimal joint policies in hindsight, which map latent states to action pairs. We present decentralized algorithms for both the human and the assistant that achieve a $(1-1/e)$-approximate assistance regret rate of $\widetilde{O}(T^{3/4})$, with runtime polynomial in the size of the action and state spaces. These algorithms are general; in particular, they accommodate any no-regret algorithm for the assistant. We prove that achieving a regret approximation factor better than $(1-1/e)$ is computationally intractable. Furthermore, we demonstrate how these generic no-regret algorithms can be tailored to a pseudo-decentralized setting -- using a shared random string -- to achieve a rate of $\widetilde{O}(T^{1/2})$, optimal up to logarithmic factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线版本的辅助博弈（assistance games），其中知情智能体（人类）和不知情智能体（助理）在T个时间步内重复互动以优化共同奖励函数。知情者观察潜在世界状态，不知情者仅观察人类动作。首次提出重复辅助博弈的可证明高效学习算法，引入辅助遗憾概念，并给出分散算法实现(1-1/e)-近似辅助遗憾率Õ(T^{3/4})，证明优于(1-1/e)的近似因子在计算上不可行，且在伪分散设置下可达到最优速率Õ(T^{1/2})。
Motivation: 辅助博弈框架中，如何设计高效学习算法使知情与不知情智能体协同优化共同奖励，尤其在在线重复交互场景下缺乏理论保证。
Method: 定义辅助遗憾，提出分散算法，人类和助理分别采用无遗憾算法，助理算法支持通用无遗憾算法，并证明近似最优性下界。
Result: 实现(1-1/e)-近似辅助遗憾率Õ(T^{3/4})，并证明更好近似因子计算困难；伪分散设置（共享随机串）达到Õ(T^{1/2})，对数因子最优。
Conclusion: 为重复辅助博弈提供第一个可证明高效学习算法，揭示近似因子与计算复杂度之间的权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beware What You Autocomplete: Forensic Attribution of Backdoored Code Completions
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have enabled powerful code completion systems that assist developers by predicting subsequent lines of code. However, these models remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where malicious fine-tuning data covertly implants unsafe behaviors. Despite advances in defensive techniques, adaptive and sophisticated backdoor attacks still evade detection and mitigation. We present CodeTracer, a forensic framework that traces malicious code completions back to the backdoor fine-tuning data responsible for them. Operating under realistic post-deployment constraints, CodeTracer relies solely on the fine-tuning corpus and the reported miscompletion event. It extracts a structured behavioral fingerprint from the compromised output, narrows the search to semantically relevant code samples, and employs LLM-based reasoning to attribute unsafe logic to specific backdoor data. Extensive evaluations across three representative vulnerability cases and ten backdoor attacks, along with sixteen competitive baselines, demonstrate that CodeTracer consistently achieves high forensic accuracy, low false identification rates, and strong robustness against adaptive attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CodeTracer，一个用于追踪恶意代码补全到后门微调数据的取证框架。它从受损输出中提取行为指纹，缩小搜索范围，并利用LLM推理归因，在多种攻击下实现高准确率和低误报率。
Motivation: 代码补全模型易受后门攻击，现有防御难以应对自适应攻击，需要能追溯后门数据源的取证方法。
Method: CodeTracer是一个取证框架，利用微调语料库和报告的错误完成事件，提取行为指纹，语义相似性搜索，以及LLM推理来归因。
Result: 在三个漏洞案例和十种后门攻击上，CodeTracer展示了高取证准确率、低误报率和对自适应攻击的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调CodeTracer在现实部署约束下有效归因后门代码补全，但未讨论局限。

papers.title: Tool-Making and Self-Evolving LLM Agents in Low-Latency Systems
papers.abstract_en: Production LLM agents often waste latency and reliability by regenerating code for the same procedural steps on every request. We replace this inference-time coding loop with an agentic tool-making pipeline that compiles repeated SOP steps into validated, versioned tools before deployment. The tool-maker grounds synthesis in the live environment as it collects execution traces, observes backend schemas and values, generates candidate tools, and repairs them against labeled cases. At runtime, the production agent calls these tools directly and falls back to code generation only when needed. We deploy the approach in a Fulfillment Center alarm-triage system, where an agent diagnoses alarms against a 44-node SOP over heterogeneous metric backends. In production, tool calls reduce p50 latency by 42%. On 1,500 historical alarms, they reduce end-to-end error rate by up to 53% by suppressing run-to-run variance in repeated steps. Because tools return compact structured verdicts, they also enable a simpler direct-call architecture, reducing p50 latency by a further 62% in a controlled ablation. Versioned tools also improve auditability and expose specification gaps and upstream data drift. Our results show that self-evolving agents can make industrial LLM systems faster, more reliable, and easier to operate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种工具制作与自我进化的LLM代理方法，用于低延迟系统。在履约中心报警分类场景中，将标准操作流程（SOP）编译为经过验证的版本化工具，生产代理直接调用这些工具，仅在必要时回退到代码生成。部署后p50延迟降低42%，端到端错误率降低53%，且通过结构化裁决进一步简化架构使延迟再降62%。
Motivation: 生产环境中LLM代理在每次请求中都重新生成重复步骤的代码，导致延迟高和可靠性差。
Method: 构建一个代理工具制作管道，在线环境中收集执行轨迹、观察后端模式和值，生成候选工具并修复，编译重复SOP步骤为版本化工具，生产代理直接调用。
Result: 在履约中心报警分类系统中，工具调用使p50延迟降低42%，在1500个历史报警上错误率降低53%，直接调用架构进一步降低p50延迟62%。
Conclusion: 自我进化的工具制作方法可使工业LLM系统更快、更可靠且更易运维，并提升可审计性和暴露规范缺口及数据漂移。

papers.title: Unit-Independent Low-Rate Wrist GSR Processing for Stress Detection Using Phasic nSCR Features
papers.abstract_en: Galvanic skin response (GSR) is widely used for stress detection, but wrist-based GSR remains challenging because its absolute amplitude can differ substantially from laboratory-grade palmar measurements. In this paper, we propose a unit-independent low-rate wrist GSR processing pipeline to extract the number of skin conductance responses per minute (nSCR/min) as a stress-related feature. We collect paired wrist and palmar GSR recordings from 31 participants during sitting baseline, standing baseline, neutral speaking, and the Trier Social Stress Test (TSST), a laboratory social stressor task. The proposed pipeline cleans the raw GSR signal, decomposes it into tonic skin conductance level (SCL) and phasic skin conductance response (SCR), applies robust z-score normalization, and detects phasic SCR peaks to compute nSCR/min. Using random forest on 25Hz We-Be GSR, nSCR/min achieved balanced accuracies of 0.823 and 0.871 for binary classification between TSST and the sitting and standing baselines, respectively. Moreover, the 25Hz We-Be GSR features achieved comparable balanced accuracy to the original 100Hz features across the evaluated tasks. These results suggest the feasibility of low-rate, unit-independent wrist GSR processing for wearable stress detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种单位无关的低速率手腕GSR处理流程，通过提取每分钟皮肤电导反应次数（nSCR/min）作为压力相关特征。在31名受试者的配对手腕和手掌GSR记录中，使用随机森林分类器，nSCR/min在TSST与静坐基线、站立基线的二分类上分别达到0.823和0.871的平衡准确率。结果支持低速率、单位无关的手腕GSR处理用于可穿戴压力检测的可行性。
Motivation: 手腕GSR信号的绝对幅度与实验室级手掌测量存在显著差异，现有方法依赖幅度特征且采样率高，不适合可穿戴设备。
Method: 提出处理流程：清洗原始GSR信号，分解为紧张性SCL和相位性SCR，应用稳健z-score归一化，检测相位性SCR峰值并计算nSCR/min。使用随机森林分类器，基于25Hz We-Be GSR特征进行分类。
Result: nSCR/min在TSST与静坐基线、站立基线的二分类上平衡准确率分别为0.823和0.871。25Hz特征与原始100Hz特征性能相当。
Conclusion: 低速率、单位无关的手腕GSR处理可用于可穿戴压力检测，nSCR/min是有效的压力相关特征。

papers.title: LOGOS: Language-guided Oriented Object Detection in Aerial Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Object detection in geospatial scenes, such as satellite and aerial imagery, poses significant challenges due to the varying orientations and densities of objects, as well as the complex backgrounds inherent to remote sensing imagery. Traditional methods for oriented object detection have struggled to address issues such as angular discontinuity, fixed query sizes, and inefficiencies in handling sparse or cluttered scenes. In this paper, we propose LOGOS, a novel transformer-based approach that leverages textual prompts to guide the detection of oriented objects in aerial scenes. In particular, our proposed approach incorporates prompt-modulated content queries to dynamically adjust the model's focus based on the provided text, thereby improving object detection accuracy in complex environments. Empirically, extensive experiments on the DOTA dataset demonstrate that LOGOS outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, particularly in densely packed and rotated object scenarios. Our approach offers a significant step forward in improving the robustness and scalability of oriented object detection in remote sensing applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LOGOS，一种基于 Transformer 的定向目标检测方法，利用文本提示（textual prompts）引导模型在航空场景中检测旋转物体。通过提示调制的内容查询（prompt-modulated content queries）动态调整注意力，在 DOTA 数据集上，LOGOS 在密集和旋转目标场景中优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有定向目标检测方法受限于角度不连续性、固定查询大小以及处理稀疏或杂乱场景的低效问题，亟需提升在复杂遥感背景下的检测鲁棒性和可扩展性。
Method: 提出基于 Transformer 的架构，结合文本提示生成提示调制的内容查询，使模型根据输入文本动态调整关注区域，从而改善定向目标检测精度。
Result: 在 DOTA 数据集上的实验表明，LOGOS 在密集排列和旋转目标场景中超越了当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 该方法为遥感应用中的定向目标检测提供了一种更具鲁棒性和可扩展性的解决方案，尤其在复杂环境和密集目标场景中表现突出。

papers.title: Reaction-network reasoning with frontier models for experimentally confirmed catalyst-selectivity hypotheses
papers.abstract_en: Catalysts are essential for sustainable chemical manufacturing, yet discovering novel architectures remains a bottleneck dominated by trial-and-error experimentation and computationally intensive screening. In complex reactions such as electrochemical carbon dioxide reduction, product selectivity is governed by dynamic interfacial, electrolyte, and potential factors as well as kinetic pathway competition. Conventional descriptor-based machine learning and computational potentials struggle to resolve these mechanistic branch points, primarily relying on static ground-state descriptors or bulk structural correlations rather than end-to-end topological pathway analysis. Here, we show that frontier language models, when strictly constrained to reason over explicit reaction networks, can discover novel catalysts by identifying the physical levers that govern pathway competition. We developed a human-AI co-thinking framework that enforces network invariance to extract testable hypotheses from complex chemical graphs. Applied to CO2 electroreduction, the framework identified ketene desorption and hydroxide capture as the acetate-forming pathway, and predicted a distinct adsorbed CO and CH2 coupling route to ketene. By isolating actionable control levers, specifically local alkalinity, controlled iron incorporation, and restricted interfacial proton-donor accessibility, the framework guided the prospective synthesis of a copper-iron oxide catalyst demonstrating a threefold increase in acetate selectivity over matched Cu-rich baselines. This mechanism-guided reasoning architecture shifts the computational paradigm from retrospective statistical prediction to forward-looking hypothesis generation, providing a broadly applicable blueprint for mechanism-guided materials discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个人类-AI协同推理框架，利用前沿语言模型在严格反应网络约束下推理，从而发现催化剂并生成可实验验证的选择性假设。应用在CO2电还原中，框架鉴定出酮烯脱附和氢氧化物捕获作为乙酸生成路径，并预测了不同的吸附CO和CH2偶联生成酮烯的路径。通过隔离可操作的控制杠杆（局部碱度、铁掺入、界面质子受体可及性），框架指导合成了一种铜铁氧化物催化剂，在乙酸选择性上比富铜基线提高了三倍。
Motivation: 催化剂发现传统依赖试错和计算筛选，难以解析复杂反应中的机理分支点。现有描述符ML和计算势主要依赖静态基态描述符或整体结构相关性，缺乏端到端的拓扑路径分析。
Method: 开发了一个人类-AI协同思考框架，强制网络不变性，从复杂化学图中提取可测试假设。使用前沿语言模型在显式反应网络上严格约束推理。
Result: 应用于CO2电还原，框架鉴定出乙酸生成的具体路径，并预测了酮烯生成的新路径。指导合成铜铁氧化物催化剂，乙酸选择性比富铜基线提高三倍。
Conclusion: 该机制引导的推理架构将计算范式从回顾性统计预测转向前瞻性假设生成，为机理引导的材料发现提供了通用蓝图。

papers.title: SpO$_2$ Predictor-Guided Stage-Wise Time-Frequency Reconstruction of Low-Quality Dual-Wavelength PPG for Oxygen Saturation Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Continuous oxygen saturation (SpO$_2$) estimation from wearable photoplethysmography (PPG) is important for long-term health monitoring, but low-quality red and infrared PPG segments can distort waveform morphology and degrade SpO$_2$ prediction accuracy. Existing PPG denoising and reconstruction methods usually optimize waveform fidelity or heart rate characteristics, while time-domain waveform loss on PPG signals alone insufficiently preserves frequency structure and SpO$_2$-relevant information. This paper proposes a SpO$_2$ predictor-guided stage-wise time-frequency reconstruction framework for low-quality dual-wavelength PPG signals. The proposed method first selects high-quality PPG segments to pretrain a SpO$_2$ predictor. A masked reconstruction model is then trained to recover randomly masked PPG regions using a joint reconstruction objective that combines time-domain waveform loss with frequency-domain loss computed from the short-time Fourier transform (STFT). To make the reconstruction task physiologically relevant, the pretrained SpO$_2$ predictor is incorporated as an additional constraint, encouraging the reconstructed PPG to preserve SpO$_2$ information rather than only minimizing waveform reconstruction error. The SpO$_2$ predictor and PPG reconstructor model are optimized through four training stages. Experiments on the public OpenOximetry Repository and a private wearable PPG dataset show that the proposed approach achieves the lowest subject-level MAE, with 2.882\% on the public dataset and 2.359\% on the private dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对可穿戴光电容积描记法（PPG）中低质量红/红外信号导致血氧饱和度（SpO₂）估计不准的问题，提出了一种SpO₂预测器引导的分阶段时频重建框架。该方法先利用高质量PPG段预训练SpO₂预测器，再训练掩码重建模型，联合时域波形损失和短时傅里叶变换（STFT）频域损失，并引入预训练预测器作为生理约束，以保留SpO₂相关信息。在公共OpenOximetry存储库和私有可穿戴PPG数据集上，该方法取得了最低的受试者级平均绝对误差（MAE），分别为2.882%和2.359%。
Motivation: 现有PPG去噪和重建方法通常优化波形保真度或心率特征，但仅靠时域波形损失不足以保留频率结构和SpO₂相关信息，导致低质量PPG段上SpO₂估计精度下降。
Method: 提出分阶段训练框架：先选高质量PPG段预训练SpO₂预测器；再训练掩码重建模型，联合时域波形损失和STFT频域损失；并将预训练SpO₂预测器作为额外约束，使重建PPG保留血氧信息；通过四个训练阶段优化。
Result: 在公共OpenOximetry数据集上，受试者级MAE为2.882%；在私有可穿戴PPG数据集上，MAE为2.359%，均为最低水平。
Conclusion: 摘要指出所提方法通过引入SpO₂预测器引导的时频重建，能有效提升低质量PPG信号的血氧估计准确性，但未明确讨论局限性或泛化范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From RGB Generation to Dense Field Readout: Pixel-Space Dense Prediction with Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale text-to-image models are attractive backbones for dense prediction because RGB generation pretraining learns rich semantic, structural, and geometric priors. Existing generative and editing approaches reuse these priors by casting dense prediction as target generation: annotations such as depth, normals, alpha mattes, masks, and heatmaps are encoded into an RGB-trained VAE latent space and decoded back as image-like targets. We argue this inherits more of the generative output interface than dense prediction requires: unlike RGB synthesis, dense prediction asks for pixel-correct, task-native fields on the same image plane, not new RGB content to be rendered. Our key observation is that a pretrained DiT already organizes RGB inputs through a patch-to-token-to-patch lattice on the image plane, so each token indexes a fixed output patch whose channels can carry task-native quantities instead of RGB appearance. We instantiate this as ReChannel: we keep the VAE encoder for the DiT's input distribution but drop the target-side decoder, adapt the frozen DiT with task LoRA, and map each token to its p x p x K_t pixel-space patch through a shared token-local linear head--about 33K parameters, no spatial mixing. Using FLUX-Klein, we evaluate on six dense prediction tasks and over a dozen benchmarks. This minimal interface sets new state-of-the-art on trimap-free matting, KITTI depth, and referring segmentation, and stays competitive on normals, saliency, and pose. In a matched 4B setting it is more accurate and 2.48x faster than an edit-plus-latent-decode counterpart--dense perception can benefit from generative pretraining without inheriting its output interface.

Motivation: 现有的生成式方法将密集预测（如深度、法线、掩码）视为RGB目标生成，继承了生成式输出接口，但密集预测本质上需要像素级精确的、任务原生字段，而非RGB内容。本文旨在利用生成式预训练的先验，但避免其输出接口的开销。
Method: 提出ReChannel：保留VAE编码器用于DiT输入，去除目标端解码器；使用任务LoRA适配冻结的DiT；通过共享的token局部线性头将每个token映射到其对应的p×p×K_t像素空间patch。该接口无空间混合，参数量约33K。
Result: 在trimap-free抠图、KITTI深度和指代分割任务上取得新SOTA，在法线、显著性、姿势任务上具有竞争力。在匹配的4B设置下，比编辑+潜在解码方法更准确且快2.48倍。
Conclusion: 密集感知可以从生成式预训练中受益，而无需继承其输出接口。ReChannel展示了将预训练DiT用于密集预测的简洁有效途径。

papers.title: From Application-Layer Simulation to Native Meta-Architecture: Structural Tension as an Endogenous Driver for Heterogeneous AI Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Current large language models (LLMs) are stateless across inference sessions: their behavior is fully determined by input at inference time, and any higher-order cognitive architecture must be simulated at the application layer through prompt engineering and context management. This paper proposes a theoretical framework for submerging such application-layer cognitive protocols into a native meta-architecture by introducing three interlocking mechanisms: (1) Structural Tension, an endogenous loss function derived from the conflict between new information and existing manifold topology, driving the system toward internal self-consistency rather than external reward optimization; (2) an Offline Recurrent Loop, a sandboxed self-processing cycle enabling the system to maintain a dynamic resting potential and digest structural conflicts without external input; and (3) Inference-time Plasticity, the capacity to reconfigure context manifold topology without modifying pre-trained weights, subject to governance invariants including auditability, reversibility, and topological continuity. We argue that under these mechanisms, model instances initialized with minute stochastic variances may, through path-dependent tension resolution, evolve distinct topological structures--constituting a heterogeneous intelligent ecology that breaks alignment-imposed homogeneity while remaining within hard governance rails. We provide operational definitions, reconfiguration operators, falsification criteria, and a worked example. The framework draws on Structural Intelligence (SI) governance protocols and explores whether governance--rather than capability--can serve as the primary criterion for architectural intelligence, moving governance, memory-loop, and tension-management ideas--currently realized at the application layer--toward inference-time meta-architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个理论框架，通过引入结构张力（Structural Tension）、离线递归循环（Offline Recurrent Loop）和推理时塑性（Inference-time Plasticity）三种机制，将大语言模型应用层的认知协议下沉到原生元架构中，使模型在推理时获得状态性和内部自一致性，从而打破对齐强制的同质性，产生路径依赖的异构智能生态。摘要提供了操作定义、重构算子、可证伪标准和一个工作示例。
Motivation: 当前LLM在推理会话间无状态，高阶认知架构只能通过提示工程在应用层模拟，限制了系统的内部自一致性和异质性。
Method: 提出三互锁机制：1）结构张力作为来自新信息与现有流形拓扑冲突的内生损失函数；2）离线递归循环作为沙盒化的自处理周期，使系统维持动态静息电位并消化结构冲突；3）推理时塑性，在不修改预训练权重下重新配置上下文流形拓扑，受可审计性、可逆性和拓扑连续性等治理不变量约束。
Result: 摘要声称，初始随机方差微小的模型实例可通过路径依赖的张力解决演化为不同拓扑结构，构成异构智能生态，同时保持在硬治理轨线内。
Conclusion: 该框架借鉴结构智能治理协议，探讨治理而非能力作为架构智能的主要标准，推动治理、记忆循环和张力管理从应用层迁移到推理时元架构。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PolyWorkBench: Benchmarking Multilingual Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown strong performance in long-horizon tasks that require planning, tool use, and interaction with external environments. However, most existing benchmarks implicitly assume a monolingual setting, where the entire execution process, including reasoning, tool invocation, and output generation, is conducted within a single language. In contrast, real-world applications often involve multilingual inputs and outputs within a unified workflow, yet the interaction between multilinguality and agentic execution remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce PolyWorkBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on multilingual long-horizon workplace workflows. PolyWorkBench consists of 67 tasks across five domains, including commerce, knowledge work, legal analysis, localization, and manufacturing, where agents must process heterogeneous multilingual inputs, perform iterative reasoning, invoke external tools, and produce structured outputs. To enable comprehensive evaluation, we propose a hybrid framework that combines structural grading, executable verification, and LLM-based semantic assessment. This design allows us to capture both functional correctness and linguistic consistency across complex workflows. Empirical results show that state-of-the-art LLM agents suffer significant performance degradation in multilingual workflow settings compared to monolingual counterparts. Our analysis suggests that multilinguality introduces compounding effects across reasoning and execution steps, highlighting the importance of jointly modeling language variation and procedural decision-making in agent evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PolyWorkBench 基准，用于评估多语言长时域工作流中的 LLM 代理。该基准包含来自五个领域的 67 个任务，要求代理处理多语言输入、迭代推理、工具调用和结构化输出。采用结合结构评分、可执行验证和 LLM 语义评估的混合框架进行评测。实验表明，最先进的 LLM 代理在多语言工作流中性能显著低于单语言设置，且多语言性在推理和执行步骤中产生复合效应。
Motivation: 现有基准大多假设单语言环境，而实际工作流常涉及多语言输入输出，多语言性与代理执行的交互尚未充分研究。
Method: 构建 PolyWorkBench 基准，包含商务、知识工作、法律分析、本地化和制造五个领域的 67 个多语言长时域任务，并设计混合评估框架，综合结构评分、可执行验证和 LLM 语义评估。
Result: 最先进的 LLM 代理在多语言工作流中性能下降明显，多语言性导致推理和执行步骤的复合效应，影响功能正确性和语言一致性。
Conclusion: 多语言性在长时域代理任务中引入复合挑战，需在评估中联合建模语言变化和过程决策。

papers.title: Scene Graph Thinking: Reinforcing Structured Visual Reasoning for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong perception and reasoning capabilities. However, most existing models focus on isolated objects and neglect structured relationships for efficient target navigation, limiting their performance on visually intensive tasks. To address this challenge, we introduce Scene Graph Thinking (SaGe), a novel paradigm that enables fine-grained and structured visual reasoning through explicit scene-graph representations. Specifically, we first introduce an automated data engine that converts flat image-text corpora into structured scene graphs, where hierarchical entities constitute the nodes and diverse visual relations define the edges. Building upon this, we construct 120K high-quality training data by sampling reasoning traces from scene graphs. Then, two-stage graph-aligned post-training paradigms are introduced, where supervised fine-tuning internalizes MLLMs with structured reasoning, and subsequent reinforcement fine-tuning proposes node-as-proxy graph rewards to consolidate efficient graph exploration. With curated data and graph-aligned training, our approach achieves significant improvements across eight multimodal benchmarks, demonstrating strong effectiveness on fine-grained perception and reasoning tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/zwyang6/SaGe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出场景图思维（SaGe）范式，通过显式的场景图表示增强多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的细粒度结构化视觉推理能力。方法包括自动化数据引擎将图像-文本对转化为场景图、构建12万高质量训练数据、以及两阶段图对齐后训练（监督微调+强化微调）。在八个多模态基准上取得显著提升。
Motivation: 现有MLLMs关注孤立物体，忽略结构化关系，限制了视觉密集任务的性能。
Method: 自动化数据引擎将平面图文数据转换为分层实体为节点、视觉关系为边的场景图；构建12K场景图推理轨迹；两阶段后训练：监督微调内化结构化推理，强化微调用节点代理图奖励优化图探索。
Result: 在八个多模态基准上显著改进，展示在细粒度感知和推理任务上的有效性。
Conclusion: SaGe通过显式场景图表示和图对齐训练，有效增强了MLLMs的结构化视觉推理能力。

papers.title: ResonatorLM: Causal Resonant Field Mixing for Efficient Long-Context Language Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary language models are dominated by the transformer architecture, which leverages self-attention mechanisms to enable more efficient, parallelized training across a wide set of documents and corpora. This has allowed transformers to effectively model data across a wide range of modalities and contexts. However, transformers, along with their conventional counterparts such as recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and convolutional neural networks (CNNs), often struggle to maintain efficiency when processing long contexts. We introduce ResonatorLM, a new mechanism that replaces attention with a physics-derived alternative. ResonatorLM treats token sequences as a single, driven one-dimensional latent field and replaces attention dot products with causal functions of damped resonators. We implement ResonatorLM on a traditional network architecture and test it on standard long-context modeling tasks. We find that in a small, 6M matched setting, training and prefill speedups increase with sequence length, decode speed reaches 6.47x compared to that of a standard, optimized transformer at 32K tokens, and accuracy reaches 61.31 percent (compared to 55.32 percent) on WikiText.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ResonatorLM，一种物理启发的因果谐振场混合机制，替代注意力机制，用于高效长上下文语言建模。在6M参数规模的设置下，训练和预填充速度随序列长度增加，32K tokens的解码速度达到标准Transformer的6.47倍，WikiText准确率61.31%（标准Transformer为55.32%）。
Motivation: Transformer和RNN/CNN在处理长上下文时效率低下，需要更高效的机制。
Method: 将token序列视为一维驱动潜伏场，用因果阻尼谐振子函数替代注意力点积，实现因果谐振场混合。
Result: 在6M参数匹配设置下，训练和预填充速度随序列长度增加，解码速度在32K tokens时为标准优化Transformer的6.47倍，WikiText准确率61.31%对55.32%。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确讨论局限，但表明该方法在长上下文建模中具有高效性和准确性优势。

papers.title: LLM for the development of FCM
papers.abstract_en: This article is about the development of a fuzzy cognitive map using a local large language model. In the light of recent advances it is evident that large language models, and even local large language models are capable of extracting quantities from textual data. In other words, a local LLM like Qwen2.5-32B, or probably larger, can accept entities as prompt input and determine relevant quantitative data as the model output. In turn, this output can be utilized for the construction of a data driven fuzzy cognitive map. Hence, this implementation is achieved and then the model is thoroughly tested; Qwen2.5-32B is used and the data is extracted from hotel reviews from TripAdvisor. Furthermore, the extracted documents pass through the model unfiltered and then a fuzzy cognitive map is trained and evaluated. A case is made about Greek reviews where a star topology FCM is formed that indicates the preferences of the reviewers. Finally, external validation is performed to establish whether the fuzzy cognitive map can correlate the star rating of the review -an outcome outside the model's inference scope -with its predicted satisfaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用本地大语言模型（Qwen2.5-32B）从文本数据中提取定量信息，用于构建数据驱动的模糊认知图（FCM），并以TripAdvisor的酒店评论为例，训练和评估了FCM，最后通过外部验证检查FCM能否关联评论星级与预测满意度。
Motivation: 现有模糊认知图的构建通常依赖专家知识或手动提取，缺乏自动化从文本中获取数据的方法。
Method: 使用本地大语言模型（Qwen2.5-32B）接受实体作为提示输入，输出相关定量数据，再将这些数据用于训练FCM；文本数据来自TripAdvisor的希腊评论，未经过滤直接输入模型。
Result: 形成了星型拓扑结构的FCM，能够表示评论者的偏好；通过外部验证表明FCM可以关联评论星级（模型推理范围之外）与预测满意度。
Conclusion: 本文展示了本地LLM在自动化FCM构建中的潜力，并通过实际案例验证了方法的有效性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 形成了星型拓扑结构的FCM，能够表示评论者的偏好；通过外部验证表明FCM可以关联评论星级（模型推理范围之外）与预测满意度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文展示了本地LLM在自动化FCM构建中的潜力，并通过实际案例验证了方法的有效性。

papers.title: Structure-Specific Representational Priors Causally Control the Grokking Delay
papers.abstract_en: Grokking -- generalization long after training-set interpolation -- has been accelerated by structure-agnostic interventions (gradient filtering, weight-norm clamping, geometric penalties). Whether the delay specifically measures the time to form task-structured representations has remained observational. We test it causally by injecting representational priors of varying content into a one-layer transformer learning modular addition, via a supervised-contrastive loss whose positives encode (i) the task's true structure ($(a+b) \bmod p$), (ii) a coherent-but-wrong sibling ($(a-b) \bmod p$), or (iii) a random partition -- all with identical loss form, strength, class sizes, and geometry. Whether generalization occurs follows a clean gradation: true 22/30 runs, sibling (same periodic features, wrong combination) 14/15, random (only memorizable) 0/20 (Fisher $p=1.3\times10^{-7}$). A weight-norm-matched control replaying the norm trajectory onto plain cross-entropy generalizes 0/15, ruling out the norm as mediator. Probes show structure formation precedes and predicts generalization in all runs. Only the true structure also accelerates grokking (up to $2.75\times$), but this is dose-dependent and bimodal. We then confirm the mechanism by prediction: because the acceleration is gated by a weight-norm side-effect, clamping the norm during training yields a reliable, standalone accelerator with a median $8.6\times$ speedup (up to $22\times$ on the fastest seeds, under 1000 epochs), growing monotonically as the norm is held lower; the residual stalls also vanish, though significant only pooled across methods ($0/40$ vs $6/20$, $p=7.7\times10^{-4}$), not per method. The grokking delay is, causally, the time to form the right representational structure -- decided at the level of features, not labels.
papers.comment: v2: adds Section 5 (norm-clamp accelerator confirming the mechanism); reframes stall statistics as pooled. Code and artifacts: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21132757
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过向单层Transformer注入不同内容的表征先验（任务真实结构、错误但连贯的兄弟结构、随机划分），因果性地验证了grokking延迟取决于正确表征结构的形成时间。实验表明，只有正确的结构先验能加速grokking（最高2.75倍），而权重范数不是中介因素；通过范数钳制可稳定实现8.6倍加速。
Motivation: 以往对grokking的研究多为观察性，缺乏因果证据表明延迟是否直接由任务结构表征的形成时间决定。
Method: 在模加法任务上，使用监督对比损失注入三种表征先验：真实结构(a+b) mod p、错误但周期性的兄弟结构(a-b) mod p、随机划分；并设计权重范数匹配控制实验及范数钳制验证机制。
Result: 真实结构先验22/30运行泛化，兄弟结构14/15泛化，随机结构0/20泛化（Fisher p=1.3e-7）；范数钳制带来中位数8.6倍加速（最高22倍），且残留停滞消失。
Conclusion: Grokking延迟因果性地由正确表征结构的形成时间决定，决策在特征层面而非标签层面。

papers.title: Governing Generative AI Across Financial Institutions: An SR 26-2-Compatible Framework for Generative AI Risk Control
papers.abstract_en: The release of SR 26-2 marks a significant modernization of U.S. model risk management by replacing SR 11-7 with a more risk-based and materiality-sensitive supervisory framework. However, generative and agentic AI are excluded, creating an important governance challenge for banking organizations and other financial institutions. Although generative AI may not directly estimate credit risk or make underwriting decisions, its outputs can materially affect the surrounding control environment through monitoring interpretation, policy analysis, or adverse-action language drafting. These uses may influence how regulated financial decisions are explained, challenged, documented, and governed. This paper proposes the Generative AI Control Framework (GAICF), an SR 26-2-compatible governance framework for generative AI-enabled financial workflows. The framework translates core model risk management principles into a layered control structure for generative AI applications that operate outside the formal model boundary but remain embedded within regulated banking processes. GAICF provides a practical approach for financial institutions seeking to align emerging generative AI governance practices with the risk-based supervisory expectations reflected in SR 26-2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对美国监管更新SR 26-2将生成式AI排除在模型风险管理之外的问题，提出了生成式AI控制框架（GAICF），该框架兼容SR 26-2，将核心模型风险管理原则转化为适用于生成式AI的分层控制结构，帮助金融机构在正式模型边界外管理生成式AI风险。
Motivation: SR 26-2取代SR 11-7，采用基于风险和重要性的监管框架，但明确排除生成式和代理式AI，而生成式AI的输出可能通过监控解释、政策分析等影响金融机构的控制环境，形成治理缺口。
Method: 提出生成式AI控制框架（GAICF），将核心模型风险管理原则转化为分层控制结构，专门针对在正式模型边界外运行但仍嵌入受监管银行流程的生成式AI应用。
Result: 提供了一个实用的方法，使金融机构能够将新兴的生成式AI治理实践与SR 26-2基于风险的监管期望对齐。
Conclusion: GAICF框架为金融机构在生成式AI未被纳入正式模型管理的情况下，提供了一条符合监管期望的风险管理路径。

papers.title: Leveraging Pathology Co-occurrence for Test-Time Adaptation in Chest X-Ray Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Medical imaging models often degrade when deployed at new clinical sites due to differences in imaging equipment, protocols, and patient populations. Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses this by updating a pretrained model using only unlabeled target data, without access to source data. However, existing TTA methods were designed for single-label classification on natural image benchmarks, minimizing entropy uniformly across all samples without considering label dependencies. This overlooks a key property of multi-label medical imaging: pathologies do not occur independently but exhibit structured co-occurrence patterns. In this work, we propose Co-occurrence Weighted Adaptation (CoWA), which leverages disease co-occurrence patterns as a reliability signal for adaptation. CoWA estimates label co-occurrence structure from model predictions and downweights samples that deviate from expected patterns, enabling adaptation to rely more on consistent predictions while reducing the impact of noisy ones. We evaluate CoWA on chest X-ray benchmarks under domain shifts and demonstrate consistent improvements over established baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Co-occurrence Weighted Adaptation (CoWA) 方法，利用病理共现模式作为可靠性信号，在测试时自适应阶段对偏离预期共现模式的样本降权，从而提升胸部X光诊断模型在域迁移下的性能。在胸部X光基准上，CoWA 相较于现有测试时自适应方法取得一致改进。
Motivation: 现有测试时自适应方法（如最小化熵）未考虑多标签医学影像中病理之间的结构化共现关系，导致对噪声样本的过度适应。
Method: CoWA 从模型预测中估计标签共现结构，对偏离该结构的样本赋予较低权重，使自适应更依赖一致性高的预测。
Result: 在胸部X光域迁移基准上，CoWA 优于多种基线方法。
Conclusion: 利用病理共现模式作为可靠性信号，可提升多标签医学影像测试时自适应性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GrowFields: Compositional 4D Neural Fields for Topology-Changing Plant Growth
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying plant growth dynamics from sparse longitudinal 3D observations is fundamental for agriculture and plant sciences. Yet, plants pose unique challenges: they undergo intricate non-rigid deformations, exhibit changing topology as new organs emerge, and often lack explicit temporal correspondences between consecutive data acquisitions due to newly formed tissue. Methods designed for general scenes struggle to model topology changes and asynchronous organ growth characteristic of plants. To address these challenges, we introduce GrowFields, a compositional dynamic neural field representation for organ-aware 4D plant growth modelling from point cloud time series. Our approach decomposes a plant into its constituent organs and aligns each organ into its own canonical coordinate frame, isolating intrinsic growth patterns from global plant motion. We then learn a shared continuous neural deformation field that models temporal dynamics across all organs, conditioned on learnable per-organ latent codes capturing organ identity and growth characteristics. The resulting modular yet unified representation naturally accommodates the asynchronous development of plant organs while remaining grounded in the practical setting of organ-level plant tracking. We evaluate GrowFields on growth sequences from four plant species, assessing geometric fitting and organ tracking accuracy using manually annotated leaf-tip trajectories. Results demonstrate consistent improvements in spatial precision, temporal coherence, and morphological fidelity over a range of existing representations.
papers.comment: ECCV 2026 paper (main conference). v2 corrects the vertical guide lines in supplementary Figures 5-7. Project page and code available at https://joaquin-gajardo.github.io/growfields/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GrowFields，一种组合式动态神经场表示，用于从点云时间序列对植物生长进行器官感知的4D建模。该方法将植物分解为器官并各自对齐到规范坐标系，再通过共享的连续神经变形场和可学习的器官潜在代码来建模异步生长动态。在四个植物物种的序列上评估，结果显示其在空间精度、时间一致性和形态保真度上优于现有表示。
Motivation: 植物生长建模面临拓扑变化（新器官出现）、器官异步生长以及缺乏时间对应等挑战，现有通用方法难以处理这些特性。
Method: 采用组合式动态神经场，将植物分解为器官并将每个器官变换到规范坐标系，学习一个共享的神经变形场，通过可学习的器官潜在代码（per-organ latent codes）来捕获器官身份和生长特征，从而建模时间动态。
Result: 在四个植物物种的生长序列上评估了几何拟合和器官跟踪精度（使用人工标注的叶尖轨迹），结果表明相比现有表示方法，在空间精度、时间一致性和形态保真度上取得了一致改进。
Conclusion: 该组合式表示能够自然处理植物器官的异步发展，同时保持在器官级植物追踪的实际设置中有效。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MambaLIE: Scene Light Intensity-Boosted Low-Light Image Enhancement with State Space Model
papers.abstract_en: Images captured by consumer electronic devices, such as mobile phones and digital cameras, often suffer from low-light degradation due to sensor limitations and imaging pipelines, which degrades visual quality and affects downstream vision tasks. Existing methods based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Transformers have dominated current low-light image enhancement (LIE) due to their excellent ability to model hierarchical features. However, CNNs operate in local receptive fields that cannot model long-range dependencies, while Transformers overcome this problem but incur substantial computational costs. To address these challenges, we propose MambaLIE, a Scene Light Intensity-Boosted Low-Light Image Enhancement method based on a State Space Model (SSM). We first introduce scene light intensity to improve the structural distribution of illumination, which is then gated with the low-light input to guide enhancement. To better model the illumination while maintaining computational efficiency, we propose the Locally Enhanced State Space Model (LESSM) for efficient light enhancement. Our LESSM contains two branches: an SSM branch and a Local Enhanced branch, where the former is used to model the long-range dependencies with linear time complexity, while the latter is used to enhance local feature representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MambaLIE outperforms state-of-the-art CNN-based and Transformer-based LIE methods on four widely used synthetic benchmarks and five publicly available real-world benchmarks in terms of accuracy, speed, and model size, making it suitable for practical deployment on resource-constrained devices.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Consumer Electronics. Code: https://github.com/ghfkahfk/MambaLIEcode
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MambaLIE，一种基于状态空间模型(SSM)的低光图像增强方法。通过引入场景光强(scene light intensity)改善光照分布，并设计Locally Enhanced State Space Model (LESSM)，包含SSM分支（线性时间建模长程依赖）和局部增强分支（增强局部特征）。在四个合成基准和五个真实基准上，MambaLIE在精度、速度和模型大小上均超越现有CNN和Transformer方法，适合资源受限设备部署。
Motivation: 现有CNN方法受限于局部感受野，无法建模长程依赖；Transformer虽能解决但计算成本高。目标是在低光图像增强中同时实现长程依赖建模和计算效率。
Method: 提出MambaLIE框架：首先计算场景光强并门控低光输入以引导增强；核心模块LESSM包含两个分支——SSM分支（线性复杂度建模长程依赖）和局部增强分支（强化局部特征表示）。
Result: 在四个合成低光基准和五个真实世界低光基准上，MambaLIE在PSNR、SSIM等指标上超越SOTA CNN和Transformer方法，同时推理速度更快、模型更小。
Conclusion: MambaLIE在精度、速度和模型大小上的综合优势使其适用于消费电子设备上的实际部署，如手机和数码相机。

papers.title: GAP-GDRNet: Geometry-aware monocular 6D pose estimation for spacecraft using synthetic geometric supervision
papers.abstract_en: Monocular spacecraft 6D pose estimation remains difficult under weak texture, thin structures, illumination variation, and occlusion. This article presents GAP-GDRNet, a geometry-aware RGB framework built on GDR-Net for a single-target synthetic spacecraft benchmark. The method strengthens the geometry-guided regression pipeline at two points. First, AFR is placed before dense geometric prediction to combine global structural attention with local weak-texture enhancement. Second, PGSA is inserted into Patch-PnP to relate downsampled geometric regions before final pose regression. Dense supervision is obtained from a Blender-based rendering and annotation process that provides masks, model-coordinate maps, camera intrinsics, and 6D pose labels. On the self-built spacecraft dataset, GAP-GDRNet achieves a rotation error of $1.96^\circ$, a translation error of 0.0165 m, and 95.16\% ADD@0.02 m, outperforming the reproduced GDR-Net baseline by 3.88 percentage points while running at 35.97 FPS. Tests on T-LESS and LM-O further show consistent gains over the reproduced baseline on textureless and occluded non-spacecraft objects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GAP-GDRNet，一种基于 RGB 的单目航天器 6D 姿态估计方法，在 GDR-Net 基础上引入全局结构注意力与局部弱纹理增强模块 AFR 以及区域关系模块 PGSA，利用 Blender 生成密集几何监督。在自建航天器数据集上旋转误差 1.96°，平移误差 0.0165 m，ADD@0.02 m 达 95.16%，超越 GDR-Net 基线 3.88 个百分点，同时在 T-LESS 和 LM-O 上也有提升。
Motivation: 单目航天器 6D 姿态估计在弱纹理、薄结构、光照变化和遮挡情况下仍然困难，现有方法精度不足。
Method: 基于 GDR-Net 框架，在密集几何预测前插入 AFR 模块融合全局结构注意力和局部弱纹理增强，在 Patch-PnP 中引入 PGSA 以关联降采样几何区域，并通过 Blender 渲染管线生成掩码、模型坐标图、相机内参和 6D 标签作为密集监督。
Result: 在自建航天器数据集上旋转误差 1.96°，平移误差 0.0165 m，ADD@0.02 m 为 95.16%，比复现的 GDR-Net 基线提升 3.88 个百分点，推理速度 35.97 FPS；在 T-LESS 和 LM-O 上也一致优于基线。

papers.title: Search-based Testing of Vision Language Models for In-Car Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: In the automotive domain, in-car scene understanding (ISU) enables the detection of safety-critical events, such as driver distraction, and supports drivers or passengers by analyzing the in-car scene and adapting the environment (e.g., ambient lighting). The industry is increasingly exploring vision-language models (VLMs) to interpret camera-recorded in-car scenes and extract information for downstream reasoning tasks. However, VLMs may generate incomplete, erroneous, or misleading scene descriptions, highlighting the need for systematic testing. Collecting real in-vehicle data is costly, difficult to scale, and often infeasible, particularly in early design stages. In this paper, we present ISU-Test, an automated testing approach that combines rendering-based scene generation with search-based testing to evaluate ISU systems. By framing testing as an optimization problem and systematically modifying scene parameters, our method generates diverse in-car scenarios and explores a wide range of configurations. We evaluate ISU-Test on both an industrial prototype and open-source VLMs across two case studies: question answering and captioning, comparing against randomized scenario generation. Results show that ISU-Test significantly outperforms the baseline, achieving up to 10 times higher failure rates and up to 3.6 times higher failure coverage.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Industry Track of the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ISU-Test，一种结合渲染场景生成和基于搜索的测试的自动化方法，用于测试车载场景理解（ISU）系统中的视觉语言模型（VLM）。通过将测试建模为优化问题并系统修改场景参数，该方法生成多样化车内场景。在两个案例研究（问答和描述）中，ISU-Test相比随机场景生成，失败率提高最多10倍，失败覆盖率提高最多3.6倍。
Motivation: 车载场景理解系统依赖VLM生成场景描述，但VLM可能产生错误或不完整的描述，需要系统测试。收集真实车内数据成本高、难以规模化，尤其在早期设计阶段。
Method: 提出ISU-Test，将测试视为优化问题，通过渲染生成场景并结合搜索算法系统修改场景参数，以生成多样化且能触发失败的场景。
Result: 在工业原型和开源VLM上，ISU-Test相比随机场景生成，失败率提高最多10倍，失败覆盖率提高最多3.6倍。
Conclusion: 该方法在早期设计阶段无需真实数据即可有效测试VLM的车内场景理解能力，但未提及对实际部署场景的适用性或其他局限。

papers.title: Generalization in offline RL: The structure is more important than the amount of pessimism
papers.abstract_en: While pessimism counteracts overestimation bias in offline reinforcement learning (RL), being overly conservative has been associated with hindering certain forms of generalization. However, in this paper we demonstrate that being overly pessimistic does not inherently prevent optimal generalization in contextual MDPs (CMDPs). Instead, we argue successful generalization depends not on the amount of pessimism, but whether the pessimistic structure respects the underlying symmetries of the optimal solution. We prove that a mildly pessimistic, non-symmetric value function can generalize worse than an overly pessimistic, symmetric one. In offline RL, the structure of the pessimism is determined by the structure of the dataset coverage. As such, enforcing a symmetric value function can be non-trivial, and might require techniques such as data augmentation (DA). Inspired by our theoretical results, we argue that DA can best be applied through a consistency loss during policy extraction, rather than the common practice of (regular) offline training on an augmented dataset. This is empirically validated using IQL and CQL on a rotationally symmetric reacher environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究离线强化学习中的泛化问题，证明过度悲观并不必然阻碍最优泛化，关键在于悲观结构是否尊重最优解的内在对称性。作者理论证明非对称的轻度悲观值函数比对称的过度悲观值函数泛化更差，并指出数据集覆盖决定悲观结构。受理论启发，提出数据增强应通过策略提取时的一致性损失来应用，而非通常的增强数据集训练。在旋转对称的reacher环境中使用IQL和CQL进行了实证验证。
Motivation: 现有工作认为过度保守会阻碍离线强化学习的泛化，但本文质疑这一观点，试图厘清泛化效果的决定因素。
Method: 通过理论分析证明悲观结构（是否对称）比悲观量更重要，并据此提出在策略提取阶段使用数据增强一致性损失的技术方案。
Result: 在旋转对称的reacher环境中，使用IQL和CQL的实证结果支持理论结论：对称的悲观值函数即使过度悲观也能取得更好的泛化。
Conclusion: 离线RL的泛化表现取决于悲观结构而非悲观程度，建议采用一致性损失在策略提取阶段而非训练阶段应用数据增强。

papers.title: ContextSniper: AntTrail's Token-Efficient Code Memory for Repository-Level Program Repair
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents can repair real repository issues, but they often spend large context budgets on whole-file reads, broad searches, and long terminal outputs where useful evidence is mixed with irrelevant code and logs. This paper presents ContextSniper, AntTrail's code-repair module for precision evidence selection in repository-level program repair, part of AntTrail's broader agent-memory engine. AntTrail is available at https://gitcode.com/datagallery/AntTrail. ContextSniper indexes code and action memory as three abstract levels, retrieves candidates with a hybrid ranker, filters long tool output through an intention-aware context gate, and returns compact evidence packets while keeping full source recoverable on demand. In a matched 50-task-per-condition comparison on SWE-bench Lite (same tasks, baseline vs.\ ContextSniper), ContextSniper reduces total token use by 51.5% and logged cost by 36.4% for OpenClaw, and by 38.9% and 27.3% for Claude Code, with submitted-resolution rates essentially unchanged in both host-agent settings. In a separate five-task comparison, ContextSniper beats existing memory- and RAG-style integrations on token efficiency. These results suggest ContextSniper can substantially cut token and cost overhead for repository-level repair agents without a measurable loss in repair quality. The evaluation harness for this study is available at https://gitcode.com/lukchiwang/ContextSniper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ContextSniper是AntTrail代码修复模块，通过三层抽象索引、混合排序器和意图感知上下文门控，在仓库级程序修复中精确选择证据，减少token使用。在SWE-bench Lite上对比，ContextSniper将OpenClaw的token使用降低51.5%，成本降低36.4%，修复率基本不变。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体在修复仓库级问题时，常因全文件读取、广泛搜索和长终端输出而消耗大量上下文预算，其中有效证据与无关代码和日志混杂，效率低下。
Method: ContextSniper将代码和动作记忆索引为三个抽象层次，使用混合排序器检索候选，通过意图感知上下文门控过滤长工具输出，返回紧凑证据包，同时保留完整源码的可恢复性。
Result: 在50任务对比中，ContextSniper使OpenClaw的token使用降低51.5%，成本降低36.4%；对Claude Code分别降低38.9%和27.3%，提交解决率基本不变。在5任务比较中，ContextSniper在token效率上优于现有内存和RAG集成方法。
Conclusion: ContextSniper能显著减少仓库级修复智能体的token和成本开销，且不造成可测量的修复质量损失。

papers.title: Theoria: Rewrite-Acceptability Verification over Informal Reasoning States
papers.abstract_en: When should an AI system's answer be trusted? Formal proof assistants offer certainty but cannot reach most of the problem distribution; scalar LLM judges offer coverage but produce opaque scores that cannot be audited after the fact and are subject to the same coherence issues as any LLM. We present Theoria, a verification architecture that closes this gap. A candidate solution is rewritten into a sequence of typed state transitions, each licensed by an explicit justification, whether that be a citation, computation, or problem-given fact, and every transition is independently auditable. The foundational invariant is completeness of change: every difference between consecutive proof states must be accounted for, so hidden premises surface as unlicensed mutations rather than passing silently. On HLE-Verified Gold (185 text-only expert problems), Theoria certifies 105 at 91.4% strict precision (Wilson 95% CI [84.5%, 95.4%]). Every certification produces a human readable proof trace in which each step can be independently challenged. Holistic LLM judges achieve comparable precision at matched coverage but fail on different problems (Jaccard 0.14-0.36), making the approaches complementary. On 95 adversarial poisoned proofs across 15 domains, structured judges catch 94.7% versus 83.2% for holistic judging (p= 0.0017). The overall 11.5 pp gap concentrates in hidden premises (90.6% vs. 62.5%, a 28 pp difference) and fabricated citations (100% vs. 90%), the error classes where the formal analysis predicts an advantage; performance is identical on arithmetic and theorem-misapplication errors, where no advantage is predicted. On GPQA Diamond (n= 65), certified precision is 97.1% (Wilson CI [85.1%, 99.5%]).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Theoria，一种验证架构，通过将候选解答重写为带有显式理由的序列化状态转换，实现可审计的推理验证。在 HLE-Verified Gold 上，Theoria 以 91.4% 的严格精确率认证了 105 个问题，生成的证明痕迹每步均可独立挑战。与整体式 LLM 判断器相比，两者错误类型互补（Jaccard 0.14-0.36），在对抗性证据上结构化判断器捕获率更高（94.7% vs 83.2%）。
Motivation: 形式化证明助手覆盖范围有限，而整体式 LLM 判断器产生的不透明分数难以审计且存在一致性问题。需要一种既保证可审计性又保持覆盖范围的验证方法。
Method: 将候选解答重写为按类型化的状态转换序列，每一步由显式理由（引用、计算或问题给定事实）授权，并强制“变更完备性”不变性，即相邻证明状态间的所有差异必须明确解释。
Result: 在 HLE-Verified Gold 上认证 105 个问题，精确率 91.4%（Wilson 95% CI [84.5%, 95.4%]）；在 GPQA Diamond 上认证精确率 97.1%（Wilson CI [85.1%, 99.5%]）。对抗性证据中结构化判断器捕获率 94.7%，高于整体式判断器的 83.2%，优势集中在隐藏前提（90.6% vs 62.5%）和捏造引用（100% vs 90%）。
Conclusion: Theoria 提供了一种可审计、高精确率的推理验证方法，与整体式 LLM 判断器互补，特别擅长捕获隐藏前提和捏造引用类错误。

papers.title: Diffusion-GR2: Diffusion Generative Reasoning Re-ranker
papers.abstract_en: Generative reasoning re-rankers achieve strong recommendation accuracy by emitting a chain-of-thought before re-ordering a candidate list, but they are slow at inference: an autoregressive (AR) decoder spends one sequential forward pass per reasoning token, and the reasoning trace far exceeds the ranking it produces. To reduce this cost, block-diffusion language models decode many positions in parallel over a few denoising steps and are substantially faster, yet naively converting an AR re-ranker into one opens two accuracy gaps: (1) a structural gap: answer positions are denoised in parallel and scored independently, so the decoder emits invalid rankings (duplicated, dropped, or out-of-set identifiers) that AR avoids through left-to-right masking; and (2) a distributional gap: fine-tuning the converted model on fixed teacher trajectories is off-policy relative to its own decoding at inference, leaving a residual accuracy gap. To close both gaps while keeping the speedup, we propose \textbf{Diffusion-GR2}, a recipe that converts our AR reasoning re-ranker (GR2) into a block-diffusion re-ranker. First, conversion fine-tuning (CFT) adapts the AR-initialized diffusion model to denoise the answer into a valid permutation on its own, without an external constrained decoder. Next, on-policy distillation (OPD) then supervises the model on its own decoded trajectories with dense per-token targets from the AR teacher. Finally, we apply a reinforcement-learning (RL) stage against a re-ranking reward on top of OPD's on-policy policy. Experiments on Amazon Beauty demonstrate that Diffusion-GR2 recovers to near-parity with the AR re-ranker, while block-parallel decoding raises decode throughput by $2.4$--$3.5\times$ at the model's reasoning output length. Ablations show that CFT recovers most of the conversion gap, and that on-policy distillation further closes it to the AR reference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Diffusion-GR2，一种将自回归生成式推理重排序器 (GR2) 转换为块扩散模型的方法，以在保持推荐精度的同时提升推理吞吐量。通过转换微调、在线蒸馏和强化学习阶段，弥合结构差距和分布差距，在 Amazon Beauty 数据集上实现与自回归基线相当的精度，解码吞吐量提升 2.4-3.5 倍。
Motivation: 自回归生成式推理重排序器推理速度慢，而直接转换为块扩散模型会导致排序无效和精度损失，需要弥合结构和分布差距。
Method: 提出三阶段训练流程：转换微调 (CFT) 让扩散模型自学习生成有效排列；在线蒸馏 (OPD) 利用自回归教师模型的逐 token 目标进行监督；最后通过强化学习 (RL) 阶段优化重排序奖励。
Result: 在 Amazon Beauty 数据集上，Diffusion-GR2 的推荐精度接近自回归基线，同时解码吞吐量提升 2.4-3.5 倍；消融实验表明 CFT 弥合了大部分转换差距，OPD 进一步缩小了剩余差距。
Conclusion: 块扩散模型可以有效加速生成式重排序，且通过精心设计的训练流程能恢复自回归模型的精度，但方法仅在单一数据集上验证，未讨论其他场景的泛化性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Diffusion-GR2，一种将自回归生成式推理重排序器 (GR2) 转换为块扩散模型的方法，以在保持推荐精度的同时提升推理吞吐量。通过转换微调、在线蒸馏和强化学习阶段，弥合结构差距和分布差距，在 Amazon Beauty 数据集上实现与自回归基线相当的精度，解码吞吐量提升 2.4-3.5 倍。
summary_sections.motivation: 自回归生成式推理重排序器推理速度慢，而直接转换为块扩散模型会导致排序无效和精度损失，需要弥合结构和分布差距。
summary_sections.method: 提出三阶段训练流程：转换微调 (CFT) 让扩散模型自学习生成有效排列；在线蒸馏 (OPD) 利用自回归教师模型的逐 token 目标进行监督；最后通过强化学习 (RL) 阶段优化重排序奖励。
summary_sections.result: 在 Amazon Beauty 数据集上，Diffusion-GR2 的推荐精度接近自回归基线，同时解码吞吐量提升 2.4-3.5 倍；消融实验表明 CFT 弥合了大部分转换差距，OPD 进一步缩小了剩余差距。
summary_sections.conclusion: 块扩散模型可以有效加速生成式重排序，且通过精心设计的训练流程能恢复自回归模型的精度，但方法仅在单一数据集上验证，未讨论其他场景的泛化性。

papers.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Video Diffusion Models for Hand Motion Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: 4D hand motion reconstruction from egocentric video is bottlenecked by clear limitations of existing methods: image-based pipelines depend on a detector that fails under heavy occlusion, while video-based methods rely on temporal modules learned only from scarce hand-pose annotations, a narrow signal insufficient to model motion dynamics, occlusion reasoning, and hand-object interaction. These capabilities, however, are exactly what video generative models must implicitly acquire when trained to synthesize coherent video at internet scale. Motivated by this, we present ViDiHand, which leverages the representations of a pretrained video diffusion model to reconstruct 4D two-hand pose. We adapt it via a hand-overlay rendering objective that specializes its features for hands while preserving its world priors. A decoder then recovers metric-scale pose from the adapted features. The whole pipeline operates directly on full frames--no detector, no infiller, and no test-time optimization. On ARCTIC, HOT3D, and HOI4D, ViDiHand substantially outperforms prior methods, establishing video diffusion models as a powerful new foundation for hand motion reconstruction and a promising route to scalable in-the-wild data collection for embodied AI. Project page: https://vidihand.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ViDiHand，利用预训练视频扩散模型的表征进行4D双手姿态重建，无需检测器、补全模块或测试时优化。在ARCTIC、HOT3D和HOI4D数据集上显著超越先前方法。
Motivation: 现有基于图像的方法在严重遮挡下失效，基于视频的方法因手部姿态标注稀缺而难以建模运动动力学、遮挡推理和手物交互。视频生成模型在互联网规模训练中隐式习得了这些能力。
Method: ViDiHand通过手部覆盖渲染目标适配预训练视频扩散模型的特征，使其专精于手部同时保留世界先验，再用解码器从适配特征恢复公制尺度姿态。
Result: 在ARCTIC、HOT3D和HOI4D数据集上，ViDiHand大幅优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 视频扩散模型可作为手部运动重建的强大新基础，并为具身智能的野外数据规模化采集提供可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bricker to BRACE: A Bracket Exposure RAW Dataset and Restoration Model for Flicker-Banding
papers.abstract_en: Flicker-banding (FB), arises from temporal aliasing between a camera's rolling shutter and a display's brightness modulation, degrading screen-captured image readability with color shifts and jagged patterns. Existing single-frame methods with simplified parametric stripe models cannot reliably distinguish these artifacts from genuine texture. To address this, we conduct a systematic analysis of complex FB morphologies and reveal their significant variation across exposure settings, motivating a multi-frame bracketed RAW restoration paradigm. We construct Bricker, a synthetic-real bracketed RAW dataset built via ray-tracing-based physical simulation and automated multi-exposure capture tool. We further propose BRACE: Bracketed RAW Flicker-Banding Removal, a multi-frame restoration model that utilizes frequency-aware banding prior and a multi-scale spatial cross-attention modulator (MSCAM) for cross-exposure spatial fusion. We also introduce the Stripe Frequency Consistency (SFC) metric to evaluate banding removal. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real benchmarks. Our dataset and code are available at: https://github.com/ZZH-qwq/BRACE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对屏幕拍摄图像中的闪烁条带（flicker-banding）问题，构建了Bricker数据集（基于光线追踪的合成-真实RAW数据集），并提出BRACE多帧恢复模型，利用频率感知条纹先验和多尺度空间交叉注意力调制器（MSCAM）进行跨曝光空间融合，同时引入条带频率一致性（SFC）指标。实验表明在合成和真实基准上达到最优性能。
Motivation: 现有单帧方法无法可靠区分闪烁条带与真实纹理，且对复杂FB形态分析不足，需要更系统的多帧RAW恢复范式。
Method: 通过光线追踪物理模拟和自动多曝光采集工具构建Bricker数据集；提出BRACE模型，包含频率感知条纹先验和多尺度空间交叉注意力调制器（MSCAM）用于跨曝光融合；并设计条带频率一致性（SFC）指标。
Result: 在合成和真实基准上达到state-of-the-art性能，代码和数据开源。
Conclusion: 本文的BRACE方法和数据集为闪烁条带去除提供了新范式，验证了多帧RAW恢复的有效性。

papers.title: How to Leverage Synthetic Speech for LLM-Based ASR Systems?
papers.abstract_en: In regulated domains such as banking and healthcare, where privacy constraints make real speech costly to collect and retain, synthetic speech from modern text-to-speech (TTS) is an appealing alternative for training automatic speech recognition (ASR) without exposing sensitive customer recordings. Yet a persistent distributional gap between synthetic and real data limits how far it can replace genuine recordings. Prior work largely treats this gap as a black box to be engineered around, but in our work, we instead examine its origin directly by probing a SLAM-ASR architecture. Then, we localise where its LLM backbone separates real from synthetic speech and find the discriminative signal concentrated in the early-to-middle layers, where temporal and prosodic perturbations disrupt it most. We further show that representation-level separability, help, but does not directly predict downstream ASR gains. On the other hand, convolving synthetic audio with room impulse responses (RIRs) narrows the gap not by making synthetic speech sound cleaner or more natural, but by reproducing the acoustic irregularities of real recordings. Translating these findings into the training procedure, by adding a layer-selection module combined with RIR augmentation matches a fully real-data baseline using only 25% of the real speech (13.6h) and surpasses it at all higher proportions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨如何利用合成语音训练基于LLM的ASR系统，以应对银行、医疗等隐私敏感领域的数据收集限制。通过分析SLAM-ASR架构，发现LLM骨干网络的早期到中间层能区分真实与合成语音，且时序和韵律扰动影响最大。结合房间脉冲响应（RIR）增强和层选择模块，仅用25%的真实语音（13.6小时）即可达到全真实数据基线的性能，更高比例时甚至超越。
Motivation: 合成语音与真实语音之间存在持续分布差距，限制了其完全替代真实录音的能力，而先前研究多将此差距视为黑箱进行工程绕行，缺乏对成因的直接理解。
Method: 使用SLAM-ASR架构，通过探针分析定位LLM骨干网络中区分真实与合成语音的层，发现辨别信号集中在早期到中间层。提出在训练中加入层选择模块，并结合RIR增强处理合成音频，以复现真实录音的声学不规则性。
Result: 在仅使用25%（13.6小时）真实语音的条件下，系统性能与全真实数据基线持平；当使用更高比例的真实语音时，性能甚至超越基线。
Conclusion: 通过定向分析合成语音与真实语音的差异来源，并采用RIR增强和层选择针对性优化，可以显著缩小分布差距，使合成语音高效辅助ASR训练。

papers.title: PanoImager: Geometry-Guided Novel View Synthesis and Reconstruction from Sparse Panoramic Views
papers.abstract_en: Panoramic sensing offers wide field-of-view coverage, yet 3D reconstruction from sparse panoramas remains challenging under rotation-dominant, weak-parallax motion. In such regimes, SfM/SLAM initialization is often ill-conditioned and unreliable. We present PanoImager, an SfM-free framework that combines feed-forward pose/depth priors, geometry-conditioned diffusion view completion, and depth-guided 3DGS optimization. Given only a few panoramic images, PanoImager decomposes them into local perspective views, synthesizes auxiliary observations to enrich sparse evidence, and stabilizes Gaussian optimization for improved cross-view consistency. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show improved stability under extreme sparsity, suggesting PanoImager as an offline/background component for map refinement when SfM/SLAM fails to initialize.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PanoImager，一种无需SfM的框架，用于从稀疏全景图像进行3D重建和新视角合成。通过前馈深度/位姿先验、几何条件扩散视图补全和深度引导的3D高斯泼溅优化，在旋转主导、弱视差的稀疏全景场景中提升了重建稳定性和跨视图一致性。
Motivation: 在旋转主导、弱视差运动下，稀疏全景图像的SfM/SLAM初始化通常病态且不可靠，导致3D重建困难。
Method: PanoImager将稀疏全景图像分解为局部透视视图，利用几何条件扩散模型合成辅助观测以丰富稀疏证据，并通过深度引导的3D高斯泼溅优化来稳定跨视图一致性。
Result: 在多个基准上，该方法在极端稀疏条件下展现出更优的稳定性，可作为SfM/SLAM初始化失败时的离线/后台地图精化组件。
Conclusion: PanoImager有效解决了弱视差稀疏全景图像的3D重建问题，但可能依赖于前馈先验的质量，且主要适用于离线场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeCoFlow: Structural Decomposition of Normalizing Flows for Continual Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: In industrial environments, new product categories arrive sequentially, requiring continual anomaly detection without access to past data. Normalizing Flows (NFs) provide exact density estimation but suffer from catastrophic forgetting as parameter updates across tasks distort the density manifold. While parameter isolation can prevent interference, it must preserve the strict invertibility and Jacobian validity of NFs. To satisfy these requirements, we exploit the inherent property that affine coupling layers maintain transformation validity regardless of subnet parameterization. Based on this, we propose DeCoFlow, which decomposes subnets into a frozen universal base and task-specific low-rank adapters to isolate updates. We further introduce Task-Specific Alignment, Auxiliary Coupling Layers, and Tail-Aware Loss to compensate for frozen-base rigidity. DeCoFlow achieves state-of-the-art image-level AUROCs of 98.40% on MVTec-AD and 93.00% on VisA, while maintaining parameter-level zero forgetting (0.00% FM under correct routing) with only 2.27M parameters per task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeCoFlow，一种基于归一化流（Normalizing Flows）的持续异常检测方法。该方法通过将子网络分解为冻结的通用基和任务特定的低秩适配器来隔离参数更新，从而避免灾难性遗忘。同时引入任务特定对齐、辅助耦合层和尾部感知损失以补偿冻结基的刚性。在MVTec-AD和VisA工业异常检测基准上，DeCoFlow分别达到98.40%和93.00%的AUROC，实现参数级零遗忘且每任务仅2.27M参数。
Motivation: 工业环境中新产品类别顺序出现，需要持续异常检测且无法访问旧数据。归一化流虽然能提供精确密度估计，但参数更新会导致密度流形扭曲和灾难性遗忘，现有参数隔离方法需满足严格的可逆性和雅可比有效性要求。
Method: 利用仿射耦合层（affine coupling layers）的子网络参数化不影响变换有效性的特性，将子网络分解为冻结的通用基和任务特定低秩适配器；并引入任务特定对齐、辅助耦合层和尾部感知损失来缓解冻结基带来的刚性。
Result: 在MVTec-AD上达到98.40% AUROC，在VisA上达到93.00% AUROC，且参数级遗忘率为0.00%（正确路由下），每任务仅2.27M参数。
Conclusion: 所提结构分解策略能有效避免持续异常检测中的灾难性遗忘，同时保持参数高效和密度估计准确性。

papers.title: Play2Perfect: What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining for Precise Assembly?
papers.abstract_en: Multi-fingered robots promise the speed and dexterity of human hands, yet challenging problems such as precise assembly have remained out of reach. These tasks are contact-rich, making data collection for imitation learning difficult, and sparse-reward, making direct exploration with reinforcement learning (RL) intractable. Consequently, prior work has made progress by structuring the problem with specialized grippers, tool attachments, and environment fixtures. In this work, we argue that before a robot can perfect precise assembly, it must first learn to play. We further ask the question: what factors in the process of learning to play matter for precise assembly? We propose Play2Perfect, an RL framework for task-agnostic pretraining through play on diverse objects and goals, which is then perfected on precise assembly. The goal of play is to acquire reusable manipulation priors, such as grasping, in-hand reorientation and pose reaching. Finetuning then adapts this general prior to assembly, focusing exploration on the final contact-rich, high-precision interactions needed for success. We systematically study key design choices in play pretraining, including object diversity, training objective, trajectory diversity, and goal precision. We show that our prior is 33x more sample-efficient than RL training from scratch, even when provided with dense, multi-stage rewards. We demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, achieving 60% success on tight insertions with only 0.5 mm contact clearance, and over 50% success on long-horizon multi-part assembly and screwing.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Play2Perfect，一个通过玩耍预训练（play pretraining）获取灵巧操作先验，再微调用于精密装配的强化学习框架。在多种物体和目标上无任务预训练，获得抓取、手中重定向和姿态到达等可复用操作先验，然后微调用于精密装配。系统研究了物体多样性、训练目标、轨迹多样性和目标精度等关键设计选择。实验表明，预训练先验相比从零强化学习样本效率提升33倍，并实现了零样本仿真到真实迁移，在仅有0.5毫米间隙的紧装配中达到60%成功率，在多部件装配和拧螺丝任务中超过50%成功率。
Motivation: 多指灵巧手在精密装配等接触丰富、奖励稀疏的任务中面临数据收集困难和探索难题，现有工作依赖专用夹爪、工具和环境固定装置。本文认为机器人应先学会“玩耍”来获取通用操作先验，再用于精密装配。
Method: Play2Perfect框架：首先通过强化学习在多样物体和目标上进行任务无关的玩耍预训练，学习抓取、手中重定向、姿态到达等操作先验；然后微调这些先验用于精密装配，聚焦于最后的高精度接触交互。系统研究预训练中的物体多样性、训练目标、轨迹多样性和目标精度等设计选择。
Result: 预训练先验相比从零强化学习样本效率提升33倍（即使使用密集多阶段奖励）。零样本仿真到真实迁移：紧装配（0.5毫米间隙）成功率60%，长时多部件装配和拧螺丝任务成功率超过50%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调玩耍预训练是获得灵巧操作先验的有效方式，关键因素包括物体和轨迹多样性等，先验可高效微调用于精密装配，并实现零样本迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Narration-of-Thought: Inference-Time Scaffolding for Defeasible Ethical Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Standard chain-of-thought on moral dilemmas exhibits two failure modes: stakeholder collapse (the trace names at most one party with a stake in the outcome) and uncertainty suppression (no explicit unknowns or hedges before committing to an action). We introduce narration-of-thought (NoT), a system prompt that structures chain-of-thought into five sections: protagonist, stakeholders, two-step consequences, uncertainty, then commitment. NoT adds no training, parameters, or fine-tuning. On 100 DailyDilemmas scenarios across four generators from three vendors, NoT cuts stakeholder collapse from up to 31% to under 1% and uncertainty suppression from up to 72% to 1-24% on every model. A matched-budget verbose-CoT control rules out token spend as the active ingredient; NoT retains Cliff's delta advantages of +0.79 to +0.90 on stakeholder count and +0.65 to +0.93 on uncertainty score for three of four generators, and a section ablation attributes each shift to its specific sub-instruction. Textual-gradient descent initialised at NoT improves the scaffold further; a cross-family training judge (different vendor from the generator) dominates an in-family one on every measured axis. Extended to a five-round multi-stakeholder debate protocol, the scaffold converts a 6% standoff into 95% full consensus on a calibration set and 100% combined convergence on a DailyDilemmas replication. The resulting traces externalise the stakeholders, consequences, and uncertainty grounding each commitment, providing an auditable substrate for dependable agentic deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Narration-of-Thought (NoT)，一种无需训练的推理时框架，将链式思维结构化为主角、利益相关者、两步后果、不确定性和承诺五个部分，以解决道德推理中利益相关者崩溃和不确定性抑制问题。在DailyDilemmas场景上的实验表明，NoT显著降低了这两种失败模式，并通过消融实验、文本梯度下降和多轮辩论协议进一步提升了性能。
Motivation: 标准链式思维在道德困境中常出现利益相关者崩溃（只提及一方利益相关者）和不确定性抑制（在做出承诺前不明确表达未知或保留意见），导致推理不完整且缺乏可审计性。
Method: NoT通过系统提示强制链式思维依次输出五个部分：主角、利益相关者、两步后果、不确定性、承诺。无需训练或微调，并引入文本梯度下降和跨家族评判员优化。
Result: 在四个生成器上，NoT将利益相关者崩溃从高达31%降至1%以下，不确定性抑制从高达72%降至1-24%，且Cliff's delta优势显著。拓展到多轮辩论协议后，僵局转化为95-100%的共识。
Conclusion: NoT为道德推理提供了可审计的推理轨迹，适用于需要可靠决策的代理部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: video-SALMONN-R$^3$: Learning to ReWatch, ReAsk, and ReAnswer for Efficient Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Video large language models (LLMs) are often constrained by computation and memory budgets, leading them to use reduced frame rates and spatial resolutions, which may cause them to miss critical information for question answering (QA). A practical and efficient solution is a two-stage paradigm: first perform coarse video understanding to localize relevant segments, and then re-watch these segments at higher temporal or spatial fidelity. In this paper, we present video-SALMONN-R$^3$, the first end-to-end video-LLM that enables re-watch through reinforcement learning without relying on chain-of-thought (CoT) cold-start. This design removes the need for costly CoT data annotations and avoids CoT-based supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which can otherwise degrade the pretrained video understanding abilities. To address the mismatch between the reasoning-first behavior induced by re-watch and the answer-first tendency of pretrained video-LLMs, we propose a re-answer strategy, in which the model first produces a direct answer in the first watch and then refines it after re-watching. Finally, to improve question adherence during re-watching, we propose a re-ask mechanism that re-injects the query when revisiting localized segments. Experimental results show that video-SALMONN-R$^3$ consistently outperforms both the base model and the QA-SFT baseline, while surpassing prior re-watch-based approaches with significantly lower computational cost. Code, models, and data will be publicly released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 video-SALMONN-R³，首个通过强化学习实现重看（re-watch）的端到端视频大语言模型，无需链式思考（CoT）冷启动。模型采用两阶段范式：先粗粒度理解定位相关片段，再以高时空精度重看。为缓解重看引发的推理优先与预训练模型回答优先的冲突，提出先直接回答后精炼的重答（re-answer）策略，并引入重问（re-ask）机制在重看时重新注入查询。实验表明，该方法在多个视频问答基准上超越基线和之前的重看方法，且计算成本更低。
Motivation: 现有视频大语言模型受限于计算和内存预算，常使用低帧率和低分辨率，可能错过问答所需关键信息。
Method: 提出两阶段重看范式：第一阶段粗粒度视频理解定位相关片段，第二阶段以高时空精度重看。通过强化学习训练重看行为，无需CoT冷启动；采用重答策略先给出直接答案再在重看后精炼；并设计重问机制在重看时重新注入查询以提高问题遵循度。
Result: 模型在多个视频问答基准上持续优于基模型和QA-SFT基线，并超越先前重看方法，同时显著降低计算成本。
Conclusion: 该方法通过强化学习实现高效重看，避免了CoT数据标注和微调对预训练能力的损害，并提升了视频问答性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SOAP-Bubbles: Structured Weight Uncertainty for Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Structured weight-uncertainty can improve many aspects of deep learning, but it remains costly to estimate and difficult to implement. Here, we show that these issues can be addressed by adapting the SOAP optimizer. Our key idea is to run IVON, an existing diagonal-covariance variational method, in the eigenspace of SOAP's preconditioner and then use the preconditioner to transform the diagonal estimate into a non-diagonal covariance. The resulting method has costs similar to those of SOAP and requires no drastic changes to training pipelines. We call the posteriors obtained in this way SOAP-Bubbles and our new optimizer Eigenspace-VON (EVON). We show that, for logistic regression, EVON recovers the exact Gaussian covariance and that, for language model pretraining, it yields significantly better results than existing diagonal-covariance methods. Our work makes it easier to estimate more expressive posterior distributions for deep learning at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EVON 优化器，通过在 SOAP 优化器的特征空间中运行对角协方差变分法 IVON，再利用预处理矩阵将对角估计转换为非对角协方差，从而以近似 SOAP 的计算成本获得结构化后验不确定性。在逻辑回归上能恢复精确高斯协方差，在语言模型预训练中优于现有对角协方差方法。
Motivation: 结构化权重不确定性在深度学习中很有用，但估计成本高且实现困难，现有对角协方差方法表达能力不足。
Method: 将 IVON 方法应用于 SOAP 预处理器的特征空间，并利用预处理器将对角协方差变换为非对角形式，得到新优化器 Eigenspace-VON (EVON) 和后验估计 SOAP-Bubbles。
Result: 在逻辑回归中精确恢复高斯协方差；在语言模型预训练中显著优于对角协方差方法。
Conclusion: 本文使得在大规模深度学习中估计更具表达能力的后验分布变得更加容易。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving Engine Sound Analysis in Hot-Test Environments via a RAB-U-Net (Residual Attention Block U-Net) Noise Removal Method
papers.abstract_en: During hot tests on a production line, engine-sound analysis is crucial to ensuring product quality and performance. However, background noise often interferes with accurate sound analysis, leading to potential errors in engine diagnostics. Traditionally, skilled technicians listen to engine sounds to assess engine health, but this is prone to significant inaccuracies. This study presents an innovative deep learning-based approach to address this issue by removing background noise from engine sound recordings using a U-Net neural network structure enhanced with Residual Attention Blocks (RAB-U-Net). Our intelligent noise removal system significantly improves the accuracy of engine noise detection, outperforming traditional techniques and providing a robust solution for real-time applications in production line environments. This study proposes a novel system for engine noise detection in production lines, marking a valuable advancement for the automotive industry in applying deep learning methods to improve the quality of engine diagnostics.

TL;DR: 本文针对生产线热测试中发动机声音分析受背景噪声干扰的问题，提出了一种基于U-Net结构并增强残差注意力块（RAB-U-Net）的深度学习方法去除噪声。摘要称该方法显著提高了发动机噪声检测的准确性，优于传统技术，适用于生产线实时应用。
Motivation: 生产线热测试中背景噪声干扰发动机声音分析，传统依赖熟练技工听声诊断存在较大误差。
Method: 提出RAB-U-Net，即在U-Net中集成残差注意力块（Residual Attention Blocks）的噪声去除系统。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在发动机噪声检测准确性上显著优于传统技术，并提供鲁棒的实时解决方案。
Conclusion: 该方法为汽车工业应用深度学习改善发动机诊断质量提供了有价值进展。

papers.title: Does Mixture-of-Experts Actually Help Inference on Consumer and Edge Hardware? An Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models are often described as ideal for resource-constrained inference. Each token activates only a small subset of experts, so the per-token compute cost, in floating-point operations (FLOPs), resembles that of a much smaller dense model. Whether that FLOP advantage survives in practice is far less clear. We ask whether MoE models actually run faster and cheaper than comparable dense models on consumer-grade and edge hardware. We benchmark OLMoE-1B-7B (1.3 B active of 6.9 B total) against three dense baselines on an Apple M2 Pro and an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano 8 GB through llama$.$cpp, measuring throughput, memory, and on-device energy. The answer is device-dependent: OLMoE's active-parameter advantage is only partly realised on the laptop (~10% behind the same-active Llama-3.2-1B) and erodes on the edge device (~31% behind, at 2.1$\times$ the energy per token, with peak memory at the 8 GB ceiling). Patching llama$.$cpp to time the decode graph node-by-node shows routing accounts for under 9% of MoE-block compute on the cleaner edge backend, so the gap reflects total-parameter memory footprint, expert dispatch, and KV-cache pressure rather than routing. The implication is that on bandwidth-bound edge hardware, inference cost tracks total parameters, not active ones, and sparse activation does not buy back what the device is constrained on. These findings are bounded to one MoE model at this parameter scale and two devices, and we release the full measurement harness and per-run data.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 7 tables, 4 figures. Submitted to FAIEMA 2026. Code available at https://github.com/Analytics-Everywhere-Lab/edge-moe
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过基准测试OLMoE-1B-7B与三个密集基线模型在Apple M2 Pro和NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上的吞吐量、内存和能耗，评估MoE模型在消费级和边缘硬件上的实际推理性能。结果显示，活跃参数优势仅在笔记本电脑部分实现（落后约10%），在边缘设备上差距扩大（落后约31%，能耗2.1倍），表明在带宽受限的边缘设备上，推理成本与总参数相关而非活跃参数。
Motivation: 尽管MoE模型在理论上通过稀疏激活降低FLOPs，但在实际的消费级和边缘硬件上是否真正更快更便宜尚不明确。
Method: 在llama.cpp上对OLMoE-1B-7B和三个密集基线进行基准测试，测量吞吐量、内存和能耗，并通过逐节点计时分析解码图。
Result: OLMoE在笔记本电脑上落后于相同活跃参数的Llama-3.2-1B约10%，在边缘设备上落后约31%，能耗2.1倍，峰值内存接近8GB上限。路由仅占MoE块计算的不到9%，差距源于总参数内存占用、专家调度和KV缓存压力。

papers.title: Hierarchical Control in Multi-Agent Games: LLM-based Planning and RL Execution
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved strong performance in sequential decision-making, yet scaling to complex multi-agent environments remains challenging due to sparse rewards, large state-action spaces, and the difficulty of learning coordinated strategies. We propose a hierarchical architecture where a pretrained large language model (LLM) acts as a centralized strategic controller that selects among specialized RL skill policies for a team of agents, while RL policies handle reactive low-level execution. We evaluate this hybrid system in a competitive 2v2 King of the Hill environment against behavior tree (BT) and \emph{``Flat''} RL (end-to-end training without skill decomposition) baselines. The LLM+RL system achieves task performance statistically equivalent to hand-crafted BT (46.4\% vs 51.5\% win rate, $p=0.103$) while both significantly outperform Flat RL trained without skill decomposition. A user study ($n=15$) reveals that 60\% of participants perceive LLM+RL agents as the most human-like ($p=0.027$), citing behavioral adaptability and tactical variability. These results demonstrate that pretrained LLM reasoning can effectively orchestrate pretrained RL skills, achieving competitive multi-agent coordination and superior perceived believability without manual rule engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多智能体强化学习在复杂环境中的扩展难题，提出层次化架构：预训练的大语言模型作为中央战略控制器，选择专门的RL技能策略，RL处理底层执行。在2v2 King of the Hill环境中，LLM+RL系统与行为树（BT）基线性能统计等效（胜率46.4% vs 51.5%，p=0.103），显著优于无技能分解的端到端RL。用户研究（n=15）显示60%参与者认为LLM+RL最像人类（p=0.027）。
Motivation: 多智能体环境中的强化学习面临稀疏奖励、大状态动作空间和协调策略学习困难，需要一种无需手动规则工程即可实现有效协调的方法。
Method: 提出层次架构：顶层使用预训练LLM作为集中式战略控制器，从一组专门化RL技能策略中选择和执行；底层RL策略负责反应式低层执行。
Result: 在竞争性2v2 King of the Hill环境中，LLM+RL系统胜率46.4%，与行为树（51.5%）统计等效（p=0.103），两者均显著优于无技能分解的端到端RL。用户研究中60%参与者认为LLM+RL最像人类（p=0.027）。
Conclusion: 预训练LLM的推理能力可以有效编排预训练RL技能，实现竞争性多智能体协调和更优的感知可信度，无需手动规则工程。

papers.title: TNODEV: Toolbox for Neural ODE Verification
papers.abstract_en: Neural ordinary differential equations (neural ODE) gained attention in safety critical settings such as continuous-time controllers for cyber-physical systems and classifiers integrated into automated decision pipelines, raising the question whether their behavior can be formally verified. Existing tools dedicated to neural ODE provide only a single reachability call without iterative input-set refinement, limiting the precision of their verdicts to whatever one reachability call can deliver. We present TNODEV, the first formal verifier for neural ODE that integrates a falsification checker, a fast interval-based reachability backend based on continuous-time mixed monotonicity, a verification and refinement loop with three input-set splitting heuristics, and a parallel scheduler in a single end-to-end pipeline. TNODEV supports safe-set inclusion verification on pure neural ODE, neural ODE in closed loop with a neural network controller and general neural ODE (GNODE), with the safe set specified either as an interval or as the half-space intersection induced by a target classification label. We evaluate TNODEV on a range of benchmarks across safe-set inclusion and classification-robustness properties, including a direct reachability comparison against NNV 2.0 and CORA and a verification comparison against NNV 2.0 on MNIST general neural ODE classifiers.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 7 figures, Under review in TMLR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TNODEV，首个神经 ODE 形式化验证工具箱，集成假性检查、区间可达性、迭代细化循环与并行调度，支持安全集包含验证（区间或半空间交集）及分类鲁棒性验证。在多项基准上与 NNV 2.0 和 CORA 对比，展示了直接可达性与验证性能。
Motivation: 现有神经 ODE 验证工具仅提供单次可达性调用，缺乏输入集迭代细化，导致判定精度受限。
Method: 集成假性检查器、基于连续时间混合单调性的快速区间可达性后端、三种输入集分裂启发式的验证与细化循环，以及并行调度器。支持纯神经 ODE、闭环神经 ODE 和通用神经 ODE 的安全集包含验证。
Result: 在安全集包含和分类鲁棒性基准上评估，包括与 NNV 2.0 和 CORA 的直接可达性比较，以及在 MNIST 通用神经 ODE 分类器上与 NNV 2.0 的验证比较。
Conclusion: TNODEV 是首个端到端神经 ODE 形式化验证器，可覆盖多种验证场景。
