papers.title: PhasorFlow: A Python Library for Unit Circle Based Computing
papers.abstract_en: We present PhasorFlow, an open-source Python library for computing on the $S^1$ unit circle. Inputs are encoded as complex phasors $z=e^{iφ}$ on the $N$-torus ($\mathbb{T}^N$); as computation proceeds through unitary wave-interference gates, global norm is preserved while components drift into $\mathbb{C}^N$, letting algorithms leverage continuous geometric gradients. PhasorFlow makes three contributions. First, we formalize the Phasor Circuit model ($N$ threads, $M$ gates) with a 22-gate library spanning standard-unitary, non-linear, neuromorphic, and encoding operations under full matrix-algebra simulation. Second, we present the Variational Phasor Circuit (VPC), analogous to variational quantum circuits, optimizing continuous phase parameters for classification. Third, we introduce the Phasor Transformer, replacing $QK^TV$ attention with a parameter-free DFT token-mixing layer inspired by FNet. We validate on spatial classification, time-series prediction, financial volatility, neuromorphic tasks, and -- for the VPC -- real motor-imagery EEG, where it matches standard baselines at a fraction of their parameters. We characterize the models honestly: the VPC is a parameter-efficient phase-linear classifier with a parity ceiling that depth cannot raise, and the Phasor Transformer benefits from depth before saturating, competitive but not superior. This positions unit-circle computing as a deterministic, lightweight paradigm on classical hardware. Available at https://github.com/mindverse-computing/phasorflow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhasorFlow 是一个基于单位圆（S^1）计算的开源 Python 库。它将输入编码为复相量，通过幺正波干涉门进行计算，保持全局范数。该库提供了22个门的相位电路模型、变分相位电路（VPC）以及相位Transformer（用DFT层替代注意力机制）。在空间分类、时间序列预测、金融波动和EEG等任务上进行了验证，VPC在参数效率上匹配基准，但存在奇偶性上限。
Motivation: 现有的计算范式在处理某些任务时参数效率或计算复杂度较高，作者希望探索一种基于单位圆的确定性、轻量级计算范式，在经典硬件上实现高效计算。
Method: 提出 PhasorFlow 库，包含三个主要贡献：形式化相位电路模型（22门库，涵盖幺正、非线性、神经形态和编码操作）、变分相位电路（VPC，优化连续相位参数进行分类）、相位Transformer（用无参数DFT层代替注意力机制）。
Result: 在空间分类、时间序列预测、金融波动、神经形态任务和EEG分类上验证了有效性。VPC在EEG任务上以少部分参数匹配标准基线，相位Transformer深度增加时性能提升但最终饱和，整体竞争力不超越现有方法。
Conclusion: 单位圆计算可作为一种确定性的轻量级计算范式，在经典硬件上有应用潜力，但VPC存在奇偶性上限，相位Transformer性能并非最先进。

papers.title: Safe Flow Q-Learning: Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning with Reachability-Based Flow Policies
papers.abstract_en: Offline safe reinforcement learning (RL) seeks reward-maximizing policies from static datasets under strict safety constraints. Existing methods often rely on soft expected-cost objectives or iterative generative inference, which can be insufficient for safety-critical real-time control. We propose Safe Flow Q-Learning (SafeFQL), which extends FQL to safe offline RL by combining a Hamilton--Jacobi reachability-inspired safety value function with an efficient one-step flow policy. SafeFQL learns the safety value via a self-consistency Bellman recursion, trains a flow policy by behavioral cloning, and distills it into a one-step actor for reward-maximizing safe action selection without rejection sampling at deployment. Empirically, SafeFQL trades modestly higher offline training cost for substantially lower inference latency than diffusion-style safe generative baselines, which is advantageous for real-time safety-critical deployment. Across boat navigation, and Safety Gymnasium MuJoCo tasks, SafeFQL matches or exceeds prior offline safe RL performance while substantially reducing constraint violations.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables; First 2 authors have contributed equally; Paper accepted at Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Safe Flow Q-Learning (SafeFQL)，将流策略扩展到离线安全强化学习，结合Hamilton-Jacobi可达性启发的安全值函数和高效一步流策略。通过自洽Bellman递归学习安全值，行为克隆训练流策略，并蒸馏为一步actor，无需拒绝采样。在船导航和Safety Gymnasium MuJoCo任务中，SafeFQL匹配或超越先前离线安全RL性能，同时大幅减少约束违反，推理延迟低。

Method: SafeFQL结合Hamilton-Jacobi可达性启发的安全值函数和一步流策略；通过自洽Bellman递归学习安全值，通过行为克隆训练流策略并蒸馏为一步actor。
Result: 在船导航和Safety Gymnasium MuJoCo任务中，SafeFQL匹配或超越先前离线安全RL性能，同时大幅减少约束违反；以稍高的离线训练成本换取更低的推理延迟。
Conclusion: SafeFQL在安全关键实时部署中具有优势，无需拒绝采样。

papers.title: Human-like Object Grouping in Self-supervised Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models trained with self-supervised objectives achieve strong performance across diverse tasks and exhibit emergent object segmentation properties. However, their alignment with human object perception remains poorly understood. Here, we introduce a behavioral benchmark in which participants make same/different object judgments for dot pairs on naturalistic scenes, scaling up a classical psychophysics paradigm to over 1000 trials. We test a diverse set of vision models using a simple readout from their representations to predict subjects' reaction times. We observe a steady improvement across model generations, with both architecture and training objective contributing to alignment, and transformer-based models trained with the DINO self-supervised objective showing the strongest performance. To investigate the source of this improvement, we propose a novel metric to quantify the object-centric component of representations by measuring patch similarity within and between objects. Across models, stronger object-centric structure predicts human segmentation behavior more accurately. We further show that matching the Gram matrix of supervised transformer models, capturing similarity structure across image patches, with that of a self-supervised model through distillation improves their alignment with human behavior, converging with the prior finding that Gram anchoring improves DINOv3's feature quality. Together, these results demonstrate that self-supervised vision models capture object structure in a behaviorally human-like manner, and that Gram matrix structure plays a role in driving perceptual alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过引入一个基于自然场景中成对点判断的大规模行为基准（超过1000试次），系统评估了自监督视觉模型与人类物体感知的对齐程度。研究发现，随着模型代际演进，架构和训练目标均有助于对齐，其中基于DINO自监督目标训练的Transformer模型表现最佳。作者提出一种新的度量来量化表示中物体中心的成分，并发现Gram矩阵结构在驱动感知对齐中起关键作用。
Motivation: 尽管自监督视觉模型在多种任务上表现出色并涌现出物体分割能力，但其与人类物体感知的对齐程度尚不清楚，缺乏大规模行为基准来量化这种对齐。
Method: 使用人类行为实验（成对点相同/不同判断）收集反应时数据，从多种视觉模型的表征中通过简单读出预测行为；并提出基于块内和块间相似性的新度量来量化物体中心成分；此外，通过蒸馏匹配自监督模型与有监督Transformer模型的Gram矩阵来改善对齐。
Result: 摘要报告DINO自监督Transformer在预测人类反应时方面表现最强；物体中心结构更强的模型更准确预测人类分割行为；Gram矩阵匹配进一步提升了与人类行为的对齐。
Conclusion: 自监督视觉模型以类人方式捕捉物体结构，Gram矩阵结构在驱动感知对齐中发挥重要作用。

papers.title: Less Data, Faster Convergence: Goal-Driven Data Optimization for Multimodal Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal instruction tuning is often compute-inefficient because training budgets are spread across large mixed image-video pools whose utility is highly uneven. We present Goal-Driven Data Optimization (GDO), a framework that computes six sample descriptors for each candidate and constructs optimized 1$\times$ training subsets for different goals. Under a fixed one-epoch Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct training and evaluation recipe on 8 H20 GPUs, GDO uses far fewer training samples than the Uni-10x baseline while converging faster and achieving higher accuracy. Relative to the fixed 512k-sample Uni-10x baseline, GDO reaches the Uni-10x reference after 35.4k samples on MVBench, 26.6k on VideoMME, 27.3k on MLVU, and 34.7k on LVBench, while improving Accuracy by +1.38, +1.67, +3.08, and +0.84 percentage points, respectively. The gains are largest on MVBench and MLVU, while LVBench improves more modestly, consistent with its ultra-long-video setting and the mismatch between that benchmark and the short-video/image-dominant training pool. Across MinLoss, Diverse, Temp, and Temp+, stronger temporal emphasis yields steadily better long-video understanding behavior. Overall, GDO provides a goal-driven data optimization framework that enables faster convergence with fewer training samples under a fixed training protocol. Code is available at https://github.com/rujiewu/GDO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出目标驱动数据优化（GDO）框架，用于多模态指令调优。通过六个样本描述符构建优化子集，在8块H20 GPU上使用Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct模型，用远少于Uni-10x基线的样本实现更快收敛和更高精度。在MVBench、VideoMME、MLVU、LVBench上分别提升+1.38、+1.67、+3.08、+0.84个百分点。
Motivation: 多模态指令调优中，混合图像-视频数据集的效用不均匀，训练预算分散导致计算低效，需要高效数据选择方法。
Method: 提出Goal-Driven Data Optimization (GDO)，对每个候选样本计算六个样本描述符，根据不同目标构建优化的1×训练子集。在固定epoch和模型下训练评估。
Result: 相对于512k样本的Uni-10x基线，GDO在MVBench、VideoMME、MLVU、LVBench上分别用35.4k、26.6k、27.3k、34.7k样本达到或超过基线，并分别提升+1.38、+1.67、+3.08、+0.84个百分点。长时间视频理解中更强的时间强调策略效果更好。
Conclusion: GDO提供了一个目标驱动的数据优化框架，能够在固定训练协议下用更少的训练样本实现更快的收敛。代码已开源。

papers.title: Improving TabPFN's Synthetic Data Generation by Integrating Causal Structure
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic tabular data generation addresses data scarcity and privacy constraints in a variety of domains. Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Network (TabPFN), a recent foundation model for tabular data, has been shown capable of generating high-quality synthetic tabular data. However, TabPFN is autoregressive: features are generated sequentially by conditioning on the previous ones, depending on the order in which they appear in the input data. We demonstrate that when the feature order conflicts with causal structure, the model produces spurious correlations that impair its ability to generate synthetic data and preserve causal effects. We address this limitation by integrating causal structure into TabPFN's generation process through two complementary approaches: Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)-aware conditioning, which samples each variable given its causal parents, and a partially directed acyclic graph (PDAG)-based strategy for scenarios with partial causal knowledge. We evaluate these approaches on controlled benchmarks and six CSuite datasets, assessing structural fidelity, distributional quality, and Average Treatment Effect (ATE) preservation. Across most settings, DAG-aware conditioning improves the quality and stability of synthetic data relative to vanilla TabPFN. Under partial causal knowledge, the oracle partially directed acyclic graph (oracle-PDAG), which orients only the edges into the colliders, shows moderate gains, while the benefit of a Completed Partially Directed Acyclic Graph (CPDAG) discovered from data depends on how well the causal structure is recovered. These results indicate that reliable causal structure, even partial, can be injected into TabPFN at inference time, without parameter updates, to improve synthetic data quality.
papers.comment: Camera-ready version, accepted at UAI 2026. 9 pages main text, 44 pages total (including supplementary material), 35 figures. Code: https://github.com/DavideTugnoli/tabpfn-causal-synthetic
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对TabPFN在合成表格数据时因特征顺序与因果结构冲突而产生虚假相关的问题，提出整合因果结构的两种方法：DAG感知条件采样和PDAG策略。在基准测试和CSuite数据集上，DAG感知方法显著提升了合成数据质量和因果效应保持，且无需参数更新。
Motivation: TabPFN生成数据时依赖特征顺序，若顺序与因果结构冲突，会产生虚假相关，影响合成数据质量和因果效应保持。
Method: 提出两种无需参数更新的方法：1) DAG感知条件采样，每个变量基于其因果父节点生成；2) 基于PDAG的策略，适用于部分因果知识场景，包括Oracle-PDAG和数据驱动的CPDAG。
Result: DAG感知条件采样在大多数设置下提升了合成数据的结构保真度、分布质量和平均处理效应（ATE）保持。Oracle-PDAG有适度提升，CPDAG的效果取决于因果结构恢复程度。
Conclusion: 可靠的因果结构（即使部分）可在推理时注入TabPFN，改善合成数据质量，无需重新训练。

papers.title: Sign Identifiability of Causal Effects in Stationary Stochastic Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: We study identifiability in continuous-time linear stationary stochastic differential equations with a known causal structure. Unlike existing approaches, we relax the assumption of a known diffusion matrix, thereby respecting the model's intrinsic scale invariance. Therefore, rather than recovering drift coefficients themselves, we introduce edge-sign identifiability: for a given causal structure, we ask whether the sign of a given drift entry is uniquely determined across all observational covariance matrices induced by parametrisations compatible with that structure. This leads to a trichotomy of edge-sign identifiability: identifiable, non-identifiable, and partially identifiable. This trichotomy introduces the new notion of partial identifiability to the literature, which we show is a genuine category in our setting. Under a notion of faithfulness, we derive criteria to identify membership of each category for general graphs. Applying our criteria to specific causal structures, both analogous to classical causal settings (e.g., instrumental variables) and novel cyclic settings, we determine their edge-sign identifiability and, in some cases, obtain explicit expressions for the sign of a target edge in terms of the observational covariance matrix.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究连续时间线性平稳随机微分方程中因果效应的符号可识别性，在已知因果结构但扩散矩阵未知的条件下，引入边符号可识别性的三分法：完全可识别、不可识别和部分可识别。基于忠实性假设，推导了一般图下各类别的判定准则，并将其应用于包括工具变量和新型循环结构在内的因果图中。
Motivation: 现有因果效应可识别性研究通常假设扩散矩阵已知，但该假设违背模型固有的尺度不变性。本文旨在放松这一假设，研究在仅知因果结构且扩散矩阵未知时，能否唯一确定因果效应（漂移系数）的符号。
Method: 本文引入边符号可识别性（edge-sign identifiability）概念，将识别性分为三类：可识别、不可识别和部分可识别。在忠实性假设下，推导出一般图结构下判定各类别归属的代数准则，并应用于经典和新颖的因果图（如工具变量图、循环图）。
Result: 摘要未报告数值结果或实验，而是给出了理论判定准则，并指出对特定因果结构（如工具变量图）可得到目标边符号关于观测协方差矩阵的显式表达式。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了在无扩散矩阵假设下，因果效应的符号可识别性呈现三分法，其中部分可识别性是一种新的概念，在本文设定下是真实存在的类别。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有因果效应可识别性研究通常假设扩散矩阵已知，但该假设违背模型固有的尺度不变性。本文旨在放松这一假设，研究在仅知因果结构且扩散矩阵未知时，能否唯一确定因果效应（漂移系数）的符号。
summary_sections.method: 本文引入边符号可识别性（edge-sign identifiability）概念，将识别性分为三类：可识别、不可识别和部分可识别。在忠实性假设下，推导出一般图结构下判定各类别归属的代数准则，并应用于经典和新颖的因果图（如工具变量图、循环图）。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告数值结果或实验，而是给出了理论判定准则，并指出对特定因果结构（如工具变量图）可得到目标边符号关于观测协方差矩阵的显式表达式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文揭示了在无扩散矩阵假设下，因果效应的符号可识别性呈现三分法，其中部分可识别性是一种新的概念，在本文设定下是真实存在的类别。

papers.title: Partial Causal Structure Learning for Valid Selective Conformal Inference under Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Selective conformal prediction can yield substantially tighter uncertainty sets when we can identify calibration examples that are exchangeable with the test example. In interventional settings, such as perturbation experiments in genomics, exchangeability often holds only within subsets of interventions that leave a target variable "unaffected" (e.g., non-descendants of an intervened node in a causal graph). We study the practical regime where this invariance structure is unknown and must be estimated from data. Our main result quantifies how coverage degrades when the estimated safe calibration set accidentally includes interventions that affect the target, and gives a conservative correction when an upper bound on this error is available. Rather than learning a full causal graph, we learn only the intervention-target relationships needed to choose calibration interventions. We give algorithms for this partial learning task and evaluate them on synthetic structural equation models and Replogle K562 CRISPR-interference data, where the experiments illustrate synthetic gains from selective calibration and finite-sample tradeoffs on real perturbation screens.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026). Code and reproduction notebooks: https://github.com/AsiaeeLab/selective-conformal-interventions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在干预设置下进行选择性共形预测，当校准集需要排除影响目标变量的干预时，提出学习部分因果结构来选择有效的校准干预。理论量化了错误包含影响性干预时覆盖率的下降，并给出保守校正。在合成结构方程模型和Replogle K562 CRISPR干扰数据上评估了算法。
Motivation: 在扰动实验（如基因组学）中，共形预测要求校准样本与测试样本可交换，但只有当校准干预不影响目标变量时才成立。实际中这种不变性结构未知，需要从数据中估计，且完全学习因果图成本高。
Method: 提出部分因果结构学习方法，仅学习干预-目标关系以选择校准干预，而非完整因果图。给出错误包含影响性干预时覆盖率的退化量化以及保守校正方法。
Result: 在合成结构方程模型和Replogle K562 CRISPR干扰数据上，选择性校准相比非选择性方法取得更紧的预测区间，并展示了有限样本下的权衡。
Conclusion: 该方法在干预设置下有效提升共形预测效率，但校正依赖于对错误包含率的上界估计，实际中需谨慎。

papers.title: Curvature-Weighted Capacity Allocation: A Minimum Description Length Framework for Layer-Adaptive Large Language Model Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Layer-wise capacity in large language models is highly non-uniform: some layers contribute disproportionately to loss reduction, whereas others are nearly redundant. Existing layer-scoring methods provide sensitivity estimates but do not give a principled rule for converting those estimates into allocation or pruning decisions under a global hardware budget. We introduce a curvature-aware, MDL-inspired framework built around the layer gain $ζ_k^2=g_k^\top\widetilde H_{kk}^{-1}g_k$. This quantity equals twice the maximal decrease predicted by the regularized layer-restricted quadratic model and incorporates inverse local curvature; it is therefore a local surrogate for reducible risk, not a universal dominance claim over gradient-norm scores. After normalizing the gains into scores $q_k$, we formulate two convex programs: one allocates expert slots under diminishing returns, and the other assigns layer-wise pruning ratios while protecting high-score layers. Both continuous programs have unique globally optimal solutions characterized by one dual variable and computable in $O(K\log(1/\varepsilon))$ time by bisection. We also prove a quadratic transfer-regret bound: when source and target score vectors differ by at most $δ$, the target surrogate cost of the transferred decision is within $O(δ^2)$ of the target optimum. Experiments on Mistral-7B and Gemma-7B show clear allocation gains in some settings and competitive, though mixed, pruning performance. The framework therefore replaces an empirical score-to-decision heuristic with a budget-feasible optimization procedure whose guarantees apply to the stated continuous surrogates. Code is available on github repo - [TKAI-LAB-Mali/Curvature-Weighted-Capacity-Allocation](https://github.com/TKAI-LAB-Mali/Curvature-Weighted-Capacity-Allocation.git)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型中各层容量非均匀的问题，提出一种基于曲率和MDL（最小描述长度）的框架，通过层增益（layer gain）量化各层对损失降低的贡献，并构建两个凸优化问题分别用于专家槽分配和层剪枝比例分配。该方法在Mistral-7B和Gemma-7B上展示了分配增益，剪枝性能则表现混合。
Motivation: 现有层评分方法提供敏感性估计，但缺乏将评分转化为全局硬件预算下分配或剪枝决策的原则性规则。
Method: 基于曲率感知的MDL框架，定义层增益ζ_k^2 = g_k^T ũ H_{kk}^{-1} g_k，归一化为分数q_k后，分别构建凸优化问题分配专家槽和层剪枝比例，通过二分法在O(K log(1/ε))时间内求解，并证明二次传输遗憾界。
Result: 在Mistral-7B和Gemma-7B上的实验显示，框架在某些设置下带来清晰的分配增益，剪枝性能表现混合但仍具竞争力。
Conclusion: 该框架用预算可行的优化程序替代了经验评分到决策的启发式方法，其保证适用于所陈述的连续代理。

papers.title: Provable Subspace Identification of Nonlinear Multi-view CCA
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the identifiability of nonlinear canonical correlation analysis (CCA) in a multi-view setup, in which each view is generated by applying an unknown nonlinear map to a linear mixture of shared latent variables plus view-private noise. Rather than pursuing exact unmixing, which is known to be ill-posed under general nonlinear mixing, we instead reframe multi-view CCA as a basis-invariant subspace identification problem. Under suitable latent priors and spectral separation conditions, we prove that the pairwise population CCA objective recovers correlated signal subspaces up to view-wise orthogonal ambiguity. For $N \geq 3$ views, their multi-view aggregation provably isolates the jointly correlated subspaces shared across all views while eliminating view-private variation. We further establish finite-sample statistical consistency guarantees by translating the concentration of empirical cross-covariances into explicit subspace error bounds via spectral perturbation theory. Experiments on synthetic and rendered image datasets support our theoretical findings and illustrate the necessity of the assumed conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究了多视图设置下非线性典型相关分析（CCA）的可识别性问题。不同于直接解混，作者将其重构为基于不变子空间的识别问题，证明了在适当的潜在先验和谱分离条件下，成对总体CCA目标可以恢复相关的信号子空间，且对于三个及以上视图，多视图聚合能分离联合相关子空间并消除视图私有变化。进一步给出了有限样本一致性保证，并通过合成和渲染图像数据集验证了理论。
Motivation: 非线性CCA在一般非线性混合下直接解混是病态的，需要一种可证明的替代方案来识别不同视图间共享的潜在结构。
Method: 将多视图CCA重新定义为基不变子空间识别问题，利用成对总体CCA目标恢复相关信号子空间，对N≥3个视图进行多视图聚合以隔离联合相关子空间，并通过谱扰动理论给出有限样本误差界。
Result: 理论上证明了可识别性和有限样本一致性保证；实验上在合成和渲染图像数据集上支持理论发现并说明假设的必要性。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了非线性多视图CCA子空间可识别性的理论基础，但结果依赖于特定的潜在先验和谱分离条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Communication-Efficient Byzantine-Robust Federated Conformal Prediction via Partial Model Sharing
papers.abstract_en: We propose PRISM-FCP (Partial shaRing and robust calIbration with Statistical Margins for Federated Conformal Prediction), a communication-efficient Byzantine-robust federated conformal prediction framework that uses partial model sharing to mitigate stochastic model-poisoning attacks during training and histogram-based filtering to mitigate adversarial calibration submissions. Existing approaches address adversarial behavior only in the calibration stage, leaving the learned model susceptible to poisoned updates. In contrast, PRISM-FCP mitigates attacks end-to-end. During training, clients partially share updates by transmitting only $M$ of $D$ parameters per round. This attenuates the expected energy of an adversary's perturbation in the aggregated update by a factor of $M/D$, yielding lower mean-square error (MSE) and tighter prediction intervals. During calibration, clients convert nonconformity scores into characterization vectors, compute distance-based maliciousness scores, and downweight or filter suspected Byzantine contributions before estimating the conformal quantile. Extensive experiments on both synthetic data and the UCI Superconductivity dataset demonstrate that PRISM-FCP maintains near-nominal empirical coverage in the studied Byzantine settings while avoiding the interval inflation observed in standard FCP, with reduced communication. These results support PRISM-FCP as a robust and communication-efficient approach to federated uncertainty quantification.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables, Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing (TSP)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRISM-FCP，一个通信高效的拜占庭鲁棒联邦共形预测框架。训练阶段通过部分模型共享（每轮只传输 D 个参数中的 M 个）来削弱恶意扰动能量，降低均方误差并收紧预测区间；校准阶段使用基于直方图的过滤来识别并降权或剔除拜占庭贡献。实验表明，在拜占庭攻击下，PRISM-FCP 能维持近名义覆盖概率，避免标准 FCP 中的区间膨胀，同时降低通信开销。
Motivation: 现有联邦共形预测方法仅在校准阶段考虑对抗行为，训练阶段仍易受模型毒化攻击。需要一种端到端的鲁棒方法来同时防御训练和校准阶段的攻击，并保持通信效率。
Method: 提出 PRISM-FCP 框架，包含两个部分：1) 训练阶段：客户端每轮只共享 D 个参数中的 M 个，使攻击者扰动能量衰减因子 M/D；2) 校准阶段：客户端将非一致性得分转换为特征向量，计算基于距离的恶意度分数，在估计共形分位数前对可疑贡献进行降权或过滤。
Result: 在合成数据和 UCI Superconductivity 数据集上，PRISM-FCP 在拜占庭攻击下保持了近名义经验覆盖概率，避免了标准 FCP 的区间膨胀，并减少了通信量。
Conclusion: PRISM-FCP 提供了一种鲁棒且通信高效的联邦不确定性量化方法，通过部分模型共享和校准阶段的直方图过滤实现了端到端的拜占庭容错。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Online Reference-Free Evaluation Framework for Flowchart Image-to-Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used in document processing pipelines to convert flowchart images into structured code (e.g., Mermaid). In production, these systems process arbitrary inputs for which no ground-truth code exists, making output quality difficult to assess. We propose a reference-free evaluation framework that monitors flowchart image-to-code generation quality at inference time, using only the input image and the generated output. The framework introduces two automated metrics: $\text{Recall}{\text{OCR}}$, which estimates content coverage by extracting text from the input image via OCR as a proxy reference, and $\text{Precision}{\text{VE}}$, which detects hallucinated elements through Visual Entailment against the original image. Their harmonic mean, $\text{F1}{\text{OCR-VE}}$, provides a unified quality score. Validation on the FlowVQA dataset shows strong agreement with ground-truth metrics (average Pearson's $r = 0.97$, $0.91$, and $0.94$ for Recall, Precision, and F1, respectively), confirming the framework's reliability as a practical, reference-free alternative for continuous quality monitoring in production settings.
papers.comment: This manuscript was inadvertently made publicly available before all necessary internal review processes had been completed. The authors are withdrawing the manuscript
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个无需参考的评估框架，用于在推理时监控流程图图像到代码生成的质量。框架使用两个自动化指标：Recall_OCR（通过OCR提取文本作为代理参考评估内容覆盖率）和Precision_VE（通过视觉蕴含检测幻觉元素），它们的调和平均F1_OCR-VE提供统一质量分数。在FlowVQA数据集上验证，与真实指标高度相关（Pearson's r平均0.97、0.91、0.94）。注意：该稿件已被作者撤回。
Motivation: 在流程图图像到代码生成的生产环境中，输入图像没有真值代码，难以评估输出质量。
Method: 提出一个无参考评估框架，包含两个指标：Recall_OCR（基于OCR的文本覆盖率）和Precision_VE（基于视觉蕴含的幻觉检测），以及它们的调和平均F1_OCR-VE。
Result: 在FlowVQA数据集上，框架与地面真值指标高度相关，平均皮尔逊相关系数为Recall 0.97，Precision 0.91，F1 0.94。
Conclusion: 该框架为生产环境中连续质量监控提供了一个可靠的无参考替代方案。

papers.title: Self-EvolveRec: Self-Evolving Recommender Systems with LLM-based Directional Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Traditional methods for automating recommender system design, such as Neural Architecture Search (NAS), are often constrained by a fixed search space defined by human priors, limiting innovation to pre-defined operators. While recent LLM-driven code evolution frameworks shift fixed search space target to open-ended program spaces, they primarily rely on scalar metrics (e.g., NDCG, Hit Ratio) that fail to provide qualitative insights into model failures or directional guidance for improvement. To address this, we propose Self-EvolveRec, a novel framework that establishes a directional feedback loop by integrating a User Simulator for qualitative critiques and a Model Diagnosis Tool for quantitative internal verification. Furthermore, we introduce a Diagnosis Tool - Model Co-Evolution strategy to ensure that evaluation criteria dynamically adapt as the recommendation architecture evolves. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Self-EvolveRec significantly outperforms state-of-the-art NAS and LLM-driven code evolution baselines in both recommendation performance and user satisfaction. Our code is available at https://github.com/Sein-Kim/self_evolverec.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Self-EvolveRec框架，利用LLM驱动的定向反馈（包括用户模拟器进行定性批评和模型诊断工具进行定量内部验证）来实现推荐系统的自我进化，并引入诊断工具-模型协同进化策略使评估标准动态适应架构变化。实验表明该方法在推荐性能和用户满意度上显著优于NAS和LLM驱动的代码进化基线。
Motivation: 传统NAS搜索空间受限于人工先验，而LLM驱动的代码进化依赖标量指标无法提供定性见解或方向性改进指导。
Method: 构建定向反馈循环，集成用户模拟器（定性批评）和模型诊断工具（定量内部验证），并提出诊断工具-模型协同进化策略以确保评估标准动态适应推荐架构演化。
Result: 在推荐性能和用户满意度上显著优于SOTA NAS和LLM驱动代码进化基线。
Conclusion: 定向反馈循环和协同进化策略能有效引导推荐系统自我进化，突破固定搜索空间限制。

papers.title: HairWeaver: Few-Shot Photorealistic Hair Motion Synthesis with Sim-to-Real Guided Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: We present HairWeaver, a diffusion-based pipeline that animates a single human image with realistic and expressive hair dynamics. While existing methods successfully control body pose, they lack specific control over hair, and as a result, fail to capture the intricate hair motions, resulting in stiff and unrealistic animations. HairWeaver overcomes this limitation using two specialized modules: a Motion-Context-LoRA to integrate motion conditions and a Style-Alignment-LoRA to preserve the subject's photoreal appearance across different data domains. These lightweight components are designed to guide a video diffusion backbone while maintaining its core generative capabilities. By training on a specialized dataset of dynamic human motion generated from a CG simulator, HairWeaver affords fine control over hair motion and ultimately learns to produce highly realistic hair that responds naturally to movement. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that our approach sets a new state of the art, producing lifelike human hair animations with dynamic details.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HairWeaver是一种基于扩散模型的管道，能够通过单张人物图像生成具有逼真头发动态的动画。它利用运动-上下文-LoRA和风格对齐-LoRA两个轻量模块，在保持视频扩散主干生成能力的同时，实现对头发运动的精细控制。通过在CG模拟器生成的动态人物数据集上训练，该方法在生成自然动态头发动画方面达到了新水平。
Motivation: 现有方法能成功控制身体姿态，但缺乏对头发的专门控制，导致生成的头发运动僵硬、不真实。
Method: 提出两个专用模块：Motion-Context-LoRA整合运动条件，Style-Alignment-LoRA保持主体在不同数据域中的逼真外观。这些轻量组件引导视频扩散骨干网络，并在CG模拟器生成的动态人体数据集上训练。
Result: 全面评估表明该方法在生成逼真人物头发动画方面达到了新水平，具有动态细节。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过模拟到真实指导，扩散模型可以学习产生响应运动的自然头发动画。

papers.title: Data-Driven Registration and Modeling of Brain Deformation for Image-Guided Neurosurgery: A Systematic Review
papers.abstract_en: Accurate compensation of brain deformation is critical for reliable image-guided neurosurgery. Surgical manipulation and tumor resection induce tissue motion, causing preoperative planning images to become misaligned with the intraoperative anatomy. In this systematic review, we examine data-driven methods developed between 2020 and 2025 for brain deformation registration and modeling, with a particular focus on learning-based approaches. A comprehensive literature search was conducted in PubMed, IEEE Xplore, Scopus, and Web of Science using predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria for computational methods addressing brain deformation in neurosurgical imaging, resulting in 46 eligible studies. We provide a unified analysis of methodological strategies, including deep learning-based image registration, direct deformation field regression, synthesis-driven multimodal alignment, resection-aware architectures for handling missing correspondences, and hybrid models integrating biomechanical priors. We also examine dataset utilization, evaluation metrics, validation protocols, and the assessment of uncertainty and generalization across studies. While learning-based methods demonstrate promising accuracy and computational efficiency, current approaches remain limited by out-of-distribution robustness, standardized benchmarking, interpretability, and readiness for clinical deployment. Our review highlights these gaps and outlines future directions toward more robust, generalizable, and clinically translatable solutions for neurosurgical guidance. By organizing recent advances and critically assessing evaluation practices, this work provides a comprehensive reference for researchers and clinicians working on data-driven registration and modeling of brain deformation.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables. Accepted at Medical Image Analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇系统性综述调查了2020-2025年间用于脑变形注册和建模的数据驱动方法，重点关注学习型方法。通过对46项研究的统一分析，涵盖了深度学习图像配准、直接变形场回归、合成驱动的多模态对齐、切除感知架构以及混合模型等。综述指出当前方法在分布外鲁棒性、标准化基准、可解释性和临床部署准备方面仍然有限。
Motivation: 在图像引导神经外科中，脑变形导致术前图像与术中解剖错位，需要准确补偿；现有方法缺乏系统比较和标准化评估。
Method: 在PubMed、IEEE Xplore、Scopus和Web of Science进行系统文献检索，纳入46项符合标准的研究，对方法论策略进行统一分析。
Result: 学习型方法展现出有希望的精度和计算效率，但当前方法受限于分布外鲁棒性、标准化基准、可解释性和临床部署准备。
Conclusion: 综述强调了这些差距，并指出了未来实现更鲁棒、更通用和临床可转化的神经外科引导解决方案的方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Curriculum Learning for Efficient Chain-of-Thought Distillation via Structure-Aware Masking and GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Distilling Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning from large language models into compact student models presents a fundamental challenge: teacher rationales are often too verbose for smaller models to faithfully reproduce. Existing approaches either compress reasoning into single-step, losing the interpretability that makes CoT valuable. We present a three-stage curriculum learning framework that addresses this capacity mismatch through progressive skill acquisition. First, we establish structural understanding via masked shuffled reconstruction. Second, we apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on masked completion tasks, enabling the model to discover its own balance between accuracy and brevity. Third, we identify persistent failure cases and guide the student to internalize teacher knowledge through targeted rewriting, again optimized with GRPO. Experiments on GSM8K demonstrate that our approach enables Qwen2.5-3B-Base to achieve an 11.29 percent accuracy improvement while reducing output length by 27.4 percent, surpassing both instruction-tuned variants and prior distillation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种三阶段课程学习框架，用于将大语言模型的链式思维推理蒸馏到小模型。第一阶段通过掩码打乱重建建立结构理解；第二阶段在掩码补全任务上应用组相对策略优化，让模型自主平衡准确性和简洁性；第三阶段识别持续失效案例并通过目标重写引导学生内化教师知识。在GSM8K上，Qwen2.5-3B-Base准确率提升11.29%，输出长度减少27.4%，超越指令微调和以往蒸馏方法。
Motivation: 大模型生成的链式思维推理原理较长，小模型难以忠实复现。现有方法要么压缩为单步损失可解释性，要么直接复制完整原理导致容量不匹配。
Method: 三阶段课程学习：1) 掩码打乱重建学习结构；2) GRPO在掩码补全任务上优化准确性和简洁性平衡；3) 识别失败案例并用GRPO进行目标重写蒸馏。
Result: 在GSM8K上，Qwen2.5-3B-Base准确率提升11.29%，输出长度减少27.4%，超越指令调优模型和先前蒸馏方法。
Conclusion: 通过渐进式技能获取的课程学习能有效缓解小模型在链式思维蒸馏中的容量不匹配问题，同时保持可解释性和提升效率。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Success Rates: Trainability and Extractability for Offline GCRL
papers.abstract_en: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) is typically benchmarked by the best tuned success rate of each method. This score measures attainable performance, but it does not reveal how reliably a learned goal-conditioned signal can be extracted into a policy: a method could succeed across many value-learning and extraction settings, or only at a narrow, hard-to-find configuration. We study this gap across four methods, GCIQL, GCIVL, QRL, and CRL, under a shared advantage-weighted regression (AWR) extractor. For each method, we construct trainability landscapes over the optimizer learning rate, which affects value learning and actor optimization, and AWR temperature, which controls how selectively the actor imitates high-advantage transitions. Across AntMaze, Cube, and Scene, we observe distinct regimes: high-scoring methods may be broadly accessible or brittle, while broad relative basins may still sit below low absolute ceilings. To interpret these differences, we pair landscapes with post-hoc diagnostics of future-vs-random goal discrimination and AWR weight concentration. Their relationship to downstream success is task-dependent. On AntMaze, where future goals align with path-like progress, these diagnostics explain landscape regimes. On Cube and Scene, goal ranking and manipulation control decouple: methods can rank goals well while failing downstream, or succeed through action-conditioned advantages despite weak future-vs-random separation. These results show that peak tuned success alone does not establish broadly extractable goal-conditioned behavior. Trainability landscapes expose this gap, while extraction diagnostics offer a lower-cost lens on how learned signals become policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）中，传统上只关注最佳调优成功率这一指标的不足。作者提出通过训练性景观（trainability landscapes）和提取诊断（extraction diagnostics）来评估方法的可提取性。在共享的AWR提取器下，比较了GCIQL、GCIVL、QRL和CRL四种方法，发现高成功率方法可能广泛可提取也可能脆弱，而诊断与下游成功的关系依赖于具体任务。结论指出峰值调优成功率不能保证广泛可提取的目标条件行为。
Motivation: 现有的离线GCRL基准仅使用最佳调优成功率来评估方法，但这一指标无法揭示学习到的目标条件信号能否可靠地提取为策略，即方法可能只在狭窄的配置下成功，而在广泛设置下失败。
Method: 在共享的AWR（advantage-weighted regression）提取器下，对四种方法（GCIQL、GCIVL、QRL和CRL）构建训练性景观，考察超参数（优化器学习率和AWR温度）的影响。同时使用事后诊断工具（未来vs随机目标区分和AWR权重集中度）来解释景观特征。
Result: 在AntMaze、Cube和Scene环境中，观察到不同方法表现出不同的训练性景观：高评分方法可能广泛可访问或脆弱，而宽的相对盆地可能仍低于低的绝对天花板。诊断与下游成功率的关系依赖于任务：在AntMaze上诊断解释了景观；在Cube和Scene上目标排名与操作控制解耦。
Conclusion: 峰值调优成功率本身不能确立广泛可提取的目标条件行为。训练性景观揭示了这一差距，而提取诊断提供了一个低成本视角来理解学习到的信号如何转化为策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Isolated Interventions via Almost Orthogonal Features in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A central premise in mechanistic interpretability is that meaningful concepts in language models are represented by linear features in activation space. For such features to support reliable interventions, manipulating one feature should not substantially alter the effects of others. In practice, however, feature entanglement leads to interference such that localized interventions can have unintended downstream effects. Motivated by the \textit{Independent Causal Mechanisms} principle, we propose to constrain internal features to be almost orthogonal. We argue that this promotes modular representations amenable to causal intervention. We formalize this problem by characterizing the gap between an idealized isolated intervention and its realized effect on model outputs in terms of feature interference. We upper-bound the propagation of feature interference in terms of the self-coherence of the feature dictionary, and relate this discrepancy to an explicit orthogonality regularization on the dictionary itself. Empirically, we show that this regularization enables more isolated interventions on mathematical reasoning concepts while preserving model performance. Our code is available under \texttt{https://github.com/mrtzmllr/sae-icm}.
papers.comment: Accepted as a conference paper at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型可解释性中特征纠缠导致干预效果不纯的问题，借鉴独立因果机制原理，提出通过约束特征字典近似正交来促进模块化表示。作者形式化了特征干扰的上界，并引入显式正交正则化，在数学推理概念上验证了该方法能实现更孤立的干预且不损害模型性能。
Motivation: 当前语言模型中的特征纠缠会导致局部干预产生意外的下游效应，破坏了因果干预的可靠性，而理想的可解释性要求特征之间相互独立。
Method: 提出在特征字典上施加显式正交正则化，约束内部特征近似正交，从而最小化特征干扰的上界，促进模块化表示。
Result: 实验表明，该方法在数学推理概念上实现了更孤立的干预，同时保持了模型原有性能。
Conclusion: 特征正交正则化有助于实现更孤立的因果干预，促进模块化表示，但可能受限于特定任务和架构。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出在特征字典上施加显式正交正则化，约束内部特征近似正交，从而最小化特征干扰的上界，促进模块化表示。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明，该方法在数学推理概念上实现了更孤立的干预，同时保持了模型原有性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 特征正交正则化有助于实现更孤立的因果干预，促进模块化表示，但可能受限于特定任务和架构。

papers.title: Rethinking LLM-as-a-Judge: Representation-as-a-Judge with Small Language Models via Semantic Capacity Asymmetry
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used as reference-free evaluators via prompting, but this "LLM-as-a-Judge" paradigm is costly, opaque, and sensitive to prompt design. In this work, we investigate whether smaller models can serve as efficient evaluators by leveraging internal representations instead of surface generation. We uncover a consistent empirical pattern: small LMs, despite with weak generative ability, encode rich evaluative signals in their hidden states. This motivates us to propose the Semantic Capacity Asymmetry Hypothesis: evaluation requires significantly less semantic capacity than generation and can be grounded in intermediate representations, suggesting that evaluation does not necessarily need to rely on large-scale generative models but can instead leverage latent features from smaller ones. Our findings motivate a paradigm shift from LLM-as-a-Judge to Representation-as-a-Judge, a decoding-free evaluation strategy that probes internal model structure rather than relying on prompted output. We instantiate this paradigm through INSPECTOR, a probing-based framework that predicts aspect-level evaluation scores from small model representations. Experiments on reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, GPQA) show that INSPECTOR substantially outperforms prompting-based small LMs and closely approximates full LLM judges, while offering a more efficient, reliable, and interpretable alternative for scalable evaluation. The code and data are available at: https://github.com/zhuochunli/Representation-as-a-judge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“语义容量不对称假说”，认为评估任务比生成任务需要更少的语义能力，小语言模型的内部表示已蕴含丰富的评估信号。基于此，作者提出Representation-as-a-Judge范式，并实例化为INSPECTOR框架，通过探针从小模型隐藏状态中预测方面级评估分数。在GSM8K、MATH、GPQA等推理基准上，INSPECTOR显著优于基于提示的小模型，性能接近全规模大语言模型评估器，且更高效、可靠、可解释。
Motivation: 现有LLM-as-a-Judge范式成本高、不透明、对提示设计敏感，需要更高效且可解释的自动评估替代方案。
Method: 提出Representation-as-a-Judge范式，通过探针（probing）从小语言模型的内部表示（而非生成文本）中直接提取评估分数，实现无解码（decoding-free）评估。具体框架INSPECTOR在训练时利用标注数据学习从隐藏状态到方面级评分的映射。
Result: 在GSM8K、MATH、GPQA推理基准上，INSPECTOR大幅超越基于提示的小模型，并与大语言模型评估器高度接近，同时降低了计算成本和提示敏感性。
Conclusion: 小语言模型的内部表示可作为高效、可靠、可解释的评估器，有望替代传统依赖大模型生成的评估范式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HeaPA: Difficulty-Aware Heap Sampling and On-Policy Query Augmentation for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: RLVR has become a standard recipe for training LLMs on reasoning tasks with verifiable outcomes, but when rollout generation dominates the cost, efficiency hinges on which prompts are sampled and when. In practice, prompt pools are often static or only weakly coupled to policy progress, so uniform sampling fails to track the moving capability frontier and wastes rollouts on regions that are already solved or still unreachable. Prior methods improve efficiency via filtering, curricula, adaptive rollout allocation, or teacher guidance, but they often assume a fixed pool, which does not support stable on-policy pool growth, or they introduce additional teacher cost and latency. In this work, we propose HeaPA (Heap Sampling and On-Policy Query Augmentation), which maintains a bounded, evolving pool, tracks the frontier with heap-based boundary sampling, grows the pool via on-policy augmentation under lightweight asynchronous validation, and stabilizes correlated queries via topology-aware pool statistics re-estimation and controlled reinsertion. Across two training corpora, two training recipes, and seven benchmarks, HeaPA consistently improves accuracy and reaches target performance with fewer computations at comparable wall-clock time. Analyses attribute the gains to frontier-focused sampling and on-policy pool growth, with more pronounced improvements at mid-to-large model scales. Our training code is publicly available at https://github.com/horizon-llm/HeaPA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HeaPA方法，通过基于堆的边界采样（heap-based boundary sampling）和在线策略查询增强（on-policy query augmentation），动态维护一个有界、演化的提示池，以提升LLM在可验证推理任务上的强化学习效率。实验表明，该方法在两个训练语料、两种训练流程和七个基准上，一致提升了准确率，并以更少的计算量达到目标性能。
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法中，推理任务提示池通常是静态或与策略进展弱耦合，均匀采样无法追踪不断变化的能力边界，导致计算浪费。先前方法虽有改进但往往假定固定池或引入额外教师成本。
Method: HeaPA包含四个组成部分：1）维护有界、动态演化的提示池；2）基于堆的边界采样追踪能力前沿；3）轻量级异步验证下的在线策略增强扩展池；4）基于拓扑结构的池统计量重新估计和受控重新插入以稳定相关查询。
Result: 在两个训练语料、两种训练流程和七个基准上，HeaPA一致提升准确率，在可比墙钟时间内以更少计算量达到目标性能；分析表明收益来自前沿聚焦采样和在线策略池增长，在中大型模型尺度上改进更显著。
Conclusion: HeaPA通过动态池管理和前沿采样，有效提升了LLM强化学习中可验证推理任务的训练效率，避免了静态池的局限性。

papers.title: XFACTORS: Disentangled Information Bottleneck via Contrastive Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Disentangled representation learning aims to map independent factors of variation to independent representation components. On one hand, purely unsupervised approaches have proven successful on fully disentangled synthetic data, but fail to recover semantic factors from real data without strong inductive biases. On the other hand, supervised approaches are unstable and hard to scale to large attribute sets because they rely on adversarial objectives or auxiliary classifiers. We introduce \textsc{XFactors}, a weakly-supervised VAE framework that disentangles and provides explicit control over a chosen set of factors. Building on the Disentangled Information Bottleneck perspective, we decompose the representation into a residual subspace $\mathcal{S}$ and factor-specific subspaces $\mathcal{T}_1,\ldots,\mathcal{T}_K$ and a residual subspace $\mathcal{S}$. Each target factor is encoded in its assigned $\mathcal{T}_i$ through contrastive supervision: an InfoNCE loss pulls together latents sharing the same factor value and pushes apart mismatched pairs. In parallel, KL regularization imposes a Gaussian structure on both $\mathcal{S}$ and the aggregated factor subspaces, organizing the geometry without additional supervision for non-targeted factors and avoiding adversarial training and classifiers. Across multiple datasets, with constant hyperparameters, \textsc{XFactors} achieves state-of-the-art disentanglement scores and yields consistent qualitative factor alignment in the corresponding subspaces, enabling controlled factor swapping via latent replacement. We further demonstrate that our method scales correctly with increasing latent capacity and evaluate it on the real-world dataset CelebA. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/ICML26-anon/XFactors}{github.com/ICML26-anon/XFactors}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 XFactors，一种弱监督 VAE 框架，基于解耦信息瓶颈（Disentangled Information Bottleneck）和对比学习实现因子解耦。将表示分解为目标因子子空间和残差子空间，通过 InfoNCE 损失和 KL 正则化训练，无需对抗目标或辅助分类器。在多个数据集上以固定超参数取得 SOTA 解耦分数，并能实现因子替换。
Motivation: 现有无监督解耦方法在真实数据上依赖强归纳偏置，而有监督方法因使用对抗目标或辅助分类器而不稳定且难以扩展到大属性集。
Method: 提出弱监督 VAE 框架，将表示分解为残差子空间 S 和多个因子特定子空间 T_i；通过 InfoNCE 对比损失将具有相同因子值的潜变量拉近、不同值的推远，同时用 KL 正则化对 S 和聚合的因子子空间施加高斯结构。
Result: 在多个数据集上以固定超参数获得 SOTA 解耦分数，在 CelebA 真实数据集上有效，支持通过潜变量替换实现因子交换。
Conclusion: 该方法无需对抗训练或分类器，可扩展至大属性集，并能在保持解耦质量的同时增加潜容量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Anatomically Guided Latent Diffusion for Brain MRI Progression Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Accurately modeling longitudinal brain MRI progression is crucial for understanding neurodegenerative diseases and predicting individualized structural changes. Existing state-of-the-art approaches, such as Brain Latent Progression (BrLP), often use multi-stage training pipelines with auxiliary conditioning modules but suffer from architectural complexity, suboptimal use of conditional clinical covariates, and limited guarantees of anatomical consistency. We propose Anatomically Guided Latent Diffusion Model (AG-LDM), a segmentation-guided framework that enforces anatomically consistent progression while substantially simplifying the training pipeline. AG-LDM conditions latent diffusion by directly fusing baseline anatomy, noisy follow-up states, and clinical covariates at the input level, a strategy that avoids auxiliary control networks by learning a unified, end-to-end model that represents both anatomy and progression. A lightweight 3D tissue segmentation model (WarpSeg) provides explicit anatomical supervision during both autoencoder fine-tuning and diffusion model training, ensuring consistent brain tissue boundaries and morphometric fidelity. Experiments on 31,713 ADNI longitudinal pairs and zero-shot evaluation on OASIS-3 demonstrate that AG-LDM matches or surpasses more complex diffusion models, achieving highly competitive image quality and 15-20% reduction in volumetric errors in generated images. AG-LDM also exhibits markedly stronger utilization of temporal and clinical covariates (3.5-31.5x higher covariate sensitivity than BrLP) and generates biologically plausible counterfactual trajectories, accurately capturing hallmarks of Alzheimer's progression such as limbic atrophy and ventricular expansion. These results highlight AG-LDM as an efficient, anatomically grounded framework for reliable brain MRI progression modeling.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Code available at https://github.com/JornyWan/AG-LDM

TL;DR: 本文提出解剖引导的潜在扩散模型（AG-LDM），用于脑MRI纵向进展建模，通过轻量级分割模型提供解剖监督，简化训练流程，并在ADNI和OASIS-3数据集上取得与复杂扩散模型相当或更优的性能，同时减少体积误差并增强协变量敏感性。
Motivation: 现有脑MRI进展模型如BrLP存在架构复杂、协变量利用不足和解剖一致性有限的问题，需要更简洁且解剖约束更强的方法。
Method: 提出AG-LDM，在潜在扩散模型的输入层融合基线解剖、噪声随访状态和临床协变量，并通过轻量级3D分割模型WarpSeg在自编码器微调和扩散模型训练中提供解剖监督。
Result: 在31713对ADNI纵向数据上，AG-LDM匹配或超越更复杂的扩散模型，生成图像体积误差降低15-20%，协变量敏感性比BrLP高3.5-31.5倍，并生成合乎生物学的反事实轨迹。
Conclusion: AG-LDM作为解剖引导的高效框架，能够可靠建模脑MRI进展，尤其适用于阿尔茨海默病的纵向研究。

papers.title: Threshold Differential Attention for Sink-Free, Ultra-Sparse, and Non-Dispersive Language Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Softmax attention struggles with long contexts due to structural limitations: the strict sum-to-one constraint forces attention sinks on irrelevant tokens, and probability mass disperses as sequence lengths increase. We tackle these problems with Threshold Differential Attention (TDA), a sink-free attention mechanism that achieves ultra-sparsity and improved robustness at longer sequence lengths without the computational overhead of projection methods or the performance degradation caused by noise accumulation of standard rectified attention. TDA applies row-wise extreme-value thresholding with a length-dependent gate, retaining only exceedances. Inspired by the differential transformer, TDA also subtracts an inhibitory view to enhance expressivity. Theoretically, we prove that TDA controls the expected number of spurious survivors per row to $O(1)$ and that consensus spurious matches across independent views vanish as context grows. Empirically, TDA produces $>99\%$ exact zeros and eliminates attention sinks while maintaining competitive performance on standard and long-context benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Softmax注意力在长上下文中强制注意力汇和概率质量分散的问题，提出阈值微分注意力（TDA），通过行极值阈值化和长度相关门控实现无汇、超稀疏注意力，并引入抑制视图提高表达力。理论分析表明TDA能控制每行虚假幸存者数量为O(1)，且随上下文增长伪匹配消失。实验显示TDA产生超过99%的精确零值并消除注意力汇，在标准与长上下文基准上保持竞争力。
Motivation: Softmax注意力在长上下文场景存在两个结构缺陷：严格的归一化约束导致注意力汇，以及概率质量随序列增长而分散，影响模型性能。
Method: 提出TDA机制，对注意力得分进行行级极值阈值化，并采用长度相关门控动态保留超过阈值的元素；借鉴微分transformer思想，增加抑制视图（inhibitory view）以增强表达能力。
Result: 摘要报告TDA在标准与长上下文基准上保持竞争力，注意力矩阵产生超过99%的精确零值，且消除了注意力汇。
Conclusion: 摘要强调TDA在保持性能的同时实现了无汇、超稀疏和非分散的注意力分布，理论保证了其长上下文下的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GenDA: Generative Data Assimilation on Complex Urban Areas via Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Urban wind flow reconstruction is essential for assessing air quality, heat dispersion, and pedestrian comfort, yet remains challenging when only sparse sensor data are available. We propose GenDA, a generative data assimilation framework that reconstructs high-resolution wind fields on unstructured meshes from limited observations. The model employs a multiscale graph-based diffusion architecture trained on computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations and interprets classifier-free guidance as a learned posterior reconstruction mechanism: the unconditional branch learns a geometry-aware flow prior, while the sensor-conditioned branch injects observational constraints during sampling. This formulation enables obstacle-aware reconstruction and generalization to held-out mesh geometries, wind directions, and sensor configurations within the studied urban-flow setting, without retraining. We consider both sparse fixed sensors and trajectory-based observations using the same reconstruction procedure. When evaluated against supervised graph neural network (GNN) baselines and classical reduced-order data assimilation methods, GenDA reduces the relative root-mean-square error (RRMSE) by 25-57% and increases the structural similarity index (SSIM) by 23-33% across the tested meshes. Experiments are conducted on Reynolds-averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) simulations of a real urban neighborhood in Bristol, United Kingdom, at a characteristic Reynolds number of $\mathrm{Re}\approx2\times10^{7}$, featuring complex building geometry and irregular terrain. The proposed framework provides a scalable path toward generative, geometry-aware data assimilation for environmental monitoring in complex domains.

papers.title: Bridging Cognitive Neuroscience and Graph Intelligence: Hippocampus-Inspired Multi-View Hypergraph Learning for Web Finance Fraud
papers.abstract_en: Online financial services constitute an essential component of contemporary web ecosystems, yet their openness introduces substantial exposure to fraud that harms vulnerable users and weakens trust in digital finance. Such threats have become a significant web harm that erodes societal fairness and affects the well-being of online communities. However, existing detection methods based on graph neural networks (GNNs) struggle with two persistent challenges: (1) long-tailed data distributions, which obscure rare but critical fraudulent cases, and (2) fraud camouflage, where malicious transactions mimic benign behaviors to evade detection. To fill these gaps, we propose HIMVH, a Hippocampus-Inspired Multi-View Hypergraph learning model for web finance fraud detection. Specifically, drawing inspiration from the scene conflict monitoring role of the hippocampus, we design a cross-view inconsistency perception module that captures subtle discrepancies and behavioral heterogeneity across multiple transaction views. This module enables the model to identify subtle cross-view conflicts for detecting online camouflaged fraudulent behaviors. Furthermore, inspired by the match-mismatch novelty detection mechanism of the CA1 region, we introduce a novelty-aware hypergraph learning module that measures feature deviations from neighborhood expectations and adaptively reweights messages, thereby enhancing sensitivity to online rare fraud patterns in the long-tailed settings. Extensive experiments on six web-based financial fraud datasets demonstrate that HIMVH achieves 6.42% improvement in AUC, 9.74% in F1 and 39.14% in AP on average over 15 SOTA models.

papers.title: Resolving Predictive Multiplicity for the Rashomon Set
papers.abstract_en: The existence of multiple, equally accurate models for a given predictive task leads to predictive multiplicity, where a Rashomon set of models achieve similar accuracy but diverge in their individual predictions. This inconsistency undermines trust in high-stakes applications where we want consistent predictions. We propose three approaches to reduce inconsistency among predictions for the members of the Rashomon set. The first approach is outlier correction. An outlier has a label that none of the good models are capable of predicting correctly. Outliers can cause the Rashomon set to have high variance predictions in a local area, so fixing them can lower variance. Our second approach is local patching. In a local region around a test point, models may disagree with each other because some of them are biased. We can detect and fix such biases using a validation set, which also reduces multiplicity. Our third approach is pairwise reconciliation, where we find pairs of models that disagree on a region around the test point. We modify predictions that disagree, making them less biased. These three approaches can be used together or separately, and they each have distinct advantages. The reconciled predictions can then be distilled into a single interpretable model for real-world deployment. In experiments across multiple datasets, our methods reduce disagreement metrics while maintaining competitive accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对预测多重性问题（predictive multiplicity），即存在多个准确率相似的模型（Rashomon set）但个体预测不一致，提出三种降低不一致性的方法：异常值修正（outlier correction）、局部补丁（local patching）和成对调和（pairwise reconciliation）。实验表明这些方法能在保持竞争力的准确率的同时降低不一致性指标。
Motivation: 在高风险应用中，多个等精度模型预测不一致会削弱信任，现有方法缺乏系统性解决Rashomon set内部预测分歧的方案。
Method: 提出三种可单独或联合使用的方法：1) 异常值修正识别并修正所有好模型都无法正确预测的标签；2) 局部补丁使用验证集检测并修正测试点局部区域的模型偏差；3) 成对调和找到在局部区域存在分歧的模型对并修改不一致预测以减少偏差。调和后的预测可蒸馏为单个可解释模型。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验中，所提方法在保持竞争力准确率的同时降低了一致性指标（如分歧度量）。
Conclusion: 异常值修正、局部补丁和成对调和能有效减少Rashomon set内部的预测不一致性，且可组合使用以提升部署模型的可靠性。

papers.title: Conversational AI for Rapid Scientific Prototyping: A Case Study on ESA's ELOPE Competition
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as coding partners, yet their role in accelerating scientific discovery remains underexplored. This paper presents a case study of using ChatGPT for rapid prototyping in ESA's ELOPE (Event-based Lunar OPtical flow Egomotion estimation) competition. The competition required participants to process event camera data to estimate lunar lander trajectories. Despite joining late, we achieved second place with a score of 0.01282, highlighting the potential of human-AI collaboration in competitive scientific settings. ChatGPT contributed not only executable code but also algorithmic reasoning, data handling routines, and methodological suggestions, such as using fixed number of events instead of fixed time spans for windowing. At the same time, we observed limitations: the model often introduced unnecessary structural changes, gets confused by intermediate discussions about alternative ideas, occasionally produced critical errors and forgets important aspects in longer scientific discussions. By analyzing these strengths and shortcomings, we show how conversational AI can both accelerate development and support conceptual insight in scientific research. We argue that structured integration of LLMs into the scientific workflow can enhance rapid prototyping by proposing best practices for AI-assisted scientific work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以ESA的ELOPE（基于事件相机的月球光学流自运动估计）竞赛为案例，探讨了使用ChatGPT进行快速科学原型设计的潜力。尽管参赛较晚，团队凭借ChatGPT的帮助获得第二名（得分0.01282），展示了人类-AI协作在竞争性科学场景中的价值。ChatGPT不仅生成了可执行代码，还提供了算法推理、数据处理以及方法论建议（如使用固定事件数而非固定时间窗口）。同时，论文也指出了其局限性：模型常引入不必要的结构变化、被中间讨论干扰、偶尔产生严重错误，并在较长的科学讨论中遗忘重要细节。基于这些优缺点，论文提出了在科学研究中集成LLM的最佳实践。
Motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）作为编码伙伴日渐普及，但它们在加速科学发现方面的作用仍未被充分探索。本文旨在通过具体竞赛案例评估这一潜力。
Method: 采用案例研究方法，在ELOPE竞赛中使用ChatGPT进行快速原型开发。ChatGPT参与了算法推理、数据处理、代码编写和方法论建议（如事件窗口策略），团队则进行验证和调整。
Result: 在ELOPE竞赛中取得第二名，得分0.01282。ChatGPT贡献了可执行代码和关键方法论建议，但也表现出结构变更随意、长对话记忆不佳等问题。
Conclusion: 论文认为，结构化地将LLM整合到科学工作流中可以加速原型设计并提供概念性见解，同时提出了AI辅助科学工作的最佳实践建议。

papers.title: Multi-Distribution Robust Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: In many fairness and distribution robustness problems, one has access to labeled data from multiple source distributions yet the test data may come from an arbitrary member or a mixture of them. We study the problem of constructing a conformal prediction set that is uniformly valid across multiple, heterogeneous distributions, in the sense that no matter which distribution the test point is from, the coverage of the prediction set is guaranteed to exceed a pre-specified level. We first propose a max-p aggregation scheme that delivers finite-sample, multi-distribution coverage given any conformity scores associated with each distribution. Upon studying several efficiency optimization programs subject to uniform coverage, we prove the optimality and tightness of our aggregation scheme, and propose a general algorithm to learn conformity scores that lead to efficient prediction sets after the aggregation under standard conditions. We discuss how our framework relates to group-wise distributionally robust optimization, sub-population shift, fairness, and multi-source learning. In synthetic and real-data experiments, our method delivers valid worst-case coverage across multiple distributions while greatly reducing the set size compared with naively applying max-p aggregation to single-source conformity scores, and can be comparable in size to single-source prediction sets with popular, standard conformity scores.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多分布鲁棒共形预测问题，旨在构建一个对多个异构源分布均能保证预定义覆盖率的预测集，无论测试点来自哪个分布或其混合。提出最大值聚合方案，证明其在有限样本下达到多分布覆盖的最优性和紧致性，并设计学习有效 conformity scores 的通用算法。实验表明该方法在保持有效最坏情况覆盖的同时，显著减小集合大小。
Motivation: 实际应用中常有多源分布标记数据，但测试数据可能来自任意分布或其混合，现有共形预测方法通常针对单一分布，无法保证多分布下的统一覆盖。需要一种能在多个异构分布间提供均匀有效覆盖的预测集构建方法。
Method: 提出最大值聚合方案：针对每个分布计算conformity scores，取所有分布的最大值作为聚合统计量，以保证最坏情况覆盖。进一步探讨在均匀覆盖约束下的效率优化问题，证明该聚合方案的最优性和紧致性，并给出学习conformity scores的通用算法。
Result: 在合成和真实数据实验中，该方法在多分布下提供有效的最坏情况覆盖，同时与简单应用最大值聚合到单源conformity scores相比大幅减小集合大小，且与使用流行标准conformity scores的单源预测集大小相当。
Conclusion: 该框架与群体分布鲁棒优化、子群体偏移、公平性和多源学习相关，为多分布环境下共形预测提供了理论保证与实用算法。

papers.title: Zoom-IQA: Image Quality Assessment with Reliable Region-Aware Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Image Quality Assessment (IQA) is a long-standing problem in computer vision. Previous methods typically focus on predicting numerical scores without explanation or providing low-level descriptions lacking precise scores. Recent reasoning-based vision language models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for IQA by jointly generating quality descriptions and scores. However, existing VLM-based IQA methods often suffer from unreliable reasoning due to their limited capability of integrating visual and textual cues. In this work, we introduce Zoom-IQA, a VLM-based IQA model to explicitly emulate key cognitive behaviors: uncertainty awareness, region reasoning, and iterative refinement. Specifically, we present a two-stage training pipeline: 1) supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on our Grounded-Rationale-IQA (GR-IQA) dataset to teach the model to ground its assessments in key regions, and 2) reinforcement learning (RL) for dynamic policy exploration, stabilized by our KL-Coverage regularizer to prevent reasoning and scoring diversity collapse, with a Progressive Re-sampling Strategy for mitigating annotation bias. Extensive experiments show that Zoom-IQA achieves improved robustness, explainability, and generalization. The application to downstream tasks, such as image restoration, further demonstrates the effectiveness of Zoom-IQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Zoom-IQA，一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的图像质量评估模型，通过显式模拟不确定性感知、区域推理和迭代细化等认知行为。采用两阶段训练：先对Grounded-Rationale-IQA数据集进行监督微调，再用强化学习（RL）结合KL-Coverage正则化稳定策略探索。实验表明模型在鲁棒性、可解释性和泛化性上有所提升。

Result: 实验表明Zoom-IQA在鲁棒性、可解释性和泛化性上取得提升；在图像恢复等下游任务中也验证了有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过显式模拟认知行为提升了IQA的可靠性与可解释性，但未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: SimRPD: Optimizing Recruitment Proactive Dialogue Agents through Simulator-Based Data Evaluation and Selection
papers.abstract_en: Task-oriented proactive dialogue agents play a pivotal role in recruitment, particularly for steering conversations towards specific business outcomes, such as acquiring social-media contacts for private-channel conversion. Although supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning have proven effective for training such agents, their performance is heavily constrained by the scarcity of high-quality, goal-oriented domain-specific training data. To address this challenge, we propose SimRPD, a three-stage framework for training recruitment proactive dialogue agents. First, we develop a high-fidelity user simulator to synthesize large-scale conversational data through multi-turn online dialogue. Then we introduce a multi-dimensional evaluation framework based on Chain-of-Intention (CoI) to comprehensively assess the simulator and effectively select high-quality data, incorporating both global-level and instance-level metrics. Finally, we train the recruitment proactive dialogue agent on the selected dataset. Experiments in a real-world recruitment scenario demonstrate that SimRPD outperforms existing simulator-based data selection strategies, highlighting its practical value for industrial deployment and its potential applicability to other business-oriented dialogue scenarios.
papers.comment: Published in the ACL 2026 Industry Track. Oral presentation
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 6: Industry Track), 2026, pp. 1359-1377
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SimRPD框架，用于训练招聘场景下的主动对话代理。框架包括三阶段：构建高保真用户模拟器生成大规模对话数据；基于意图链的多维评估框架评估模拟器并选择高质量数据；在选中的数据上训练对话代理。实验表明SimRPD优于现有基于模拟器的数据选择策略。
Motivation: 招聘场景中主动对话代理的性能受限于高质量、目标导向的领域数据稀缺。
Method: 提出SimRPD三阶段框架：开发用户模拟器合成对话数据；引入基于意图链的多维评估框架，包含全局和实例级指标，评估模拟器并选择高质量数据；在选定数据集上训练主动对话代理。
Result: 在真实招聘场景中的实验表明SimRPD优于现有基于模拟器的数据选择策略。
Conclusion: SimRPD对工业部署有实用价值，并可推广到其他业务导向的对话场景。

papers.title: V-VLAPS: Value-Guided Planning for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide strong action priors for robotic manipulation, but their reactive behavior can fail under distribution shift and long-horizon task structure. Recent VLA-guided planning methods improve execution by using pretrained policies to guide tree search, yet node selection still depends heavily on policy priors and visit-count exploration. Consequently, when the policy favors poor actions, the planner lacks a learned value signal to correct this bias. Prior work has shown that VLA representations encode rollout success and failure information, suggesting that they may also support value estimation during planning. We introduce Value-Guided Vision-Language-Action Planning and Search (V-VLAPS), which augments VLA-guided planning with a lightweight value head trained on offline VLA rollouts to predict Monte Carlo returns. These predictions guide Monte Carlo Tree Search in simulation toward higher-value branches. Across five LIBERO suites, V-VLAPS matches value-free planning baseline at the default search budget in aggregate, and analysis shows that many hard failures are root-level timeouts where predicted values are weakly separated. With a larger search budget, V-VLAPS improves over the baseline in all task suites with +6 percentage points on LIBERO-Object and +4 percentage points on LIBERO-10. Our results suggest that VLA representations can support not only failure prediction, but also value-guided planning when search reaches branches where value-based ranking matters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 V-VLAPS（Value-Guided Vision-Language-Action Planning and Search），通过在 VLA 模型上添加轻量级价值头，利用离线 rollouts 预测蒙特卡洛回报，从而在规划中引导蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）向高价值分支探索。在 LIBERO 机器人操作基准套件上，V-VLAPS 在默认搜索预算下与无价值基线持平，而在更大搜索预算下，在 LIBERO-Object 和 LIBERO-10 上分别提升 6 和 4 个百分点。结果表明 VLA 表示可用于价值引导规划。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型作为反应式策略在分布偏移和长时域任务中易失败，而基于 VLA 引导的规划方法过度依赖策略先验和访问计数探索，缺乏学习到的价值信号来纠正策略偏差。
Method: 在预训练 VLA 模型基础上附加一个轻量级价值预测头，该头使用离线 VLA rollout 数据训练以拟合蒙特卡洛回报；在规划时，利用该价值头指导 MCTS 的节点选择，偏向高价值分支。
Result: 在 LIBERO 套件的 5 个任务套件上，默认搜索预算下 V-VLAPS 与无价值规划基线性能相当；增大搜索预算后，V-VLAPS 在所有套件上均有提升，其中 LIBERO-Object 和 LIBERO-10 分别提高 6 和 4 个百分点。
Conclusion: VLA 模型不仅可用于失败预测，还可用于价值引导规划，当搜索分支的价值排序起关键作用时，该方法能有效改善规划性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoCo-Fed: A Unified Framework for Memory- and Communication-Efficient Federated Learning at the Wireless Edge
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of large-scale neural networks within the Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) architecture is pivotal for enabling native edge intelligence. However, this paradigm faces two critical bottlenecks: the prohibitive memory footprint required for local training on resource-constrained gNBs, and the saturation of bandwidth-limited backhaul links during the global aggregation of high-dimensional model updates. To address these challenges, we propose CoCo-Fed, a novel Compression and Combination-based Federated learning framework that unifies local memory efficiency and global communication reduction. Locally, CoCo-Fed breaks the memory wall by performing a double-dimension down-projection of gradients, adapting the optimizer to operate on low-rank structures without introducing additional inference parameters/latency. Globally, we introduce a transmission protocol based on orthogonal subspace superposition, where layer-wise updates are projected and superimposed into a single consolidated matrix per gNB, drastically reducing the backhaul traffic. Beyond empirical designs, we establish a rigorous theoretical foundation, proving the convergence of CoCo-Fed even under unsupervised learning conditions suitable for wireless sensing tasks. Extensive simulations on an angle-of-arrival estimation task demonstrate that CoCo-Fed significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both memory and communication efficiency while maintaining robust convergence under non-IID settings.
papers.comment: This article contains several errors in theoretical derivation and improper usage of formula notations
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoCo-Fed 提出一种基于压缩与组合的联邦学习框架，在无线边缘（O-RAN）上同时解决本地训练的内存瓶颈和全局聚合的通信瓶颈。本地通过双重降维投影使优化器工作在低秩结构上，全局通过正交子空间叠加将逐层更新压缩为单一矩阵，并给出无监督条件下的收敛证明。在角度到达估计任务上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 大规模神经网络在 O-RAN 部署时面临两个关键瓶颈：资源受限的 gNB 上本地训练的内存占用过高，以及高维模型更新全局聚合时回程链路带宽饱和。
Method: 提出 CoCo-Fed 框架：本地使用双重降维投影（double-dimension down-projection）将梯度映射到低秩结构，不增加推理参数/延迟；全局引入基于正交子空间叠加的传输协议，将逐层更新投影并叠加为单个矩阵，减少回程流量。
Result: 在角度到达估计任务上，CoCo-Fed 显著优于现有基线，在内存和通信效率上均表现更优，且在非独立同分布（non-IID）设置下保持鲁棒收敛。
Conclusion: CoCo-Fed 通过统一的内存和通信压缩设计，为无线边缘联邦学习提供了一种理论上收敛的实用方案。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Deep Neural Networks as Discrete Dynamical Systems: Implications for Physics-Informed Learning
papers.abstract_en: We revisit the analogy between feed-forward deep neural networks (DNNs) and discrete dynamical systems derived from neural integral equations and their corresponding partial differential equation (PDE) forms. A comparative analysis between the numerical/exact solutions of the Burgers' and Eikonal equations, and the same obtained via PINNs is presented. We show that PINN learning provides a different computational pathway compared to standard numerical discretization in approximating essentially the same underlying dynamics of the system. Within this framework, DNNs can be interpreted as discrete dynamical systems whose layer-wise evolution approaches attractors, and multiple parameter configurations may yield comparable solutions, reflecting the degeneracy of the inverse mapping. In contrast to the structured operators associated with finite-difference (FD) procedures, PINNs learn dense parameter representations that are not directly associated with classical discretization stencils. This distributed representation generally involves a larger number of parameters, leading to reduced interpretability and increased computational cost. However, the additional flexibility of such representations may offer advantages in high-dimensional settings where classical grid-based methods become impractical.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新探讨了前馈深度神经网络（DNN）与离散动力系统之间的类比，基于神经积分方程及其偏微分方程形式。通过对比Burgers方程和Eikonal方程的数值/精确解与PINN求解结果，作者发现PINN学习提供了不同于标准数值离散化的计算路径，DNN可解释为层间演化趋近吸引子的离散动力系统，且多个参数配置可能产生相似解。相比于有限差分法的结构化算子，PINN学习到的密集参数表示不与经典离散模板直接对应，参数更多、可解释性降低、计算成本增加，但在高维问题中可能更具灵活性。
Motivation: 现有物理信息学习（PINN）与经典数值离散方法之间的差异尚未从动力系统角度得到清晰解释，且PINN的可解释性和计算效率问题需要更深入的理论理解。
Method: 通过将前馈DNN视为离散动力系统，利用神经积分方程导出对应PDE形式，比较Burgers方程和Eikonal方程的数值/精确解与PINN解，分析两种计算路径的异同。
Result: PINN学习与有限差分法在逼近相同底层动力学时采用不同计算路径；DNN的层间演化趋近吸引子，逆映射存在退化性；PINN习得密集参数表示，参数多、可解释性低、计算成本高，但在高维问题中可能具有优势。
Conclusion: 该框架揭示了PINN与传统数值方法的本质差异，指出PINN在高维问题中可能更具优势，但需权衡可解释性和计算效率。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: A Tool Bottleneck Framework for Clinically-Informed and Interpretable Medical Image Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent tool-use frameworks powered by vision-language models (VLMs) improve image understanding by grounding model predictions with specialized tools. Broadly, these frameworks leverage VLMs and a pre-specified toolbox to decompose the prediction task into multiple tool calls (often deep learning models) which are composed to make a prediction. The dominant approach to composing tools is using text, via function calls embedded in VLM-generated code or natural language. However, these methods often perform poorly on medical image understanding, where salient information is encoded as spatially-localized features that are difficult to compose or fuse via text alone. To address this, we propose a tool-use framework for medical image understanding called the Tool Bottleneck Framework (TBF), which composes VLM-selected tools using a learned Tool Bottleneck Model (TBM). For a given image and task, TBF leverages an off-the-shelf medical VLM to select tools from a toolbox that each extract clinically-relevant features. Instead of text-based composition, these tools are composed by the TBM, which computes and fuses the tool outputs using a neural network before outputting the final prediction. We propose a simple and effective strategy for TBMs to make predictions with any arbitrary VLM tool selection. Overall, our framework not only improves tool-use in medical imaging contexts, but also yields more interpretable, clinically-grounded predictors. We evaluate TBF on tasks in histopathology and dermatology and find that these advantages enable our framework to perform on par with or better than deep learning-based classifiers, VLMs, and state-of-the-art tool-use frameworks, with particular gains in data-limited regimes. The project details and the code are available at https://christinaliu2020.github.io/tbm/.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 9th International Conference on Medical Imaging with Deep Learning, Proceedings of Machine Learning Research 315 (2026) 2958-2986
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出工具瓶颈框架（Tool Bottleneck Framework, TBF），用于医学图像理解。该框架利用现成的医学视觉语言模型（VLM）选择临床相关工具，然后通过学习的工具瓶颈模型（TBM）以神经网络方式组合工具输出，而非传统基于文本的组合。在组织病理学和皮肤病学任务上，TBF与深度分类器、VLM及现有工具框架性能相当或更优，尤其在数据有限时表现更好。
Motivation: 现有基于文本的工具组合方法难以有效融合医学图像中的空间局部特征，导致在医学图像理解任务中性能不佳。
Method: 提出TBF：使用医学VLM从工具箱中选择工具，每个工具提取临床相关特征；然后由TBM（一个神经网络）计算并融合工具输出，生成最终预测，支持任意工具选择组合。
Result: 在组织病理学和皮肤病学任务上，TBF与深度分类器、VLM及最新工具框架性能相当或更优，尤其在数据有限场景下增益明显。
Conclusion: TBF在医学图像理解中提升了工具使用的有效性，并产出更可解释、临床可解释的预测器。

papers.title: Borrowing from anything: A generalizable framework for reference-guided instance editing
papers.abstract_en: Reference-guided instance editing is fundamentally limited by semantic entanglement, where a reference's intrinsic appearance is intertwined with its extrinsic attributes. The key challenge lies in disentangling what information should be borrowed from the reference, and determining how to apply it appropriately to the target. To tackle this challenge, we propose GENIE, a Generalizable Instance Editing framework capable of achieving explicit disentanglement. GENIE first corrects spatial misalignments with a Spatial Alignment Module (SAM). Then, an Adaptive Residual Scaling Module (ARSM) learns what to borrow by amplifying salient intrinsic cues while suppressing extrinsic attributes, while a Progressive Attention Fusion (PAF) mechanism learns how to render this appearance onto the target, preserving its structure. Extensive experiments on the challenging AnyInsertion dataset demonstrate that GENIE achieves state-of-the-art fidelity and robustness, setting a new standard for disentanglement-based instance editing.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 GENIE 框架，用于参考引导的实例编辑，核心挑战是解耦参考图像的内在外观与外在属性。GENIE 通过空间对齐模块修正错位，自适应残差缩放模块学习借用什么，渐进式注意力融合学习如何渲染到目标上。在 AnyInsertion 数据集上达到最先进效果。
Motivation: 现有参考引导实例编辑受限于语义纠缠（semantic entanglement），难以分离参考中的内在外观与外在属性，导致编辑效果不佳。
Method: 提出 GENIE 框架，包含空间对齐模块（SAM）修正错位，自适应残差缩放模块（ARSM）通过放大内在线索抑制外在属性来学习借用内容，以及渐进式注意力融合（PAF）机制将外观渲染到目标上并保留其结构。
Result: 在 AnyInsertion 数据集上的实验表明，GENIE 在保真度和鲁棒性方面达到最先进水平，树立了基于解耦的实例编辑新标准。
Conclusion: GENIE 通过显式解耦实现了参考引导实例编辑的泛化，但论文已撤回需进一步修订。

papers.title: Elastic3D: Controllable Stereo Video Conversion with Guided Latent Decoding
papers.abstract_en: The growing demand for immersive 3D content calls for automated monocular-to-stereo video conversion. We present Elastic3D, a controllable, direct end-to-end method for upgrading a conventional video to a binocular one. Our approach, based on (conditional) latent diffusion, avoids artifacts due to explicit depth estimation and warping. The key to its high-quality stereo video output is a novel, guided VAE decoder that ensures sharp and epipolar-consistent stereo video output. Moreover, our method gives the user control over the strength of the stereo effect (more precisely, the disparity range) at inference time, via an intuitive, scalar tuning knob. Experiments on three different datasets of real-world stereo videos show that our method outperforms both traditional warping-based and recent warping-free baselines and sets a new standard for reliable, controllable stereo video conversion. Please check the project page for the video samples https://elastic3d.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Elastic3D 提出一种端到端的单目到立体视频转换方法，基于条件潜在扩散和引导VAE解码器，避免深度估计和扭曲带来的伪影，并通过标量旋钮控制视差范围。在三个真实立体视频数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于传统基于扭曲和无扭曲的基线，树立了可靠可控立体视频转换的新标准。
Motivation: 沉浸式3D内容需求增长，现有方法依赖显式深度估计和扭曲易产生伪影，且缺乏用户控制能力。
Method: 基于条件潜在扩散模型，设计一种新颖的引导VAE解码器确保立体输出锐利且满足极线约束，并在推理时通过标量旋钮控制立体效果强度（即视差范围）。
Result: 在三个真实世界立体视频数据集上，该方法在质量和可控性上均优于传统扭曲基线和近期无扭曲基线。
Conclusion: 该方法为可靠、可控的立体视频转换设立了新标准，并提供了视频样本的项目页面。

papers.title: Maximum Mean Discrepancy with Unequal Sample Sizes via Generalized U-Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Existing two-sample testing techniques, particularly those based on choosing a kernel for the Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), often assume equal sample sizes from the two distributions. Applying these methods in practice can require discarding valuable data, unnecessarily reducing test power. We address this long-standing limitation by extending the theory of generalized U-statistics and applying it to the usual MMD estimator, resulting in new characterization of the asymptotic distributions of the MMD estimator with unequal sample sizes (particularly outside the proportional regimes required by previous partial results). This generalization also provides a new criterion for optimizing the power of an MMD test with unequal sample sizes. Our approach preserves all available data, enhancing test accuracy and applicability in realistic settings. Along the way, we give much cleaner characterizations of the variance of MMD estimators, revealing something that might be surprising to those in the area: while zero MMD implies a degenerate estimator, it is sometimes possible to have a degenerate estimator with nonzero MMD as well; we give a construction and a proof that it does not happen in common situations.
papers.comment: v2: various improvements, as published at TMLR - https://openreview.net/forum?id=KjXW75GHHF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对两样本检验中最大均值差异（MMD）通常假设样本量相等的局限，通过推广广义U-统计量理论，将MMD估计扩展到不等样本量情形。摘要给出了不等样本量下MMD估计量的渐近分布新刻画，并提出了优化检验效力的准则，同时揭示了MMD估计量退化与零MMD之间关系的新性质。
Motivation: 现有基于MMD的两样本检验方法通常假设样本量相等，实际应用中常需丢弃数据，降低检验效力。
Method: 通过推广广义U-统计量理论，对常规MMD估计量进行扩展，推导出不等样本量下的渐近分布，并给出优化检验效力的新准则。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但指出该方法保留所有可用数据，提高检验准确性，并给出了MMD估计量方差的更清晰刻画，发现非零MMD下也可能出现退化估计量（但常见情况不会）。
Conclusion: 该方法适用于不等样本量的两样本检验，通过保留全部数据提升检验准确性，并提供了对MMD估计量方差和退化性质的更深理解。

papers.title: MetaHGNIE: Meta-Path Induced Hypergraph Contrastive Learning in Heterogeneous Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Estimating node importance in heterogeneous knowledge graphs is a fundamental problem underlying recommendation, search, and knowledge decision systems. However, most existing methods rely on pairwise message passing mechanisms that fail to capture higher-order interactions induced by meta-relational structures. Furthermore, structural topology and semantic attributes are typically entangled within a unified embedding space, which obscures their distinct inductive biases and limits the discriminative capacity of learned importance representations. To address these limitations, we propose DualHNIE, a principled dual-channel hypergraph learning framework for node importance estimation. DualHNIE first constructs a higher-order knowledge graph by forming typed hyperedges from meta-path sequences, enabling explicit modeling of higher-order relational patterns. It then introduces two complementary encoders: a structure-aware hypergraph attention network that performs locally normalized aggregation over meta-path--induced hyperedges to capture localized structural dependencies, and a sparse--chunked hypergraph transformer that captures global semantic interactions while maintaining scalable computation. We further design a contrastive alignment mechanism with auxiliary supervision, ensuring cross-view consistency while preserving modality-specific representation. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that DualHNIE outperforms state-of-the-art methods, validating the effectiveness of explicit high-order modeling and disentangled dual-channel representation learning for heterogeneous knowledge graphs. Code and datasets are available https://github.com/jiawenchen10/DualHNIE.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对异质知识图谱中节点重要性估计问题，提出DualHNIE双通道超图学习框架。该框架通过元路径序列构建高阶超图，显式建模高阶关系模式；引入结构感知超图注意力网络和稀疏分块超图Transformer分别捕获局部结构依赖与全局语义交互，并通过对比对齐机制保持跨视角一致性。实验表明DualHNIE在多个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖成对消息传递，无法捕捉元关系结构导致的高阶交互；同时结构拓扑与语义属性在统一嵌入空间中纠缠，限制了表示判别能力。
Method: 提出DualHNIE框架，首先从元路径序列构建带类型超边的高阶知识图谱；然后采用双通道编码器：结构感知超图注意力网络进行局部归一化聚合，稀疏分块超图Transformer实现全局语义交互；最后设计对比对齐机制辅助监督，确保跨视角一致性并保持模态特异性表示。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，DualHNIE优于现有方法，验证了显式高阶建模和解耦双通道表示学习的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文强调显式高阶建模和解耦双通道表示学习对异质知识图谱节点重要性估计的有效性，代码和数据集已开源。
