papers.title: How Do I Know What to Say Next? Barenholtz's Autogenerative Theory as an Enrichment of Harrisean Integrationism
papers.abstract_en: Roy Harris's Integrationist linguistics offers a compelling critique of the referentialist tradition embedded deep at the heart of computational approaches to language, arguing that language is not a code that maps onto a pre-given world but a situated, bipartite activity oriented toward prospective joint action. Yet Integrationism leaves certain explanatory gaps: it does not fully account for the structural mechanism by which signs sustain prospective openness, it undertheorises the continuity between linguistic and non-linguistic semiotic activity, and it offers no detailed account of the structural properties of the accumulated archive of past integrations. This paper argues that Elan Barenholtz's autogenerative theory of language, developed in response to the behaviour of Large Language Models (LLMs), can fill precisely these gaps, enriching Integrationism without undermining any of its core commitments. Specifically, the autogenerative account provides: a structural mechanism for the prospective openness that Harris identifies as central to bipartite communication; a computational correlate for Harris's thesis of semiotic continuity between language and other sign-making activity; and a theory of the archive: what the accumulated residue of past integrations looks like and how new participants draw upon it. The synthesis preserves Harris's ontological primacy of the situated integrative act while adding explanatory content that Integrationism itself does not supply. For practitioners and researchers in natural language processing and large language model design, the argument offers a principled account of what the statistical structure that LLMs so effectively exploit actually is, and of what it cannot, by its nature, provide.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出整合语言学（Integrationism）存在解释缺口，而Barenholtz的自动生成理论（autogenerative theory）可填补这些缺口，为语言的前瞻开放性、符号连续性及历史积累档案提供结构机制和计算对应物，同时保持整合语言学的核心主张。
Motivation: 整合语言学虽批判计算语言学的指称主义传统，但未能完全解释符号维持前瞻开放性的结构机制、语言与非语言符号活动的连续性，以及过往整合积累档案的结构特性。
Method: 通过将Barenholtz的自动生成理论融入整合语言学，提供前瞻开放性的结构机制、符号连续性的计算对应物，以及整合档案的理论说明。
Result: 论文声称该合成保留了整合语言学的情境整合行动本体论优先性，同时增加了整合语言学自身未提供的解释内容。
Conclusion: 对于自然语言处理和大型语言模型领域，该论证提供了对LLM所利用的统计结构本质及其局限性的原则性解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distributed Sketching on Data Partitions for OLS Regression
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies distributed sketching for ordinary least squares (OLS) regression, an approach that distributes small sketches of a large data set over multiple machines to separately construct OLS estimators and average them. Unlike prior studies that consider sketching on the whole data set, we consider sketching on partitioned subsets to further reduce computational cost. Under the fixed design setting, we characterize the exact excess loss of the averaged OLS estimator. Results show that this loss is comparable to the established loss for sketching on the whole data set when the divergence among subset covariances is small.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted at Statistics&Probability Letters, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分布式草图（distributed sketching）用于普通最小二乘（OLS）回归的方法，将数据集分区后每个机器上构建小草图并分别计算OLS估计量，再取平均。在固定设计下推导了平均估计量的精确超额损失，并证明当各子集协方差差异较小时，该损失与在整个数据集上草图的已有结果相当。
Motivation: 现有分布式草图方法通常对整个数据集进行草图化，计算成本较高；本文通过在数据分区上分别草图化，进一步降低计算和通信开销。
Method: 将数据集划分为若干子集，每个子集独立构建草图，在本地计算OLS估计量，最后将各估计量取平均作为全局估计。
Result: 在固定设计设定下，推导了平均OLS估计量的精确超额损失表达式，并证明当子集协方差矩阵间的发散度较小时，该损失与全局草图方法相当。
Conclusion: 该方法适合子集协方差差异较小的场景，可与全局草图方法媲美，同时降低计算成本。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Mixtures of spatial factor analyzers for tensor-variate data
papers.abstract_en: A mixture of spatial factor analyzers (MSFA) is introduced to address the challenges of clustering high-dimensional spatial data. By leveraging the underlying coordinate system, the proposed framework incorporates a flexible, spline-based spatial decay covariance structure that prevents parameter inflation as dimensionality increases. To model non-spatial dependence, matrix variate factor analyzers are employed for further dimensionality reduction. Parameter estimation is conducted via a variant of the expectation-maximization algorithm combined with a generalized least squares estimator. The proposed models are explored in the context of tensor-variate data analysis, where simulation studies and applications to Raman spectroscopy and hyperspectral texture databases demonstrate their capacity to accurately infer and differentiate distinct spatial patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出混合空间因子分析模型（MSFA），用于处理高维空间数据的聚类问题。通过利用底层坐标系，模型引入灵活的基于样条的空间衰减协方差结构，避免参数随维度增加而膨胀。为建模非空间依赖，使用矩阵变量因子分析进一步降维。参数估计采用期望最大化算法与广义最小二乘估计的组合。在张量数据背景下，通过模拟、拉曼光谱和高光谱纹理数据库展示了模型准确推断和区分不同空间模式的能力。
Motivation: 高维空间数据聚类面临参数膨胀和计算挑战，现有方法难以有效捕捉空间和非空间依赖关系。
Method: 提出混合空间因子分析模型，整合基于样条的空间衰减协方差矩阵处理空间依赖，并利用矩阵变量因子分析处理非空间依赖，通过改进的EM算法和广义最小二乘估计进行参数推断。
Result: 模拟研究和实际应用（拉曼光谱、高光谱纹理数据库）表明，模型能准确推断和区分不同的空间模式。
Conclusion: 该框架为高维空间数据聚类提供了一种灵活且计算可行的方案，特别适用于张量数据分析。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Time-to-Collision Based Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance Using Pretrained Vision Models for Robots in Unstructured Environments
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic obstacle avoidance in unstructured outdoor environments remains a critical challenge for autonomous mobile robots, particularly when large-scale robot-specific training data and simulation-based policies are impractical. We present a data-efficient, interpretable method for vision-based dynamic obstacle avoidance that operates entirely on real-world data, avoiding the sim-to-real transfer problem inherent in simulation-trained policies. Our approach leverages UniDepth, a large pretrained monocular depth estimation model, to produce dense depth maps from RGB video without requiring stereo cameras or LiDAR at inference time. Dynamic obstacle avoidance is achieved by extending the SuperPoint and SuperGlue feature correspondence pipeline to track keypoints across long frame sequences, projecting their 2D pixel-space positions into 3D using camera intrinsics and predicted depth, running bundle adjustment initialized from these 3D keypoints, and computing per-keypoint time-to-collision (TTC). A 2D motion primitive in the ground plane is then selected to move the robot away from the closest point of approach of the minimum-TTC keypoint. Evaluated on real-world data from the M3ED dataset, our pipeline achieves a precision of 0.49 and a recall of 0.38 in identifying frames with a ground truth TTC below 1 second, and correctly generates the evasive motion direction in 84\% of true positive detections. Crucially, it detects at least one frame with TTC less than 1 second for 20 out of 22 unique physical obstacles present in our test sequences. Unlike end-to-end learned methods that demand thousands of hours of robot-specific training data, our approach eliminates model training entirely, requiring only 74 seconds of data for hyperparameter tuning. This demonstrates exceptional data efficiency while preserving interpretable and generalizable behavior across diverse obstacle types.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据高效、可解释的视觉动态避障方法，利用预训练单目深度估计模型UniDepth和SuperPoint+SuperGlue特征匹配管线，通过计算关键点的碰撞时间（TTC）来选择避障动作。在M3ED数据集上，对TTC<1秒的帧识别精度0.49、召回0.38，正确生成躲避方向的比例84%，且对22个障碍中的20个至少检测到一帧TTC<1秒。该方法无需模型训练，仅需74秒数据调整超参数，避免了模拟到现实的迁移问题。
Motivation: 现有基于模拟训练的避障策略面临sim-to-real迁移困难，且大规模机器人专用训练数据难以获取；本文希望开发无需大量机器人专用数据、可直接在真实世界运行的避障方法。
Method: 利用预训练的单目深度估计模型UniDepth生成稠密深度图，扩展SuperPoint和SuperGlue特征匹配管线进行长序列关键点跟踪；将2D像素投影到3D并进行束调整优化，计算每个关键点的碰撞时间（TTC）；然后选择地面平面上的2D运动原语使机器人远离最小TTC关键点的最近接近点。
Result: 在M3ED数据集上，对TTC<1秒的帧识别精度0.49、召回0.38，正确生成躲避方向的比例84%；在22个物理障碍中检测到20个至少一帧TTC<1秒。仅需74秒数据调整超参数。
Conclusion: 该方法完全基于真实数据，无需模型训练，数据高效且可解释，泛化性良好，避免了sim-to-real问题；但精度和召回率仍有提升空间。

summary_sections.result: 在M3ED数据集上，对TTC<1秒的帧识别精度0.49、召回0.38，正确生成躲避方向的比例84%；在22个物理障碍中检测到20个至少一帧TTC<1秒。仅需74秒数据调整超参数。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法完全基于真实数据，无需模型训练，数据高效且可解释，泛化性良好，避免了sim-to-real问题；但精度和召回率仍有提升空间。

papers.title: Optimal Learning Rate Scaling Depends on Data in Deep Scalar Linear Networks
papers.abstract_en: In this short note we consider the gradient descent dynamics of deep scalar linear networks, $f(x) = \prod_{l=1}^L w_l x$, which enjoy exact time-course solutions for any integer depth. We show that even in this minimal model, the optimal depth-wise learning rate scaling depends on data, whereas data-agnostic scaling rules fail to transfer across depths. Under the data-dependent optimal scaling, the learning dynamics is independent of data and weakly dependent on depth, resulting in a constant linear convergence rate across all depths including infinity. We further show similar data-dependent effects in deep scalar linear networks with residual connections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度标量线性网络中的梯度下降动力学，发现在这一简化模型中，最优的深度方向学习率缩放依赖于数据，而与数据无关的缩放规则无法在不同深度间迁移。在数据依赖的最优缩放下，学习动力学与数据无关且对深度弱依赖，从而在所有深度（包括无穷深）实现恒定线性收敛速度。残差连接网络也表现出类似的数据依赖效应。
Motivation: 标准神经网络中的学习率缩放规则通常与数据无关，但实际训练中深度和数据的交互可能影响最优缩放。该文旨在通过可解析求解的深度标量线性网络，揭示数据依赖对最优学习率缩放的必要性。
Method: 对深度标量线性网络（f(x)=∏w_l x）的梯度下降动力学进行精确解析分析，推导出最优学习率缩放条件，并比较数据依赖与数据无关缩放的影响，同时扩展到残差连接网络。
Result: 数据依赖的最优缩放使得学习动力学与数据无关，且收敛速率在任意深度下为常数线性；数据无关缩放则导致深度间性能差异。残差连接网络同样呈现数据依赖效应。
Conclusion: 即使在极简线性模型中，最优学习率缩放也必须考虑数据特性，数据无关的缩放规则不适用于不同深度；该结果可能为深度神经网络的学习率调度提供理论启示。

papers.title: Nigeria Machinery: A Low-Resource Industrial Dataset with a Domain-Grounded Reasoning Layer
papers.abstract_en: There is relatively little, public, and model-ready data on industrial machinery for African economies. This makes it hard to do quantitative analysis or to train language models on numeric tasks grounded in that setting. We release two things to help with part of this problem. The first is the Nigeria Machinery Usage and Failures Dataset: 89 machine-level records across 28 indicators, covering Nigeria's manufacturing and oil and gas sectors from 2006 to 2025. Every record names a public source and is decoded by a codebook. The second is a method for building chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning examples from these sparse numeric values. The result is 94 prompt, completion, and reasoning-trace rows. In every row, the prompt names the real indicator, subsector, year, and source of the record it comes from. The data adaptation work was carried out by Adaption Labs. Along the way we describe a problem that is common when language models are used to build datasets. The prompts can match the real numbers while saying nothing about the real domain. We show that fixing this raises the share of domain-grounded prompts from 1 out of 78 in an earlier release to 94 out of 94, and that every retrieval answer now matches its source value (84 out of 84). We release the data, the reasoning layer, and a per-row provenance file under CC-BY-4.0. We are clear about the limits. With 89 records and 17 indicators that have only one observation, this is a reference and seed dataset, not a large training set. Most reasoning rows are retrieval rather than multi-step computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布了一个尼日利亚工业机械数据集（89条记录，28个指标，覆盖2006-2025年制造业和油气行业），并提供了一种从稀疏数值构建链式推理（CoT）示例的方法。作者指出，用语言模型构建数据集时常见的问题是提示匹配数字但不反映真实领域；他们通过方法改进，使领域接地提示的比例从1/78提升至94/94，检索答案全部匹配源值（84/84）。数据及推理层以CC-BY-4.0开源，但作者明确其局限性：规模小，仅作为参考和种子数据集。
Motivation: 非洲经济体工业机械的公开、模型就绪数据稀缺，阻碍了定量分析和基于该场景的数值语言模型训练。
Method: 收集尼日利亚机械使用与故障数据（89条记录，28个指标），并为每条记录构建包含真实指标、子行业、年份和来源的链式推理示例，同时修正提示中领域信息缺失的问题。
Result: 领域接地提示的比例从早期版本的1/78提升至94/94，检索答案全部匹配源值（84/84）。数据集规模小，但提供了完整的溯源信息。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个小而可信的工业数据集和推理层，适合作为参考和种子数据，但不宜直接用作大规模训练集；多数推理行是检索而非多步计算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Functional and Secure Code Generation with Task Vectors
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, but they struggle to generate functional code free of security vulnerabilities. Prior work to improve the secure code generation abilities of such coding LLMs has largely focused on evaluating code functionality and security separately using different datasets, or focused on finding vulnerabilities post-generation. At the same time, the text-generation domain has seen significant work on alignment techniques, where models are tuned such that their outputs exhibit certain qualities (e.g., helpfulness, harmlessness). Of particular interest is task-vector arithmetic, where linear operations on LLM weights can be used to arbitrarily enhance alignment while incurring only minimal computational overhead. We develop a novel method, SecVecCoder, leveraging task vectors to produce trustworthy code that is simultaneously functional and secure without the need for post-generation adjustment. Across six coding LLMs from three families on the CodeGuard+ benchmark, SecVecCoder improves the rate of trustworthy code completions by 2.1-36.0 percentage points over the base model, with improvements on unseen CWE types reaching up to 39.1 percentage points. Since the effectiveness of the coding LLM relies only on changing the model weights, SecVecCoder requires no method-specific decoding and hence achieves a decoding latency within 0.6% of the base model's, on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SecVecCoder，利用任务向量（task vectors）算术操作来同时提升代码生成的功能性和安全性，无需事后调整。在 CodeGuard+ 基准测试上，该方法在六个编码大语言模型上将可信代码补全率提升 2.1–36.0 个百分点，对未见过的 CWE 类型提升高达 39.1 个百分点，且解码延迟仅增加约 0.6%。
Motivation: 现有代码生成模型难以同时生成功能正确且无安全漏洞的代码，而前期工作通常分离评估功能性和安全性或仅在生成后修复漏洞，缺乏高效的同步优化方法。
Method: 提出 SecVecCoder，通过对编码 LLM 权重执行线性任务向量算术（如相加或相减）来融合功能性和安全性对齐，无需方法特定的解码策略。
Result: 在六个编码 LLM（来自三个模型族）上，SecVecCoder 在 CodeGuard+ 基准上将可信代码补全率相对于基模型提高 2.1–36.0 个百分点，其中对未见过的 CWE 类型改善达 39.1 个百分点，解码延迟平均仅增加 0.6%。
Conclusion: 任务向量算术能高效地将功能性和安全性对齐注入编码 LLM，无需事后调整或专用解码，为生成可信代码提供了一种轻量级、通用的方法。

papers.title: GIRAF: Towards Generalizable Human Interactions with Articulated Objects
papers.abstract_en: Synthesizing realistic full-body human interactions with articulated objects is a fundamental challenge for embodied AI and graphics, with applications in robotics training and virtual agents. Existing models remain limited: some focus on simple activities with static objects, while others restrict attention to hand-only manipulation. This leaves open the problem of generating coordinated full-body motion that approaches, manipulates, and moves articulated objects in a realistic and generalizable way. The key difficulty lies in reasoning jointly about locomotion, fine-grained contact, and object articulation. Models must capture subtle hand-object correspondences that transfer across object geometries, while also producing seamless transitions from navigation to manipulation. At the same time, the scarcity of large-scale paired motion-scene data makes it difficult to generalize across diverse object positions and shapes. We introduce a text-conditioned diffusion model that addresses these challenges through three core ideas: an object-centric representation that unifies hand-object contact with object surfaces, a mixed-domain training strategy that balances locomotion and interaction, and a contact-based augmentation scheme that expands training diversity. Through experiments, our method demonstrated strong generalization to unseen object configurations, surpassing current state-of-the-art methods.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the Third Workshop on Human Motion Generation (HuMoGen), CVPR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种文本条件扩散模型GIRAF，用于生成全身与可活动物体（如门、抽屉）交互的逼真动作。核心贡献包括：以物体为中心的表征统一手-物接触与物体表面、混合域训练策略平衡导航与操作、基于接触的增强方案增加训练多样性。实验表明该方法在未见过的物体配置上泛化能力强于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有全身交互模型要么针对静态物体简单活动，要么仅限手部操作，缺乏协调全身运动与可活动物体交互的通用方法。关键难点在于同时推理移动、精细接触和物体关节运动，且缺乏大规模配对数据。
Method: 提出文本条件扩散模型，包含三个核心设计：物体为中心的表征将手-物接触与物体表面统一建模；混合域训练策略平衡导航和操作动作；基于接触的数据增强方案扩展训练多样性。
Result: 实验表明方法在未见过的物体配置上展现出强泛化能力，超越当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 该方法通过物体为中心的表征、混合域训练和接触增强，解决了全身与可活动物体交互的通用性问题，但主要限于合成数据评估。

papers.title: Global reanalysis from observations alone with machine learning
papers.abstract_en: Earth system reanalysis datasets are foundational for weather and climate research and provide the gridded training data used by most machine learning weather prediction systems. Here we show results from a prototype system that suggest that machine learning models trained only on Earth system observations can potentially be used to generate multi-decade global reanalyses without using physics-based numerical models. The resulting gridded fields capture large-scale atmospheric structure and variability across multiple timescales, while exhibiting signs of physical coherence in several key dynamical diagnostics. Evaluations of the prototype against held-out independent atmospheric observations indicate that the root mean square vector error of upper-level winds is close to that of ERA5 when compared at a consistent resolution, and that the standard deviation of the error at the surface is between that of 4th- and 5th-generation ECMWF reanalyses (ERA-Interim and ERA5). Furthermore, while traditional reanalysis production is computationally expensive, typically taking several years to produce, the reanalysis presented here was generated during the course of a single working day. These results suggest that observation-trained machine learning models offer a promising new approach for reanalysis production from observations alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种仅基于地球系统观测数据训练机器学习模型、而不使用物理数值模型来生成全球再分析数据集的原型系统。结果显示，生成的网格化场能够捕捉多时间尺度的大气结构及变率，并在关键动力学诊断中表现出物理一致性。与独立观测对比，上层层流均方根向量误差接近ERA5，地表误差标准差介于ERA-Interim与ERA5之间；且整个再分析生成过程仅需一个工作日，远快于传统再分析。
Motivation: 传统再分析数据集生成依赖物理数值模型，计算成本高、耗时数年；同时，多数机器学习天气预报模型也依赖再分析作为训练数据。探索仅从观测数据学习生成再分析的可能性，有望大幅降低计算开销并加快更新周期。
Method: 构建了一个机器学习原型系统，仅以地球系统观测数据为训练输入，无需物理数值模型，直接学习生成全球网格化再分析场。评估时与ERA5等独立观测及再分析产品进行对比。
Result: 上层层流均方根向量误差接近ERA5（一致分辨率下），地表误差标准差介于ERA-Interim与ERA5之间；再分析生成时间仅需一个工作日（传统需数年）。
Conclusion: 仅依赖观测训练的机器学习模型为再分析生成提供了一种有前景的新途径，有望在保持一定精度的同时极大提升效率。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning Under Small-Data Constraints: Lessons from Abrasive Waterjet Milling
papers.abstract_en: In physically dominated machining processes, experimental datasets are small, expensive, and material-specific; in this regime, data curation, evaluation design, and the form of physics integration can matter as much as the learning algorithm. Using an abrasive waterjet milling dataset ($n{=}155$, Inconel\,718), we make three methodological contributions. First, we separate physics-based data \emph{cleaning} from statistical \emph{curation} and treat the latter as competing modelling hypotheses rather than silent preprocessing. Second, we find that model rankings from a 15-point hold-out set can be unstable: the single-split winner drops from rank~1 to rank~7 under 10-fold cross-validation, while Gaussian Process (GP) variants occupy the top ranks. Third, we study a spectrum of physics integration levels and find that residual learning on a compact physics baseline is competitive for GP, yielding lower variance and an interpretable decomposition, but degrades tree-based models. Bayesian hyper parameter tuning improves parameter-sensitive baselines such as gradient boosting and SVR, yet harms multi-stage hybrid pipelines at this sample size. GP uncertainty intervals are approximately calibrated ($86\%$ empirical coverage at nominal $90\%$). The resulting picture is methodological: for small, expensive process datasets, our results suggest that, in this setting, reliable model comparison benefits from explicit curation hypotheses, robust evaluation, and careful choices about how physics enters the model.

TL;DR: 本文在磨料水射流铣削的小样本数据集（n=155）上研究物理信息机器学习的实践问题，发现数据整理策略、评估设计和物理知识集成方式比学习算法本身更重要。实验表明单次划分的模型排名不稳定，高斯过程变体表现最优，残差学习对高斯过程有效但对树模型有害，贝叶斯超参数调优对部分基线有益但会降低多阶段混合管线的性能。
Motivation: 物理主导的加工过程数据集通常规模小、昂贵且针对特定材料，此时数据整理、评估设计和物理知识集成方式与学习算法同等重要，但缺乏系统的方法论研究。
Method: 使用磨料水射流铣削数据集（Inconel 718，n=155），提出三个贡献：分离基于物理的数据清洗与统计整理，将后者视为竞争性建模假设；比较单次划分与10折交叉验证的模型排名稳定性；研究不同物理集成程度（残差学习、基线融合等）对不同模型（GP、树模型、SVR等）的影响，并进行贝叶斯超参数调优。
Result: 单次15点测试集上的冠军模型在10折交叉验证中从第1名降至第7名，GP变体占据前几名；残差学习降低了GP的方差并提供可解释分解，但降低了树模型性能；贝叶斯调优改进了梯度提升和SVR等参数敏感基线，但损害了小样本下的多阶段混合管线；GP不确定性区间近似校准（名义90%覆盖率达86%）。
Conclusion: 对于小样本昂贵过程数据集，可靠的模型比较需要明确的数据整理假设、稳健的评估以及谨慎选择物理知识进入模型的方式。

papers.title: CTA-Pipelining: A Latency-Oriented Spatial Scaling Method for Multi-GPU Systems
papers.abstract_en: The evolution of compute infrastructure has transformed multi-GPU systems into tightly integrated shared-memory structures. However, current software still mostly treats these coherent interconnects simply as high-speed networks. Simultaneously, the demand for serving Large Language Models under latency constraints has shifted GPU workload optimization from being throughput-driven to latency-bound, necessitating latency-oriented scaling methods beyond Tensor Parallelism (TP). Thus, we introduce CTA-pipelining, an execution paradigm designed to exploit shared-memory multi-GPU systems. As a latency-oriented spatial scaling technique, CTA-pipelining leverages dependencies at the Cooperative Thread Array level, enabling concurrent execution of dependent kernels across GPUs. We demonstrate its capability using CUTLASS, cuBLAS, and NCCL libraries on 8-GPU H200 and B200 systems. Results show on 2-layer GEMM, representing the MLP operation, CTA-pipelining reduces latency by up to 31.8% compared to micro-batching, and 29.6% compared to TP. It can also be combined with TP as an orthogonal scaling dimension to further push the latency boundary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多GPU系统中大语言模型服务的延迟约束，提出CTA-pipelining执行范式，在Cooperative Thread Array级别利用依赖关系实现跨GPU的依赖内核并发执行。在8-GPU H200和B200系统上，对2层GEMM（代表MLP操作）的测试显示，相比微批处理和Tensor Parallelism，延迟分别降低31.8%和29.6%，且可与TP正交组合进一步优化延迟。
Motivation: 当前多GPU系统软件将一致性互连视为高速网络，未能充分利用共享内存结构；同时大语言模型延迟约束促使GPU优化从吞吐驱动转向延迟受限，现有Tensor Parallelism等方法需要新的延迟导向扩展方法。
Method: 提出CTA-pipelining，一种在Cooperative Thread Array级别利用依赖关系的执行范式，实现依赖内核在多个GPU上并发执行。使用CUTLASS、cuBLAS和NCCL库在8-GPU H200和B200系统上实现。
Result: 在2层GEMM操作上，CTA-pipelining相比微批处理降低延迟31.8%，相比Tensor Parallelism降低29.6%，且可与TP正交组合进一步降低延迟。
Conclusion: CTA-pipelining是一种有效的延迟导向空间扩展方法，能够利用多GPU共享内存系统，与TP正交组合可进一步优化延迟。目前仅在特定硬件和操作上验证，未来可扩展到更复杂模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Feedback Manipulation Regularization: Enabling Offline Agent Alignment for Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) research has increasingly shifted focus towards alignment, ensuring agents learn behaviors adhering to human values. While human demonstrations and feedback have proven crucial for alignment, existing approaches predominantly combine these signals using multi-stage pipelines designed for the contextual bandit framing of language generation. Yet little work explores how these complementary inputs can serve as a richer, interconnected signal for single-stage offline training in fully sequential decision-making environments. We propose Feedback Manipulation Regularization (FMR), an algorithm-agnostic method that harnesses evaluative feedback as a corrective signal to improve the alignment of imitation learning policies. We adapt Safety Gymnasium environments to be a principled testbed for alignment evaluation, demonstrating improved aptitude and up to a 98\% reduction in misalignment across a range of imitation learning algorithms. FMR remains robust in limited data regimes, even when learning from scarce aligned and uninformative noisy demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出反馈操作正则化（FMR），一种算法无关的方法，利用评估性反馈作为纠正信号来改进模仿学习策略的对齐能力。在Safety Gymnasium环境上，该方法在多种模仿学习算法中实现了高达98%的失配减少，并在数据稀缺场景下保持鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有强化学习对齐方法多采用多阶段流水线处理人类演示和反馈，缺乏在完全序列决策环境下利用这些互补信号进行单阶段离线训练的探索。
Method: 提出反馈操作正则化（FMR），通过操纵反馈信号作为修正项，在离线模仿学习框架中整合评估性反馈，算法无关且适用于多种模仿学习算法。
Result: 在改编的Safety Gymnasium环境中，FMR将失配行为减少高达98%，并在有限数据下表现鲁棒。
Conclusion: FMR提供了一种简单有效的方式，利用人类反馈改善模仿学习策略的对齐，无需复杂的多阶段训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Models in Straight-Through Underwriting
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is beginning to reshape actuarial practice, particularly in domains that require reasoning over unstructured documents, heterogeneous data sources, and regulated decision workflows. Actuaries now face a design space that ranges from traditional rule-based automation to large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-agent ``agentic'' systems that plan, retrieve, call tools, and reflect. This paper examines how these emerging architectures can support actuarial priorities such as transparency, auditability, and human-in-the-loop governance, with a focus on straight-through decision processes. To make these ideas concrete, we develop and analyze an agentic AI framework for straight-through underwriting of small commercial Business Owner Policies (BOPs). We construct a synthetic but realistic experimental environment and compare three underwriting pipelines: (i) a single-LLM baseline, (ii) a naive RAG system, and (iii) a multi-agent ``Agentic RAG'' pipeline that combines targeted retrieval, third-party data checks, and explicit multi-step rule evaluation. The agentic system performs best overall, with the largest gains in multi-step and missing-information scenarios, where structured retrieval and reflection help the model avoid unsupported straight-through decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了代理人式AI（agentic AI）和检索增强生成（RAG）在保险直通式承保中的应用。针对小型商业企业主保单（BOPs），构建了一个合成实验环境，比较了单LLM基线、朴素RAG系统和多智能体“Agentic RAG”管道三种承保流程。实验表明，Agentic RAG在处理多步骤和缺失信息场景中表现最佳，能避免不合理的直通式决策，同时满足透明度、可审计性和人机协同治理的保险精算需求。
Motivation: 传统规则式自动化难以处理非结构化文档和异构数据，而现有LLM和RAG系统在需要多步骤推理和缺失信息场景下可能做出不支持的直通式决策。需要一种兼顾透明度、审计性和治理要求的承保架构。
Method: 提出一个多智能体Agentic RAG框架，结合目标检索、第三方数据检查和显式多步骤规则评估，并与单LLM基线和朴素RAG系统进行对比实验。利用合成但现实的实验环境，聚焦小型商业企业主保单的直通式承保。
Result: Agentic RAG管道在整体性能上最优，尤其是在多步骤和缺失信息场景中优势明显，结构化检索与反思机制帮助模型避免不合理的直通式决策。
Conclusion: 该研究展示了代理人式AI在保险承保中的可行性，特别强调了在复杂决策中结合检索、工具调用和反思的重要性，但局限在于实验基于合成数据，实际应用需进一步验证。

papers.title: Multi-agent Autoformalization of Tensor Network Theory
papers.abstract_en: We build a team of specialized large language-model agents and present an agent-driven workflow for research-level formalization in theoretical physics, with the autoformalization of the fundamental theorem of matrix-product states as a demonstration. The agents, coordinated through a structured mathematical blueprint and periodic human review, orchestrated and executed the full formalization autonomously. For some statements, the agents were able to explore new proof routes that are not part of the standard literature. Along the way the agents produced extensive tensor-network and quantum-information libraries not previously available in Mathlib, Lean's mathematical library. As a physical application, the formalization also extends towards symmetry-protected topological phases in one dimension. We find that the main bottleneck in large-scale autoformalization is enforcing mathematical intent and we provide a detailed study of the full process and various subtleties involved. We release the codebase as the library \href{https://github.com/LionSR/TNLean}{TNLean}, together with a \nChapters{}-chapter \href{https://lionsr.github.io/TNLean/blueprint/}{blueprint} of the formalization effort.
papers.comment: 5+2+33 pages; 3+3+11 figures; 6 tables; An accompanying blueprint document is available at https://lionsr.github.io/TNLean/blueprint-ch01-12.pdf
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个由专门大语言模型智能体组成的团队，用于理论物理的研究级自动形式化。以矩阵乘积态基本定理为演示，智能体通过结构化数学蓝图和定期人工审查自主完成形式化，并探索了标准文献之外的新证明路径。工作产出了Mathlib中新增的张量网络和量子信息库，并延伸至一维对称保护拓扑相。主要瓶颈在于强制执行数学意图。
Method: 提出多智能体驱动工作流：每个智能体具有专门角色，通过结构化数学蓝图和定期人工审查协调，自主执行形式化过程。使用大语言模型作为智能体基础，自动生成证明并探索新路径。
Result: 成功形式化矩阵乘积态基本定理，部分陈述探索出非标准证明路径；生成Mathlib中此前缺乏的张量网络和量子信息库；形式化延伸至一维对称保护拓扑相。
Conclusion: 展示了多智能体自动形式化在理论物理中的可行性，识别出强制执行数学意图为主要瓶颈；发布了TNLean代码库和详细蓝图。

papers.title: NFTR: From Provable Mode-Averaging to Geodesic Subgoal Selection in Offline Goal-Conditioned RL
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical Implicit Q-Learning (HIQL), an offline goal-conditioned RL method, selects subgoals by value-function advantages alone. This rule has two coupled failure modes. Optimistic bias treats lucky stochastic outcomes as skillful choices, and mode collapse reduces a multi-modal subgoal distribution to a single Gaussian mean that often falls in unreachable regions. We propose NFTR (Normalizing Flows subgoal policies with Triangle-slack Reweighting). A conditional Normalizing Flow replaces the Gaussian policy, and a closed-form mode-averaging result identifies NFs as the minimal generative class for AWR-based subgoal selection. A triangle slack score, built on the architectural triangle inequality without relying on distance accuracy, multiplicatively corrects the AWR weight to downweight subgoals whose detour cost exceeds average reachability. Triangle-slack vanishes on geodesics in deterministic MDPs and remains a conservative upper bound on composability violation under stochastic dynamics. The RWDR objective preserves AWR's population-level monotonic improvement and admits a three-term suboptimality decomposition. Together, these two ingredients yield subgoal selection that provably avoids the Gaussian collapse described above and remains stable under stochastic dynamics. GitHub page: https://github.com/erdemtbao/NFTR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对层次化隐式Q学习（HIQL）在离线目标条件RL中的两个耦合失败模式——乐观偏差和模式坍缩——提出NFTR方法。用条件归一化流（Normalizing Flow）替代高斯策略，并引入基于三角不等式松弛的三角松弛得分来修正AWR权重，从而避免子目标分布的模式坍缩。理论上证明了该方法在随机动力学下的稳定性。
Motivation: HIQL中子目标选择仅依赖值函数优势，导致乐观偏差（将随机好结果视为技能）和模式坍缩（多模态子目标分布退化为单个高斯均值，常落在不可达区域）。需要新方法解决这两个问题。
Method: 提出NFTR，包含两个组件：条件归一化流（NF）作为子目标策略，以及三角松弛得分（triangle slack score），基于架构三角不等式（不依赖距离精度）乘性修正AWR权重，降低绕路成本超过平均可达性的子目标权重。
Result: 摘要中未报告具体数值结果，但声称子目标选择可证明避免高斯坍缩并在随机动力学下保持稳定。提供了GitHub链接。
Conclusion: 该方法通过联合使用NF和三角松弛，实现了可证明的子目标选择稳定性，并保持了AWR的单调改进。

papers.title: False Confidence: Automated Labels Confound Fairness Audits in Cervical Spine Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Automated segmentation of cervical-spine MRI is increasingly used in clinical workflows, yet no fairness audit exists for this anatomy. We show that auditing these segmentation tasks is complicated by a common property of modern segmentation datasets: expert-annotated gold labels are expensive, so abundant machine-generated (silver) labels are added to limit annotation cost. This matters because the reference used to judge a model can itself be biased. In this study, we present the first fairness audit of cervical-spine MRI segmentation across sex, age, and race using the CSpineSeg dataset. We observe that the deployed model is demographically fair, but the choice of reference label, however, is not neutral. Because a dataset's silver labels are generated by a model trained on its gold labels, any new model trained on those same gold labels agrees more with the silver labels than with expert truth: scoring identical predictions against silver rather than gold overestimates performance by ~8 Dice points and turns the fairness verdict for age from non-significant to significant - not by the gap inflation Parikh et al. report (which we term false magnitude) but by collapsing within-group variance (which we term false confidence). Reference-label provenance is thus a first-order confounder in segmentation evaluation: performance and fairness should be reported against expert labels, and any fairness claim stated together with the provenance of its reference.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Under review at FAIMI 2026 (MICCAI workshop)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对颈椎MRI分割进行公平性审计，发现使用机器生成的银标（silver labels）代替专家金标（gold labels）评估模型会过度估计约8 Dice点，并改变公平性结论（年龄组从无显著差异变为显著），这种偏差并非来自性能差距膨胀（false magnitude），而是来自组内方差坍塌（false confidence）。作者强调评估模型时应使用专家标注，并报告标注来源。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对颈椎MRI分割模型的公平性审计，且常用低成本机器生成的银标作为参考，但银标本身可能含有偏差，影响审计结果。
Method: 使用CSpineSeg数据集，对比基于金标和银标评估同一分割模型在性别、年龄、种族维度上的性能差异和公平性结论。
Result: 银标将模型平均Dice得分高估约8点，并将年龄组公平性从无显著差异变为显著差异，这种效应由组内方差坍塌而非性能差距膨胀导致。
Conclusion: 参考标注的来源是分割评估中的一阶混淆因素，性能和公平性应基于专家标注报告，且公平性结论应伴随参考标注来源的说明。

papers.title: Kime-Representation Formulations of Three Open Problems in the Foundations of Classical Mechanics: Uncertainty, Invariant Entropy, and Directional Degrees of Freedom
papers.abstract_en: We give mathematically self-contained formulations, in the complex-time (kime) representation, of three open problems from the foundations of classical mechanics: (I) the extension of the classical entropic uncertainty principle to non-canonical variables and to multiple degrees of freedom; (II) the characterization of coordinate-invariant measures and entropies, i.e., the question of why continuous physical quantities must be paired for an invariant entropy to exist; and (III) the construction of a classical relativistic directional degree of freedom (a classical analogue of a spin-1/2 system). Throughout, the kime phase is interpreted {statistically as a latent circular random variable whose law Φmodels the intrinsic trial-to-trial variability of repeated, identically controlled experiments indexed by the kime magnitude. The mathematical bridge is an exact symplectic identification of the kime cone with the action-angle chart of a one-degree-of-freedom phase space, under which the kime measure is the Liouville measure and the phase law becomes the angular conditional of a Liouville density. Specifically, we (i) prove a sharp entropic uncertainty relation on the kime cylinder whose extremal family is von Mises x Gaussian, together with a sharp circular Fisher-information inequality saturated exactly by von Mises laws; (ii) prove an exact non-canonical uncertainty relation in which the correction term is the geometric mean of the Poisson bracket, clarifying the conjectured role of the expected bracket; (iii) prove aggregate multi-degree-of-freedom bounds via the Williamson normal form and Fischer's inequality, and isolate the per-degree-of-freedom refinement as a precise open problem of symplectic Schur-Horn type; (iv) prove that diffusion of the kime phase produces monotone entropy growth with the equipartitioned (Haar-uniform) phase law.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在复时间（kime）表示法中给出了经典力学基础中三个开放问题的数学自洽表述：不确定性原理扩展到非正则变量和多自由度、坐标不变度量和熵的表征、以及经典相对论定向自由度的构建。通过kime锥与单自由度相空间的辛等同，证明了尖锐的熵不确定关系、非正则不确定关系以及多自由度聚合界。
Motivation: 经典力学基础中仍存在未解决的开放问题，特别是关于不确定性原理的非正则扩展、不变熵的存在条件以及经典自旋类似物。
Method: 采用kime表示法，将kime相位解释为潜在圆形随机变量，通过辛等同将kime锥与单自由度相空间的角作用图联系起来，并利用Liouville测度、von Mises分布、Fisher信息不等式、Williamson标准型和Fischer不等式等工具进行数学证明。
Result: 证明了kime圆柱上的尖锐熵不确定关系（von Mises × Gaussian达到极值）、非正则不确定关系（修正项为泊松括号几何平均）、多自由度聚合界，并证明了kime相位的扩散产生单调熵增长（均衡Haar均匀相位）。
Conclusion: 给出了三个开放问题的精确数学表述和部分解答，但每自由度细化的精确开放问题仍为辛Schur-Horn类型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Graph Neural Network Model for Real-Time Gesture Recognition Based on sEMG Signals
papers.abstract_en: For seemless control of advanced hand prostheses and augmented reality, accurate and immediate hand gestures recognition is essential. Surface electromyography (sEMG) signals obtained from the forearm are commonly employed for this purpose. In this paper, we present a novel approach for sEMG representation that utilizes graph networks which contain information about muscle activation patterns in the forearm. Based on these graph networks, we have developed a machine learning algorithm capable of real-time hand gesture recognition using a graph neural network. The algorithm's performance was evaluated using sEMG signals acquired from myoband, which has 8 electrodes placed around the forearm, involving 8 healthy subjects. The proposed method demonstrated an average classification accuracy of 99\%, surpassing the performance of state-of-the-art techniques. The average time for both graph construction and prediction stood at 48ms utilizing a M1 pro CPU, rendering the approach well-suited for real-time applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的实时手势识别方法，利用从前臂采集的表面肌电（sEMG）信号构建肌肉激活模式图网络。使用Myoband（8电极）对8名健康受试者采集数据，平均分类准确率达99%，图构建与预测平均耗时48ms（M1 Pro CPU），优于现有技术，适合实时应用。
Motivation: 为了实现对先进假手和增强现实的无缝控制，需要准确且即时的的手势识别，而现有sEMG信号处理方法在实时性和准确性上仍有提升空间。
Method: 提出基于sEMG信号的图网络表示方法，将肌肉激活模式建模为图，并训练图神经网络（GNN）进行手势分类。
Result: 在8名受试者的Myoband数据上，平均分类准确率达99%，图构建与预测平均耗时48ms（M1 Pro CPU），优于现有技术。
Conclusion: 该GNN方法在sEMG手势识别中实现了高准确率和低延迟，适用于实时控制应用。

papers.title: When Does Continual Learning Require Learning
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly capable, the next question is how can we enable models to continually learn? Today, the field largely frames this as a problem of context management and mitigating forgetting. We argue this framing is incomplete: continual learning is fundamentally about increasing model competence as the world changes. We disentangle this change along two axes -- space, where the model encounters new domains, and time, where the underlying data drifts under a fixed task. This framing lets us study continual learning under realistic conditions: new domains arrive over time, facts drift past their training cutoff, and agentic interactions accumulate state across episodes. To evaluate methods under this setting, we recast widely used LLM benchmarks as sequential problems and introduce a single mechanism-agnostic protocol that compares prompt-based methods (GEPA, ACE), supervised learning (SFT, SDFT), reinforcement learning (GRPO, SDPO), and context compression (Cartridges, In-place TTT). Prompt-based methods fit each new stage quickly but degrade on future tasks. Distillation-based methods accumulate knowledge stably but struggle to update outdated facts. Context compression improves efficiency without substantially improving the ability to learn new tasks. Online reinforcement learning adapts most effectively to knowledge updates but remains sensitive to noisy reward signals. Overall, our results suggest that continual learning is not a single capability: different patterns of environmental change require fundamentally different update behaviors, determining when adaptation must be learned inside model weights and when it can be achieved through external scaffolding. We hope that understanding where each method succeeds and fails will guide the design of stronger continual learning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视持续学习的本质，认为其核心是在环境变化时提升模型能力，而非仅仅管理上下文和缓解遗忘。作者通过空间（新领域）和时间（数据漂移）两个维度分解环境变化，并引入统一的机制无关协议来评估多种方法（提示式、蒸馏式、上下文压缩、在线强化学习）在真实条件下的表现，结果表明不同类型的环境变化需要根本不同的更新行为。
Motivation: 现有持续学习框架过度关注上下文管理和遗忘缓解，忽略了持续学习旨在使模型随世界变化而增长能力的根本目标。
Method: 将LLM基准重铸为序列问题，引入机制无关的评估协议，比较提示式方法（GEPA, ACE）、监督学习（SFT, SDFT）、强化学习（GRPO, SDPO）和上下文压缩（Cartridges, In-place TTT）在多种环境变化模式下的表现。
Result: 提示式方法快速适应新阶段但损害未来任务；蒸馏式方法稳定积累知识但难以更新过时事实；上下文压缩提升效率但未能显著增强新任务学习能力；在线强化学习在知识更新上最有效，但对噪声奖励敏感。
Conclusion: 持续学习并非单一能力，不同环境变化模式需要根本不同的更新行为，需区分何时需要内部权重学习与何时可通过外部脚手架实现适应。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: VectorizationLLM: Smart Vectorization Based AI Assistant
papers.abstract_en: VectorizationLLM is a specialized Large Language Model based on Google open-weight LLMs. The model is designed to assist students to learn smart vectorization, time/wave vector analysis, piecewise functions, Fourier analysis, and differential equations in MATLAB. The course application is CTEC 247: Applied Computational Analysis II by the Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering Technology at New York Institute of Technology Old Westbury. The LLM model is designed to be an instructive assistant, providing detailed explanations of concepts with examples from in-class notes without providing direct answers to questions. The model is designed with a RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) knowledge base and system prompt architecture. Examples in both code, text, and images are provided in the LLM responses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VectorizationLLM 是一个基于 Google 开源大语言模型构建的专用 LLM，旨在帮助学生学习 MATLAB 中的智能向量化、时间/波向量分析、分段函数、傅里叶分析和微分方程。该模型通过 RAG 知识库和系统提示架构，以教学助手的形式提供带示例的详细解释，但不会直接给出答案。
Motivation: 现有教学工具往往直接提供答案，无法有效引导学生理解概念。需要一种能够结合课程笔记、提供解释性示例但不直接答题的 AI 助手。
Method: 基于 Google 开源 LLM（具体权重未指定）构建，采用检索增强生成（RAG）知识库和精心设计的系统提示架构。在响应中整合代码、文本和图像示例。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，仅说明模型作为教学助手，能提供带示例的解释且不直接给出答案。
Conclusion: 该模型是针对 CTEC 247: 应用计算分析 II 课程设计的教学辅助工具，强调概念解释与示例结合，但缺乏实验验证或泛化性讨论。

papers.title: Explaining Near-Zero Hessian Eigenvalues Through Approximate Symmetries in Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The Hessian of the training loss governs the local geometry of the loss landscape, yet despite existing explanations for its largest eigenvalues, the origin of the vast multitude of vanishingly small eigenvalues remains elusive. We argue that the bulk consists of the weakly lifted pseudo-Goldstone modes of the continuous symmetries of the network parametrization. In deep linear networks these symmetries are exact: they generate flat directions and hence exact zero modes, whose eigenvectors we construct explicitly. Introducing a ReLU nonlinearity as a perturbation, we show that it breaks these symmetries weakly and explicitly. Resolving the spectrum at the level of eigenvectors, we find that the high-curvature directions are orthogonal to the symmetry subspace, while the bulk lies almost entirely within it. We demonstrate the mechanism in a two-layer ReLU student--teacher model and in a network trained on CIFAR-10. A convolutional example demonstrates that the same diagnostic extends beyond fully connected layers. Together, these results link the Hessian bulk to weakly broken symmetries and clarify the origin of near-zero modes.

papers.title: Shift & Drift: A Zero-Shot Benchmark for Generalizable and Robust Autonomous Driving Motion Planning
papers.abstract_en: While closed-loop motion planners trained on large-scale, object-level datasets, e.g., nuPlan, demonstrate strong in-distribution (ID) performance, their generalization to novel urban topologies and recovery mechanisms following execution perturbations remain under-explored. To address this, we present Shift & Drift, a novel dual-track benchmark designed to rigorously stress-test motion planners across two critical axes of distribution shift: (1) The Semantic Shift Track leverages a novel conversion pipeline that transforms the aerial, DeepScenario Open 3D dataset into the nuPlan simulation framework. This enables zero-shot evaluation of planners trained on North American and Singaporean data against 1,182 scenarios spanning four German cities and the US city of San Francisco featuring dense pedestrian-cyclist interactions. (2) The State-Distribution Drift Track injects stochastic perturbations into the ego vehicle's dynamics to quantify robustness against compounding execution errors. Based on this, we systematically evaluate the failure modes of diverse planning paradigms under semantic and state-distribution shifts. While imitation learning methods achieve high scores in ID benchmarks, they exhibit significant failures under semantic shift, particularly in pedestrian-dense environments, and suffer from persistent drift when subjected to temporally correlated actuation noise. In contrast, the evaluated reinforcement-learning-based planner demonstrates more graceful degradation, maintaining higher safety and progress metrics across both tracks. Our findings reveal an empirical trade-off between imitation fidelity and closed-loop resilience, providing the community with a rigorous benchmark to evaluate progress toward reliable deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Shift & Drift，一个双轨基准测试，用于评估自动驾驶运动规划器在语义偏移（不同城市和行人密集场景）和状态分布漂移（执行扰动）下的泛化性和鲁棒性。在 nuPlan 框架上评估多种规划范式，发现模仿学习方法在域外场景中显著失效，而基于强化学习的方法退化更平滑。
Motivation: 现有闭环运动规划器在分布内性能良好，但在新城市拓扑和面对执行误差时的泛化与恢复能力尚未被充分探索。
Method: 构建双轨基准：语义偏移轨利用 DeepScenario Open 3D 数据集转换到 nuPlan 仿真环境，实现零样本评估；状态分布漂移轨注入随机随机扰动到自车动力学，量化对复合执行误差的鲁棒性。
Result: 模仿学习方法在分布内基准得分高，但在语义偏移下（尤其行人密集环境）安全指标大幅下降，且受到时间相关噪声时出现持续漂移；强化学习规划器安全性和进度指标退化更慢。
Conclusion: 揭示了模仿保真度与闭环鲁棒性之间的经验性权衡，为社区提供了评估可靠部署的严格基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GradInf: Gradient Estimation as Probabilistic Inference
papers.abstract_en: Gradient estimation -- the task of computing the gradient of the expected value of a probabilistic program -- has diverse applications in scientific computing, but is notoriously difficult because of issues such as high-dimensional integration, discrete random choices, and complex stochastic dependencies. This article introduces gradient inference, a new approach to developing sound and efficient gradient estimators for probabilistic programs. Gradient inference rests on a formal reduction from a gradient estimation problem to a closely related probabilistic inference problem, whose solution can be differentiated to obtain a gradient estimator. This inference problem is obtained by applying two powerful statistical operations -- coupling and factorization -- to the input probabilistic program. Our reduction lets us leverage the rich toolkit of probabilistic inference algorithms to design novel gradient estimators that extend and improve upon existing methods. We introduce GradInf, a probabilistic programming system that facilitates the sound and automated implementation of gradient inference. GradInf is centered around programmable source-to-source transformations for coupling and factorizing higher-order probabilistic programs, whose soundness is proven in terms of a denotational semantics. Key to our development is the use of information-flow typing to allow random choices in a probabilistic program to be factored out and partially evaluated, which improves our ability to deploy sophisticated probabilistic inference algorithms. The resulting system offers practitioners a principled framework for designing gradient estimators. We apply GradInf to several challenging case studies, showing that it can express prominent gradient estimators from the literature and enables the construction of new state-of-the-art estimators that outperform the best existing baselines.
papers.journal_ref: Proc. ACM Program. Lang. 10, PLDI, Article 243 (June 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出梯度推断（gradient inference）框架，将概率程序的梯度估计问题归约为概率推断问题，利用耦合（coupling）和因子分解（factorization）操作实现。基于此开发了GradInf系统，通过源到源变换和信息流类型系统，支持高阶概率程序的自动梯度估计。实验表明该方法能表达文献中的主流梯度估计器，并构建出优于现有基线的新估计器。
Motivation: 梯度估计在科学计算中广泛应用，但因高维积分、离散随机选择和复杂随机依赖而困难。现有方法缺乏统一且可靠的框架。
Method: 形式化地将梯度估计问题归约为一个相关的概率推断问题，该推断问题通过对输入概率程序应用耦合和因子分解得到。GradInf系统通过可编程的源到源变换实现这一归约，并利用信息流类型系统支持随机选择的因子化和部分求值。
Result: 在多个具有挑战性的案例研究中，GradInf能够表达文献中的主流梯度估计器，并构建出超越现有最佳基线的新估计器。
Conclusion: 梯度推断为设计梯度估计器提供了有原则的框架，GradInf系统证明了该方法的自动化和实用性。

papers.title: Infinity-Parser2 Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We present Infinity-Parser2, a large multimodal model that couples a controllable data-synthesis pipeline with multi-task reinforcement learning for end-to-end document parsing, addressing the persistent scarcity of faithfully annotated parsing corpora. Our contributions are threefold. First, we build a scalable synthesis engine, pairing a controllable rendering framework with an iterative refinement loop, and use it to construct and open-source Infinity-Doc2-5M: a 5-million-sample bilingual (Chinese/English) corpus spanning diverse document types, annotated with element bounding boxes, canonical content forms (Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, SMILES, structured charts), and full-page reading order. Second, we introduce a verifiable, multi-task reward system that enables Joint Reinforcement Learning across eight co-trained objectives (document parsing, layout analysis, table parsing, math formula parsing, chart parsing, chemical formula parsing, document VQA, and general multimodal understanding), unifying perception, structure, and reasoning in a single optimization signal. Third, we release two variants under a shared architecture: Infinity-Parser2-Flash, optimized for low-latency inference with a $3.68\times$ throughput gain over Infinity-Parser-7B, and Infinity-Parser2-Pro, engineered for precision-critical settings. Infinity-Parser2-Pro reaches state-of-the-art 87.6% on olmOCR-Bench and 74.3% on ParseBench, surpassing DeepSeek-OCR-2, PaddleOCR-VL-1.5, and MinerU2.5, with strong generalization to charts, chemical formulas, and document VQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Infinity-Parser2，一个结合可控数据合成管道与多任务强化学习的大规模多模态文档解析模型。通过构建 5 百万样本的中英双语语料库 Infinity-Doc2-5M，并设计可验证的多任务奖励系统，联合优化八个目标（包括文档解析、布局分析、表格/公式/图表/化学式解析、文档 VQA 及多模态理解）。发布两个变体：Flash 版（低延迟，吞吐量提升 3.68 倍）和 Pro 版（高精度，在 olmOCR-Bench 和 ParseBench 上分别达到 87.6% 和 74.3%）。
Motivation: 忠实标注的文档解析语料库持续稀缺，现有方法难以同时处理多种文档类型和结构。
Method: 构建可扩展的数据合成引擎（可控渲染框架+迭代精炼循环），生成大规模双语语料库；提出可验证的多任务奖励系统，通过联合强化学习优化八个预定义目标，统一感知、结构推理与理解。
Result: Infinity-Parser2-Pro 在 olmOCR-Bench 上达到 87.6%，在 ParseBench 上达到 74.3%，超过 DeepSeek-OCR-2、PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 和 MinerU2.5，并在图表、化学式及文档 VQA 上表现良好；Flash 版吞吐量提升 3.68 倍。
Conclusion: 论文展示了可控数据合成与多任务 RL 在文档解析中的有效性，但未讨论泛化到低资源语言或极端布局文档的局限性。

papers.title: Predicting Pseudo-nitzschia harmful algal blooms along the Portuguese Coast using satellite-derived predictors
papers.abstract_en: Pseudo-nitzschia diatoms pose recurrent risks to coastal ecosystems and shellfish harvesting along the Portuguese Atlantic coast. Here we develop and evaluate a spatio-temporal machine-learning framework to predict harmful algal bloom (HAB) occurrence using exclusively satellite-derived predictors under realistic forecasting constraints. We characterised environmental and biological variability across shellfish production zones (L1-L9) using 5,882 observations, providing system-wide context. Predictive models were developed for zones L1-L2, a hotspot for Pseudo-nitzschia and domoic acid events, using a decade-long dataset (2013-2023; 1,440 observations; more than 1,000 satellite-based predictors including sea surface temperature, an upwelling index, chlorophyll-a, and plankton functional types). Sampling locations were partitioned into ecologically meaningful sub-regions using a river-aware spatial clustering scheme. A stringent spatio-temporal cross-validation strategy that simultaneously withholds entire years and spatial clusters prevents leakage and closely mimics real-world forecasting conditions. HAB occurrence proved moderately predictable across model classes and feature configurations. Ensemble tree-based methods achieved the strongest discrimination: Random Forest reached 0.74 +/- 0.05 with environmental predictors; Extra Trees reached 0.77 +/- 0.06 with biological variables added. Feature-importance analyses revealed that seasonal structure, spatial context, and lagged environmental conditions dominate model decisions, while biological indicators refine bloom likelihood within physically favourable periods. The framework demonstrates operationally relevant skill for satellite-supported HAB early-warning systems along eastern boundary upwelling coasts.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 16 figures. Submitted to Harmful Algae (Elsevier)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对葡萄牙大西洋沿岸Pseudo-nitzschia硅藻引发的有害藻华（HAB）问题，构建了一个仅使用卫星衍生变量的时空机器学习预测框架。利用2013-2023年十年数据集（1440个观测值，超过1000个卫星特征），在产贝区L1-L2进行建模，通过河流感知空间聚类和严格的时空交叉验证策略，实现了对HAB发生的可预测性。集成树方法表现最佳：随机森林环境变量AUC为0.74±0.05，Extra Trees加入生物变量后达0.77±0.06。特征重要性分析表明季节结构、空间背景和滞后环境条件主导决策。
Motivation: Pseudo-nitzschia藻华对葡萄牙沿海生态系统和贝类捕捞构成反复风险，现有预测方法在真实预报约束下能力有限。
Method: 使用卫星衍生的海表温度、上升流指数、叶绿素a和浮游植物功能类型等超过1000个特征，结合河流感知空间聚类和同时留出整年与整簇的时空交叉验证，训练随机森林、Extra Trees等集成树模型。
Result: Extra Trees在加入生物变量后AUC达0.77±0.06，随机森林环境变量AUC为0.74±0.05，表明HAB发生可被卫星数据中度预测。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了卫星支持的有害藻华早期预警系统在东部边界上升流海岸的运营相关技能。

papers.title: From Triggers to Emotions: A CPM-Grounded Appraisal Multi-Agent for Dynamic Emotional Evolution in Persona-Based Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have substantially advanced persona-based dialogue agents for emotion-sensitive role simulation in healthcare, education, counseling, customer service, and interactive storytelling. However, two related lines of work leave a key gap. Persona-based dialogue systems often encode emotions as static traits or surface-level stylistic cues, and affective dialogue research has largely focused on empathetic response generation toward users rather than modeling the agent persona's own evolving emotional state. As a result, trigger-driven emotional evolution within a character remains underexplored. To address this limitation, we draw inspiration from the Component Process Model (CPM), a psychological theory that views emotion as a dynamic process shaped by the appraisal of external events. We propose CPM-MultiAgent, a CPM-grounded emotion evolution multi-agent framework for supporting emotional changes in persona-based dialogue. Instead of treating a character's emotion as a fixed attribute, CPM-MultiAgent represents it as a latent state that is continuously reshaped by dialogue triggers. Through affective trigger extraction, CPM-based collaborative appraisal, and emotion state updating, the framework enables more emotionally consistent role simulation in multi-turn interactions.Experiments with baseline comparisons, ablation studies, human evaluation, and case analyses demonstrate that CPM-MultiAgent effectively models dynamic emotional evolution in emotionally sensitive role-simulation settings.

Result: 通过基线比较、消融研究、人工评估和案例分析，CPM-MultiAgent在多轮交互中能够更一致地模拟角色的动态情感变化，优于静态情感设定方法。
Conclusion: 该框架证明了将心理学CPM模型融入多智能体系统可以增强角色对话的情感动态性和一致性，适用于医疗、教育、客户服务等情感敏感场景。

papers.title: DreamCharacter-1: From 3D Generative Foundation Models to Product-Ready Character Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present DreamCharacter-1, a lightweight post-adaptation framework that calibrates pretrained 3D foundation models toward high-fidelity, production-ready 3D character generation. Building upon a 3D foundation backbone, our pipeline incorporates three task-oriented components: (1) geometry post-training, which enhances fine-grained surface details through geometric preference optimization; (2) texture post-training, which synthesizes high-resolution textures and refines the appearance of occluded regions; and (3) inference acceleration, which enables scalable deployment. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that DreamCharacter-1 produces visually compelling and structurally robust 3D character assets, consistently surpassing state-of-the-art character generation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DreamCharacter-1 是一个轻量级后适应框架，用于将预训练的 3D 基础模型校准为高保真、可产品化的 3D 角色生成。管道包括几何后训练、纹理后训练和推理加速，在定量和定性实验中优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 3D 生成模型在生成产品级角色时缺乏精细几何细节和高分辨率纹理，且推理效率不足，难以大规模部署。
Method: 基于 3D 基础骨干网络，引入三个任务导向模块：几何后训练通过几何偏好优化增强表面细节；纹理后训练合成高分辨率纹理并细化遮挡区域外观；推理加速实现可扩展部署。
Result: 实验表明，DreamCharacter-1 能生成视觉上令人满意且结构鲁棒的 3D 角色资产，持续超越最先进的角色生成方法。
Conclusion: 该框架有效桥接了通用 3D 基础模型与产品级角色生成之间的差距，但未讨论几何和纹理后训练对非角色类物体的泛化能力。

papers.title: From Solvers to Research: Large Language Model-Driven Formal Mathematics at the Research Frontier
papers.abstract_en: Recent developments in AI for Mathematics (AI4Math), especially Large Language Model (LLM)-driven theorem provers, has achieved remarkable success in formal proof generation for well-defined mathematical problems through Interactive Theorem Proving (ITP) languages. However, current systems remain fundamentally limited in tackling frontier research mathematics, such as discovering new theorems or resolving open conjectures, which are often open-ended, under-specified, and involve multiple layers of abstraction. We argue that the next leap in AI4Math systems requires a decisive shift from predefined problem-solvers to research agents that can address frontier mathematical challenges with rigorous formal mathematical reasoning. In this position paper, we provide a systematic review of the field, covering datasets, auto-formalization, and proof synthesis. More importantly, we identify core limitations of existing systems in serving as mathematical research agents, examining issues across datasets, relational structure, mathematical exploration, tool ecosystem, and human-AI collaboration, outlining a strategic road-map for the future of AI4Math.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，系统综述了AI for Mathematics（AI4Math）领域的发展，重点关注大语言模型驱动的形式化定理证明系统。文章指出当前系统在处理前沿数学研究（如发现新定理或解决开放猜想）时存在根本局限，并提出了从预定义问题求解器转向能够进行严谨形式化数学推理的研究智能体的战略路线图。
Motivation: 现有AI4Math系统在解决明确定义的数学问题方面取得了成功，但面对开放、未明确、多层次的抽象前沿数学研究时表现不足，亟需转向研究智能体范式。
Method: 通过系统综述覆盖数据集、自动形式化与证明合成三方面，识别现有系统在数据集关系结构、数学探索、工具生态系统及人机协作等方面的核心限制。
Result: 指出当前系统无法有效应对前沿数学挑战，并提出了未来AI4Math发展的战略路线图。
Conclusion: AI4Math的下一个飞跃需要从求解器转向研究智能体，以支持开放性的形式化数学推理。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A law of robustness for two-layer neural networks with arbitrary weights
papers.abstract_en: Bubeck, Li and Nagaraj conjectured that, for generic data, any two-layer neural network with $m$ neurons that fits $n$ noisy labels must have Lipschitz constant at least of order $\sqrt{n/m}$, with no restriction on the size of the weights. Bubeck and Sellke proved a universal version of this law for Lipschitz-parameterized classes, but under a polynomial bound on the parameters; at depth three that boundedness hypothesis is genuinely necessary. The two-layer unbounded-weight case requires a different argument. We prove the conjectured law, up to one logarithmic factor, for every continuous piecewise-linear activation, in particular for ReLU networks. For data drawn uniformly from $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}$, $d\ge3$, or from $N(0,I_d/d)$, labels in $[-1,1]$ with noise level $σ^2>0$, and any width-$m$ two-layer network with arbitrary real weights, biases and affine skip connection, fitting the data $\varepsilon$ below the noise floor forces $\mathrm{Lip}(f)\ge c\,\varepsilon\sqrt{n/(\bar m\log(C\bar m nd/\varepsilon))}$, $\bar m=(K-1)m+1$, with high probability. A realized-kink-count version holds on the same event: every realized two-layer piecewise-linear function with $k(f)\le n$ distinct kink hyperplanes obeys the bound with $\bar m$ replaced by $k(f)+1$, irrespective of how many redundant hidden units parameterize it. The proof replaces parameter-space covering, impossible for unbounded weights, by a function-space covering. The central deterministic ingredient is a rigidity lemma: on $B_2$, and on $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}$ for $d\ge3$, the coefficient of each canonical kink is controlled by the Lipschitz constant of the realized function, because kinks on distinct hyperplanes cannot cancel at generic points. Rigidity genuinely fails at $d=2$, and an explicit two-layer ReLU interpolant with $O(1)$ Lipschitz constant at width $2n$ matches the law at the overparameterized endpoint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了两层神经网络在任意权重下拟合噪声标签时Lipschitz常数的一个下界猜想，该猜想最初由Bubeck、Li和Nagaraju提出。对于连续分段线性激活函数（如ReLU），当数据来自d≥3的球面或高斯分布时，Lipschitz常数至少为c ε √(n/(m log(...)))。证明采用函数空间覆盖方法，关键步骤是刚性引理：在球面上不同超平面的kink系数受Lipschitz常数控制。
Motivation: 解决两层神经网络在无界权重下的鲁棒性定律，该猜想此前仅在参数有界或深度≥3时得到部分证明。
Method: 使用函数空间覆盖代替参数空间覆盖，证明刚性引理：在球面或高维欧氏空间中，不同超平面上的kink不能在一般点抵消，从而每个kink系数受Lipschitz常数控制。
Result: 对于任意权重的两层网络，拟合噪声数据时Lipschitz常数下界为c ε √(n/(m log(C m n d / ε)))；若函数有k(f)个不同kink超平面，则下界与k(f)相关。在d=2时刚性引理不成立，但存在显式插值器满足定律。
Conclusion: 论文证明了Bubeck、Li和Nagaraju的猜想（差一个对数因子），为两层神经网络的鲁棒性提供了理论下限，并指出了低维情形的例外。

papers.title: Idiobionics: The Unification of Privacy and Intelligent Robotic Prostheses
papers.abstract_en: The human body is at the center of a growing family of technologies designed to tightly and persistently couple biological and digital systems. Robotic prostheses are a representative example of this tight coupling. Also referred to as bionic limbs, robotic prostheses are devices that support people who have lost limbs in pursuing daily life activities such as walking and grasping objects. Bionic limbs are now perceptive and responsive owing to their integration with advanced sensors and artificial intelligence-based control approaches. Consequently, such robotic prostheses can now be viewed as semiautonomous wearable robotic systems that can co-adapt with their users. However, the same sensing and control advancements that increase the capability of robotic prostheses also introduce threat vectors that could be exploited by malicious entities to violate the privacy of users. To fully realize the benefits of next-generation bionic limbs, we maintain it is important to directly understand and address these privacy risks and the barriers they might present to user adoption. This paper therefore introduces a new line of inquiry we term idiobionics to holistically investigate issues at the intersection of privacy and intelligent bionic limbs. As the main contribution of this paper, we define idiobionics, ground it in related literature, and provide preliminary evidence showing and discussing potential adversarial attacks that could exploit intelligent bionic limb designs. We then contribute a curated list of open research questions within idiobionics that are relevant to researchers in wearable robotics and other human-facing autonomous systems. We expect that idiobionics research will help unlock the full potential of robotic prostheses and related bionic devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为idiobionics的新研究方向，旨在系统性研究隐私与智能假肢（智能仿生肢体）的交叉问题。作者定义该领域，梳理相关文献，展示初步的对抗攻击证据，并列出开放研究问题，以促进用户采用。
Motivation: 智能假肢在传感和控制方面的进步虽然提升了能力，但也引入了隐私威胁，可能阻碍用户采用。因此，需要直接理解和应对这些隐私风险及其障碍。
Method: 通过定义idiobionics概念，综述相关文献，展示潜在的对抗攻击示例，并整理开放研究问题清单。
Result: 提供了初步的对抗攻击证据，并贡献了与可穿戴机器人和其他面向人类的自主系统相关的开放性研究问题列表。
Conclusion: 作者期望idiobionics研究能够帮助释放机器人假肢及相关仿生设备的全部潜力。

papers.title: Graph-Regularized Deep Learning for EEG-Based Emotion Recognition with Psychologically-Grounded Label Structure
papers.abstract_en: EEG-based emotion recognition is critical for mental health monitoring and affective brain-computer interfaces, yet existing deep learning approaches often treat emotion classes as isolated labels, ignoring their psychological interdependencies. We propose a graph-regularized learning framework that conceptualizes emotions as nodes in a graph where edges encode proximity based on dimensional emotion theories. We adapt three complementary regularization strategies--Graph Label Smoothing (intuitive soft labeling), Commuting distance on graph via Graph Laplacian (spectral graph theory), and Sliced Wasserstein Distance (optimal transport on graph)--ordered by increasing computational complexity. These strategies penalize model predictions that deviate from the established emotion topology. Our framework is evaluated across three representative backbone architectures: AudioTransformer (pure transformer), Conformer (CNN-transformer hybrid), and DCGNN (causal graph neural network), demonstrating architecture-agnostic benefits. Experiments on SEED-IV (4 classes) and SEED-V (5 classes) datasets show consistent improvements: best case up to +5.42% accuracy and 39% reduction in psychologically implausible misclassifications. Ultimately, our framework help raise the upper bound of performance achievable with standard approaches. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种图正则化深度学习框架，用于基于EEG的情绪识别，通过图标签平滑、图拉普拉斯上的通勤距离和切片Wasserstein距离三种正则化策略，利用情绪的心理维度拓扑结构提升识别性能。在SEED-IV和SEED-V数据集上，结合多种骨干网络（AudioTransformer、Conformer、DCGNN）取得一致提升，最高准确率提升5.42%，心理上不合理的误分类减少39%。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法常将情绪类别视为孤立标签，忽略了情绪之间的心理相互依赖关系，限制了识别性能。
Method: 提出图正则化框架，将情绪建模为图中的节点，边编码基于维度情绪理论的邻近性，并采用三种正则化策略：图标签平滑、图拉普拉斯通勤距离、切片Wasserstein距离，惩罚偏离情绪拓扑的预测。
Result: 在SEED-IV和SEED-V数据集上，结合三种骨干网络，最佳情况准确率提升5.42%，心理上不合理的误分类减少39%。
Conclusion: 所提框架可提升标准方法的性能上限，且架构无关，代码将发布。

papers.title: Principled Analysis of Deep Reinforcement Learning Evaluation and Design Paradigms
papers.abstract_en: Starting from the utilization of deep neural networks to approximate the state-action value function that led to winning one of the most challenging games, to algorithmic advancements that allowed solving problems without even explicitly stating the rules of the challenge at hand, reinforcement learning research has been the center of remarkable scientific progress for the past decade. In this paper, we focus on the key ingredients of this research progress and we analyze the canonical evaluation and design paradigms in reinforcement learning. We introduce the theoretical foundations of scaling laws in reinforcement learning and show that the asymptotic performance of reinforcement learning algorithms does not have a monotone relationship between performance rankings and data-regimes. We conduct large-scale experiments and our results demonstrate that a line of reinforcement learning research under the canonical design and evaluation paradigms resulted in incorrect conclusions. Our analysis and results provide a core analysis on scaling, capacity and complexity of deep reinforcement learning.

papers.title: Distributionally Faithful Imputation via Positive Semi-Definite Kernel Density Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Missing values undermine statistical inference and machine learning pipelines, yet most imputation methods rely on heuristics or restrictive parametric assumptions that ignore the joint data distribution. We recast imputation under missing completely at random (MCAR) as density estimation from masked observations: estimate a distribution whose observed marginals exactly match those in the data. Leveraging positive semi definite (PSD) kernel densities we obtain a convex empirical risk problem with closed form marginals, solvable by a Newton interior point method. The resulting PSD Impute model yields both single and multiple imputations from the same fitted density, enjoys statistical consistency with fast adaptive excess risk beating the curse of dimensionality for very regular probabilities. Preliminary experiments on one synthetic and eleven real world datasets already indicate competitive distributional accuracy compared with popular imputation baselines, suggesting strong practical promise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将MCAR下的缺失值插补重新表述为从掩蔽观测中进行密度估计，利用正半定核密度构建凸经验风险问题，通过牛顿内点法求解闭式边缘。PSD Impute模型从同一密度中同时生成单次和多次插补，具有统计一致性，对规则分布的自适应超额风险速度快于维数灾难。初步实验表明其在分布准确性上优于流行插补基线。
Motivation: 现有插补方法通常依赖启发式或参数假设，忽略联合数据分布，导致统计推断和机器学习流程受影响。本文旨在从缺失观测中直接且准确地估计完整数据分布。
Method: 将MCAR下的插补转化为密度估计问题，使用正半定核密度表示，构造凸经验风险目标函数并推导出闭式边际，采用牛顿内点法高效求解。
Result: 在1个合成数据集和11个真实数据集上的实验表明，PSD Impute在分布准确性上优于多种流行插补基线，并具有统计一致性和快速自适应超额风险率。
Conclusion: PSD Impute提供了一种基于密度估计的缺失值插补新范式，理论上保证了统计一致性，且初步实验支持其实用潜力。

papers.title: Alignment Plausibility: A New Standard for Assuring AI in Healthcare
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have become significant providers of mental health support, yet they remain products of an attention economy whose operational and commercial targets favour sustained engagement over the friction that effective psychological support often requires. Developers' safety responses have been largely reactive, addressing the most visible and acute harms while subtler, longer-term patterns of risk (e.g., dependency, boundary erosion, the amplification of distorted beliefs) receive less attention. We contend that making LLMs structurally safe requires alignment organised at three levels that mirror how society assures the safety of human clinical practice: 1) explicit value specification grounded in the codified normative commitments of clinical practice; 2) training that embeds those values in the model; and 3) oversight that detects drift and longer-term harm during deployment, much as clinical supervision does for human practice. Organising alignment in this way yields a construct we call alignment plausibility - a structured demonstration that a system's values, training regime, and oversight mechanisms are together consistent with safe and positive outcomes. We propose alignment plausibility as a regulatory construct (by drawing analogy to the established construct of biological plausibility) for AI in health: a principled way to argue for, or against, trust that systems are aligned to positive health outcomes, will cause no harm even where capable of doing so, and will ultimately lead to patient benefit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型在心理健康支持中的安全问题，提出对齐合理性（alignment plausibility）作为AI医疗安全的新标准。通过类比人类临床实践的安全保障，作者构建了三层对齐框架：明确价值规范、训练嵌入价值观、部署监督，并论证该框架能系统性地确保模型与积极健康结果对齐、不造成伤害并最终惠及患者。
Motivation: 现有LLM心理健康支持系统受注意力经济驱动，优先追求持续参与而非有效心理支持，而安全响应多是被动且集中于可见急性伤害，忽视了依赖、边界侵蚀、信念扭曲放大等长期风险。
Method: 提出三层对齐框架：1）基于临床实践规范明确价值规范；2）将价值观嵌入模型训练；3）部署后持续监控漂移和长期伤害。将这一结构化论证命名为对齐合理性（alignment plausibility），类比生物学合理性（biological plausibility）作为监管构念。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，但提出对齐合理性可作为监管框架，用于结构化论证AI系统是否与积极健康结果对齐、是否无害且促成患者受益。
Conclusion: 作者认为对齐合理性为医疗AI提供了一种原则性的信任论证方式，可系统性地评估和确保LLM在心理健康等临床场景中的安全性。

papers.title: Unlocking Temporal Generalization in Hamiltonian Video Dynamics Models
papers.abstract_en: World models are typically trained to predict discrete-time physical dynamics with a fixed step size baked into the model weights, preventing prediction at variable temporal resolutions. This matters for hierarchical planning, sim-to-real transfer, and scientific or game-engine applications that must query the same dynamics at multiple timescales. Hamiltonian Generative Networks (HGN) offer a principled path forward, grounding predictions in a continuous-time energy function that is, in principle, independent of the observation frame rate. In practice, however, their temporal generalization breaks down in non-conservative settings. We show that in externally forced, dissipative environments, HGN rollouts at step sizes beyond the training regime fail due to distinct failure modes, including latent magnitude growth driven by an unconstrained action-force map, and global truncation error accumulation from an under-resolved integrator. We identify a targeted fix for each mechanism and demonstrate stable dynamics prediction at temporal resolutions well outside the training distribution. In a detailed analysis, we recommend several strategies for enabling temporal generalization in continuous-time video generation.
papers.comment: To appear in the 1st Workshop on Physics-Aware Video Generation and Restoration at the 28th International Conference on Pattern Recognition
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究哈密顿生成网络（HGN）在视频动态模型中的时间泛化能力，指出在非保守（有外力、耗散）环境下，HGN在训练步长之外的预测失败，表现为潜在幅度增长和全局截断误差积累。作者针对这两种机制提出了修复策略，并在超出训练分布的时间分辨率下实现了稳定的动力学预测。
Motivation: 现有世界模型通常固定时间步长，无法在可变时间分辨率下预测，限制了层次规划、sim-to-real迁移等应用。HGN基于连续时间能量函数，理论上可泛化到不同帧率，但在非保守环境中时间泛化失败。
Method: 分析了两种失败模式：1）无约束的动作-力映射导致潜在幅度增长；2）积分器分辨率不足导致全局截断误差积累。针对每种机制提出了针对性修复策略，并通过实验验证了稳定性。
Result: 在非保守环境下，修复后的HGN能够在训练分布之外的时间分辨率上实现稳定动力学预测，展示了时间泛化的可行性。
Conclusion: 提出了使连续时间视频生成模型实现时间泛化的多种策略，并通过详细分析验证了有效性。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Trustworthy Machine Learning through the Lens of Combinatorial Optimization: Survey and Research Perspectives
papers.abstract_en: Modern machine learning (ML) increasingly relies on complex models whose behavior is difficult to characterize beyond empirical performance metrics. Across a wide range of tasks, including prediction, generation, and decision-making, models with similar empirical performance can exhibit markedly different properties in terms of their transparency, interpretability, robustness, fairness, privacy, and certifiability. This survey highlights how optimization- and certification-oriented reasoning can provide a useful framework for reasoning about such differences, supporting tasks ranging from model training and selection to auditing and certification. We review and synthesize recent advances at the intersection of combinatorial optimization (CO) and trustworthy ML, covering both training and post-training tasks, including interpretable model learning, explanation generation, robustness analysis, fairness auditing, model compression, and privacy attacks and protections. Across these domains, CO formulations offer additional capabilities over purely heuristic approaches, e.g., gradient-based ones, notably global guarantees, formal certificates, and explicit treatment of trade-offs. While scalability remains an important challenge, continued progress in solvers and hybrid algorithms suggests a growing role for CO in the design and deployment of trustworthy ML systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从组合优化的视角系统综述可信机器学习，涵盖可解释模型学习、解释生成、鲁棒性分析、公平性审计、模型压缩、隐私攻击与保护等任务。强调组合优化方法能提供全局保证、形式化证书和明确的权衡处理，但可扩展性仍是挑战。
Motivation: 现代机器学习模型行为复杂，仅凭经验指标难以全面刻画其透明度、可解释性、鲁棒性、公平性、隐私等可信属性，需要更严格的框架来区分模型间的差异。
Method: 系统综述近期组合优化与可信机器学习的交叉进展，按训练阶段和事后阶段组织，梳理了多个子领域的优化公式。
Result: 组合优化方法相比纯启发式方法（如基于梯度的）能提供全局保证、形式化证书以及明确的权衡处理，但可扩展性仍是重要挑战。
Conclusion: 尽管可扩展性仍是挑战，但求解器和混合算法的进步表明组合优化在可信机器学习系统的设计和部署中作用日益增长。

papers.title: Aligning Clinical Needs and AI Capabilities: A Survey on LLMs for Medical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as important tools in healthcare, showing growing potential for clinical reasoning and patient care. This survey examines recent progress in medical LLMs, focusing on reasoning applications and requirements. We present a dual-view approach that connects clinical practice with computational methods. On the clinical side, we establish a five-level competency scheme following Miller's Pyramid, progressing from knowledge recall to dynamic case management. On the computational side, we link deductive, inductive, and abductive reasoning patterns to common medical goals and tasks. We also introduce a benchmark dataset spanning five levels of medical reasoning capability and report results on 18 state-of-the-art models, revealing that medical specialist models excel in diagnosis-centric tasks while general models lead in decision support and dialogue. We conclude by discussing current progress and open challenges, including data limitations, hallucination, and grounding issues, and outline directions toward safer, more reliable, and workflow-ready systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了大型语言模型（LLMs）在临床推理中的应用，提出了一种连接临床实践与计算方法的双视角框架。临床方面基于Miller金字塔建立了五级能力体系，计算方面将演绎、归纳和溯因推理模式与医疗任务对应。引入了一个覆盖五级医疗推理能力的基准数据集，并在18个最新模型上进行了评估，发现医学专用模型在诊断任务中表现优异，而通用模型在决策支持和对话中更胜一筹。最后讨论了数据限制、幻觉和接地问题等当前挑战。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏将临床需求与AI能力系统对齐的综述，特别是缺少一个既能反映临床能力层次又能对应计算推理模式的统一框架。
Method: 提出双视角方法：临床侧采用Miller金字塔的五级能力方案（从知识回忆到动态病例管理）；计算侧将演绎、归纳和溯因推理模式与常见医疗目标和任务关联。构建了包含五级能力的基准数据集，并评估了18个模型。
Result: 医学专用模型在诊断为中心的任务上表现优异，通用模型在决策支持和对话中领先。
Conclusion: 本文提供了医疗LLMs推理能力的系统综述和基准，指出了数据、幻觉和接地等开放挑战，并提出了向更安全、更可靠、工作流程就绪的系统发展的方向。

papers.title: Adversarial Social Epistemology for Assemblies of Humans and Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We outline an adversarial social epistemology (ASE) for densely interactive communicative landscapes in which public assertions are scaffolded by chains of testimony, inference, institutional certification, and tacit trust. In such landscapes, agents have incentives and affordances to distort, color, omit, fabricate, or strategically under-specify information for private, reputational, rhetorical, or material gains. We argue that these phenomena are not adequately captured by familiar descriptions of epistemic bubbles, echo chambers, or misinformation diffusion. What requires explanation is how communicative agents exploit the commitments and entitlements that normally make scaffolded assertions trustworthy. We provide language that delivers the requisite analysis, outline mechanisms that subvert trust in scaffolded public communications, and outline machinery for auditing and redressing trust breaches arising from subverting the auditability of inferential chains, drawing on epistemic networks, enriched with an inferentialist semantics for interpreting assertions.

papers.title: AI-integrated models for assessing agricultural resilience
papers.abstract_en: Agricultural supply chains are vulnerable to disruptions through linked biophysical and economic systems. We develop an AI-powered tool that integrates economic models (GTAP) with biophysical models (APSIM) to analyze supply chain shocks, enabling policymakers and market participants to assess cross-disciplinary impacts through queries and responses written in natural language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个AI驱动的工具，将经济模型（GTAP）与生物物理模型（APSIM）相结合，用于分析农业供应链中的冲击。该工具允许政策制定者和市场参与者通过自然语言的查询和响应来评估跨学科影响。

Method: 开发了一个AI集成模型，连接经济模型（GTAP）和生物物理模型（APSIM），以自然语言接口处理查询，支持跨学科影响分析。

papers.title: Scalable and Trustworthy Earth Observation Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models (FMs) have transformed machine learning from isolated task-specific model development toward general-purpose models pretrained on broad data and adapted to multiple downstream tasks. Earth observation (EO) is an important domain for this paradigm because satellite and airborne archives are large, high-revisit, and increasingly multimodal, while reliable field labels are often sparse. Remote sensing foundation models (RSFMs) cannot be transferred reliably/optimally without domain-specific adaptation. This is because EO data are governed by measurement physics and operational decision constraints. This chapter reviews the design principles arising from these domain-specific constraints. It first defines the FMs paradigm in remote sensing (RS), then synthesizes the current model landscape, pretraining objectives, architecture designs, downstream adaptation and trustworthiness requirements. The chapter also incorporates recent benchmark evidence showing that no single geospatial foundation model is universally best and that inconsistent evaluation remains a major issue to fair comparison and reliable deployment. In addition, two brief environmental monitoring case studies; physics-informed spectral targeted masking for harmful algal bloom prediction and reinforcement learning for adaptive environmental monitoring station selection to illustrate the FMs domain-guided principles in practice. This chapter posits that next-generation RSFMs should be evaluated not only by benchmark accuracy, but also by modality-aware transfer and physically plausible representations for trustworthy EO decisions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该章节综述了地球观测（EO）基础模型的设计原则，包括预训练目标、架构设计、下游适应和可信赖性要求，并指出当前没有一个地理空间基础模型普遍最优，且评估不一致是主要问题。通过两个环境监测案例（有害藻华光谱掩码预测和强化学习自适应站点选择）说明领域引导原则。
Motivation: 遥感基础模型（RSFM）因地球观测数据受测量物理和决策约束，无法直接可靠迁移，需要领域特定适应。现有评估不一致且缺乏通用最优模型，亟需明确设计原则。
Method: 以综述形式系统回顾遥感领域基础模型范式，梳理当前模型、预训练方式、架构、下游适应和可信赖性要求，并辅以两个环境监测案例（物理信息光谱掩码和强化学习选址）。
Result: 基准证据表明没有单一地理空间基础模型普遍最优，不一致的评估是公平比较和可靠部署的主要障碍。
Conclusion: 下一代RSFM应不仅通过基准精度评估，还需通过模态感知迁移和物理合理表示来确保可信赖的地球观测决策。
Relevance: 45

papers.title: The Importance of Encoder Choice:A Tabular-Image Study
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal learning usually requires a dedicated encoder per modality. When a tabular modality is involved, prior work has been mostly using a \emph{plain MLP} as the encoder. Yet if it were a strong encoder, the tabular domain would not be ``the last unconquered castle for deep learning''. This study evaluates state-of-the-art tabular models as encoders in the image-tabular setting for the first time. An obstacle stands out. In-Context Learning models, among the best performing methods in the tabular domain, require labels to process instances, making it non-trivial to embed training and test instances the same way. We addressed this problem across multiple models of this family. With this study, we would like to highlight the importance of encoder factor in the multimodal learning.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次评估了最先进的表格模型作为图像-表格多模态设置中的编码器。研究发现，In-Context Learning模型虽在表格领域表现优异，但因其需要标签处理实例，导致训练和测试实例嵌入方式不同，作者针对此问题提出了解决方案。研究强调了编码器选择在多模态学习中的重要性。
Motivation: 在多模态学习中，表格模态通常使用简单的MLP作为编码器，但表格领域被称为深度学习的'最后一个未被征服的城堡'，因此有必要探索更强的表格编码器。
Method: 评估了多种先进的表格模型作为图像-表格场景的编码器，并针对In-Context Learning模型在嵌入训练和测试实例时的不对称问题提出了改进方法。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但指出该研究首次系统性地评估了表格编码器在多模态学习中的作用。
Conclusion: 编码器的选择对多模态学习的性能有重要影响，特别是对于表格模态，应超越传统MLP。
